zh.tag: 现代 C++ 格式化库，快速安全的 printf/iostream 替代品
zh.what: {fmt} 是一个开源格式化库，提供快速且安全的 C stdio 和 C++ iostreams 替代方案。它实现了 C++20 的 std::format 和 C++23 的 std::print，并支持类似 Python 的格式字符串语法。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的库源码、文档、示例和测试，核心文件包括 base.h、format.h 等，支持用户自定义类型和可移植的 Unicode。
zh.stack: 纯 C++ 实现，依赖少，支持 C++11 及以上标准，使用 Dragonbox 算法进行快速浮点格式化。
zh.hot: 今日新增 963 星，总星数达 25081，登顶 GitHub Trending 日榜。作为 C++ 标准库格式化功能的基础，其高性能和安全性备受开发者青睐。
uses: C++ 开发者需要比 printf 或 iostream 更安全、更快速的格式化输出时使用
库作者希望实现或扩展 C++20/23 格式化功能，或为自定义类型提供格式化支持
需要高精度浮点格式化且要求正确舍入和往返保证的数值计算场景

en.tag: A modern C++ formatting library, fast and safe alternative to printf and iostreams
en.what: {fmt} is an open-source formatting library providing a fast and safe alternative to C stdio and C++ iostreams. It implements C++20's std::format and C++23's std::print, with a format string syntax similar to Python's.
en.content: The repository contains full library source code, documentation, examples, and tests, with core files like base.h and format.h, supporting user-defined types and portable Unicode.
en.stack: Pure C++ implementation with minimal dependencies, supports C++11 and later, uses the Dragonbox algorithm for fast floating-point formatting.
en.hot: With 963 stars added today and 25,081 total, it tops the GitHub Trending daily chart. As the foundation for C++ standard formatting, its high performance and safety are widely appreciated.
uses: For C++ developers needing safer and faster formatting than printf or iostreams
For library authors implementing or extending C++20/23 formatting, or adding formatting support for custom types
For numerical computing scenarios requiring high-precision floating-point formatting with correct rounding and round-trip guarantees

zh.tag: 真实工程师的 AI 技能包，小而可组合
zh.what: 这是一个面向真实工程实践的 AI 代理技能集合，来自作者日常使用的 .agents 目录。它强调可组合、易修改，而非大而全的流程框架，旨在帮助开发者用 AI 完成实际编码任务。
zh.content: 仓库包含多个技能文件，每个技能针对特定工程任务（如代码审查、调试等），并附带安装脚本和说明文档。支持通过 Claude Code 插件或 npx 安装，可选择性安装到不同代理。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Shell 脚本，依赖 Claude Code 插件系统或 npx 工具，兼容多种 AI 代理（如 Codex）。
zh.hot: 24.7k stars 且日增 1601，位居日榜第二，因其提供了一种轻量、可控的 AI 工程实践方式，区别于流行的重流程框架，受到开发者欢迎。
uses: 希望用 AI 辅助实际编码但不想被复杂流程束缚的开发者
需要可定制、可组合技能来适配不同项目的工程师
对 Claude Code 或 Codex 等代理工具感兴趣，想扩展其能力的用户

en.tag: AI skills for real engineers, small and composable
en.what: A collection of AI agent skills for real engineering work, sourced from the author's daily .agents directory. It emphasizes composability and adaptability over monolithic frameworks, helping developers use AI for practical coding tasks.
en.content: The repo contains multiple skill files, each targeting a specific engineering task (e.g., code review, debugging), along with installation scripts and documentation. It can be installed via Claude Code plugin or npx, with selective installation to different agents.
en.stack: Primarily Shell scripts, leveraging Claude Code plugin system or npx tool, compatible with various AI agents (e.g., Codex).
en.hot: With 247k stars and +1601 today, ranking #2 on daily trending, it's popular for offering a lightweight, controllable approach to AI engineering, contrasting with heavy process frameworks.
uses: Developers who want AI assistance for real coding without being constrained by heavy workflows
Engineers needing customizable, composable skills to fit different projects
Users interested in extending the capabilities of agent tools like Claude Code or Codex

zh.tag: 自我进化的 AI 代理，跨平台、跨会话持续学习
zh.what: Hermes Agent 是一款由 Nous Research 构建的自我进化 AI 代理，内置学习循环，能从经验中创建技能、在应用中改进技能，并持续构建用户模型。它支持在多种平台（Telegram、Discord、Slack 等）和多种模型提供商之间无缝运行，且不锁定特定环境。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的代理代码库、终端 TUI 界面、跨平台网关、技能创建与改进机制、记忆管理、定时自动化（cron）、以及多语言 README 和文档。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python，依赖包括 FTS5 搜索、LLM 集成（支持 Nous Portal、OpenRouter、OpenAI 等）、以及 Honcho 用户建模库。
zh.hot: 凭借 24 万+ 星标和日增 774 星，其独特的自我改进学习循环和跨平台、跨会话的持久记忆能力引发了广泛关注，成为 AI 代理领域的热门项目。
uses: 开发者和 AI 爱好者希望部署一个能自主学习和适应用户行为的个人 AI 代理。
需要跨平台（如 Telegram、Discord）与 AI 交互并保持对话连续性的团队或个人。
研究者探索代理记忆、技能自动化和用户建模等前沿方向。

en.tag: Self-improving AI agent that learns from experience across sessions and platforms
en.what: Hermes Agent is a self-improving AI agent built by Nous Research, featuring a built-in learning loop that creates skills from experience, improves them during use, and builds a deepening model of the user. It runs seamlessly across platforms (Telegram, Discord, Slack, etc.) and model providers without lock-in.
en.content: The repository contains the full agent codebase, a terminal TUI, cross-platform gateway, skill creation and improvement mechanisms, memory management, scheduled automations (cron), and multilingual READMEs and docs.
en.stack: Primarily Python, with dependencies on FTS5 search, LLM integrations (Nous Portal, OpenRouter, OpenAI, etc.), and the Honcho user modeling library.
en.hot: With over 240K stars and 774 stars added today, its unique self-improving learning loop and persistent cross-session memory have captured attention, making it a trending project in the AI agent space.
uses: Developers and AI enthusiasts seeking a personal AI agent that autonomously learns and adapts to user behavior.
Teams or individuals needing cross-platform AI interaction (e.g., Telegram, Discord) with conversation continuity.
Researchers exploring cutting-edge topics like agent memory, skill automation, and user modeling.

zh.tag: 让 AI 代理像最懒的高级工程师一样写最少代码
zh.what: Ponytail 是一个 JavaScript 库/技能包，注入到 AI 代理中，使其倾向于生成极简代码，避免过度工程。它通过内置的“懒人”提示和规则，让代理在实现功能时优先使用浏览器原生能力或现有依赖，从而大幅减少代码量、成本和延迟。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心库、CLI 工具、基准测试脚本和文档。核心是注入到代理的提示词和规则集，支持 20 多种代理；基准测试展示了在真实仓库上的代码量减少（平均 54%，最高 94%）。
zh.stack: 主要语言是 JavaScript，通过 npm 分发，兼容多种 AI 代理（如 Claude Code）。依赖较少，核心是提示词工程。
zh.hot: 11 万星且日增近千，因为直击 AI 编程痛点：过度工程。它用幽默的“懒人”形象，承诺减少代码量、成本和延迟，且保持安全，引发开发者共鸣。
uses: AI 编程工具使用者：希望减少 AI 生成的冗余代码，提升代码质量。
团队技术负责人：想降低维护成本，让 AI 代理产出更简洁的代码。
对提示工程感兴趣者：学习如何通过提示词约束 AI 行为。

en.tag: Makes your AI agent write minimal code like a lazy senior dev
en.what: Ponytail is a JavaScript library/skill pack that injects a 'lazy senior dev' mindset into AI agents, pushing them to write minimal code and avoid over-engineering. It uses built-in prompts and rules to make agents prefer native browser features or existing dependencies, cutting code volume, cost, and latency.
en.content: The repo contains the core library, CLI tools, benchmark scripts, and docs. The core is a set of prompts and rules injected into agents, supporting 20+ agents; benchmarks show code reduction (mean 54%, up to 94%) on real repos.
en.stack: Primarily JavaScript, distributed via npm, compatible with 20+ AI agents (e.g., Claude Code). Minimal dependencies, core is prompt engineering.
en.hot: 111k stars with ~1k daily, because it hits the pain point of AI coding: over-engineering. With a humorous 'lazy dev' persona, it promises less code, lower cost, and faster execution while staying safe, resonating with developers.
uses: AI coding tool users: want to reduce redundant code and improve code quality.
Tech leads: aim to lower maintenance costs and get cleaner code from AI agents.
Prompt engineering enthusiasts: learn how to constrain AI behavior via prompts.

zh.tag: Claude Agent Skills 官方示例与规范库
zh.what: 这是 Anthropic 官方仓库，包含 Claude 的 Agent Skills 实现示例，涵盖创意、技术、企业工作流等。每个技能以文件夹形式提供 SKILL.md 指令和资源，帮助 Claude 在特定任务上表现更好。
zh.content: 仓库包含 skills 示例目录、Agent Skills 规范（spec）、技能模板（template），以及驱动 Claude 文档功能的 docx/pdf/pptx/xlsx 技能源码。
zh.stack: 主要语言为 Python，技能以 Markdown 指令和脚本形式组织，遵循 agentskills.io 规范。
zh.hot: 17.3 万星，今日新增 281，位列日榜第 5。作为 Anthropic 官方仓库，它展示了 Agent Skills 标准，是开发者学习构建可复用 AI 技能的首选参考。
uses: 开发者学习如何为 Claude 创建自定义技能，提升自动化效率。
企业团队参考企业级技能示例，如品牌文档生成和通信工作流。
AI 爱好者探索创意技能，如艺术、音乐和设计应用。
技术团队利用文档技能源码，集成到生产级 AI 应用中。

en.tag: Official Agent Skills examples and spec for Claude
en.what: This is Anthropic's official repository containing example implementations of Agent Skills for Claude, covering creative, technical, and enterprise workflows. Each skill is a folder with a SKILL.md file and resources that enable Claude to perform specialized tasks more effectively.
en.content: The repo includes example skills, the Agent Skills specification, a skill template, and the source for document skills (docx/pdf/pptx/xlsx) that power Claude's document capabilities.
en.stack: Primarily Python, skills are organized as Markdown instructions and scripts following the agentskills.io spec.
en.hot: 173k stars, +281 today, #5 on daily trending. As Anthropic's official repo, it demonstrates the Agent Skills standard and serves as the go-to reference for developers building reusable AI skills.
uses: Developers learning to create custom skills for Claude to boost automation.
Enterprise teams referencing business skills like branded document creation and communication workflows.
AI enthusiasts exploring creative skills for art, music, and design.
Technical teams leveraging document skill source code for production AI integrations.

zh.tag: 为 Claude Code 等 AI 编码代理打造的性能优化与安全增强系统
zh.what: ECC 是一个代理工具链（harness）优化系统，为 Claude Code、Codex、Opencode、Cursor 等 AI 编程代理提供技能、直觉、记忆、安全与研究优先的开发能力。它通过统一的配置与插件机制，增强代理在复杂任务中的表现与可控性。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心 JavaScript 库、CLI 工具、GitHub App（ecc-tools）、文档（多语言 README）以及示例配置，支持通过 npm 包（ecc-universal）集成。
zh.stack: 基于 JavaScript/Node.js，依赖 npm 生态，提供 CLI 与 GitHub App 集成，支持多代理框架（Claude Code、Codex 等）。
zh.hot: 凭借 24.4 万 Star 和今日新增 235 星，ECC 成为 AI 代理工具链领域的明星项目，其跨代理兼容性和性能优化特性吸引了大量开发者关注。
uses: AI 编码代理用户：希望增强 Claude Code、Codex 等代理的记忆、安全与技能，提升开发效率。
团队与组织：需要统一管理多个 AI 代理的配置、权限与安全策略，确保合规与可控。
开发者工具链爱好者：对代理性能优化、插件机制和 GitHub App 集成感兴趣，可扩展自定义功能。

en.tag: Performance optimization and security enhancement system for AI coding agents like Claude Code
en.what: ECC is an agent harness optimization system that provides skills, instincts, memory, security, and research-first development capabilities for AI coding agents like Claude Code, Codex, Opencode, and Cursor. It enhances agent performance and control through unified configuration and plugin mechanisms.
en.content: The repository includes core JavaScript libraries, CLI tools, a GitHub App (ecc-tools), multi-language documentation, and example configurations, integrable via the npm package (ecc-universal).
en.stack: Built on JavaScript/Node.js, leveraging the npm ecosystem, offering CLI and GitHub App integration, compatible with multiple agent frameworks (Claude Code, Codex, etc.).
en.hot: With 244k stars and 235 new stars today, ECC has become a star project in the AI agent toolchain space, attracting developers with its cross-agent compatibility and performance optimization features.
uses: AI coding agent users: Enhance memory, security, and skills for agents like Claude Code and Codex to boost development productivity.
Teams and organizations: Need unified management of configurations, permissions, and security policies across multiple AI agents for compliance and control.
Developer toolchain enthusiasts: Interested in agent performance optimization, plugin mechanisms, and GitHub App integration for custom extensions.

zh.tag: 让 AI 编程代理用原始人语言省 65% token 的 Claude Code 技能
zh.what: Caveman 是一个针对 Claude Code 等 AI 编程代理的技能（skill），通过将代理的回复转换为简洁的原始人风格语言，大幅减少 token 消耗。它保留了代码、命令和错误信息等关键内容，仅精简冗余的叙述性文字，从而在保持诊断准确性的同时降低成本。
zh.content: 仓库包含技能文件（SKILL.md）、安装脚本、代理包装配置（支持 30+ 代理，原生包装 10 种）、文档和示例，以及一个可选的代理模式用于进一步压缩 token。
zh.stack: 主要语言为 Go，用于实现代理包装和代理功能；技能本身是纯提示词工程，兼容 Claude Code、Codex 等 30 多种 AI 代理。
zh.hot: 在 token 计费时代，直接节省 65% 成本极具吸引力，上线即获 10 万+ star，日增 543，登上 GitHub 热榜第 7 名。
uses: 使用 Claude Code 等按 token 计费的 AI 编程代理的开发者，希望降低 API 成本
需要处理大量代码生成任务、追求效率的团队，可减少 token 消耗而不牺牲输出质量
对 AI 提示工程感兴趣，想了解如何通过语言风格优化来压缩 token 的爱好者

en.tag: Claude Code skill that cuts 65% tokens by making AI talk like a caveman
en.what: Caveman is a skill for AI coding agents like Claude Code that converts agent responses into terse caveman-style language, significantly reducing token usage. It preserves code, commands, and error messages while trimming verbose explanations, cutting costs without losing diagnostic accuracy.
en.content: The repo includes skill files (SKILL.md), install scripts, proxy wrap profiles for 30+ agents (10 native), docs, examples, and an optional proxy mode for further token reduction.
en.stack: Primarily Go for the proxy and wrapper; the skill itself is pure prompt engineering, compatible with 30+ agents like Claude Code and Codex.
en.hot: In the token-billing era, saving 65% costs is compelling; it gained 100k+ stars quickly, +543 today, ranking #7 on GitHub Trending.
uses: Developers using token-billed AI coding agents like Claude Code who want to reduce API costs
Teams handling large code generation tasks seeking efficiency, cutting token usage without sacrificing output quality
Enthusiasts interested in prompt engineering and how language style optimization compresses tokens

zh.tag: AI 文本去味剂，让机器写作更自然
zh.what: 一个便携的代理技能，用于去除文本中 AI 写作的痕迹，使其听起来更自然、更像人类。它基于维基百科的“AI 写作迹象”指南，并包含二次润色和防幻觉机制。
zh.content: 仓库包含一个 SKILL.md 文件，可通过 skills CLI 或手动安装到任何支持技能指令的代理框架中。支持全局或项目级安装，并可作为 Claude Code 插件使用。
zh.stack: 纯 Markdown 技能文件，无外部依赖，可在任何支持技能指令的代理框架中运行。
zh.hot: 本周新增 1504 星，总星数 31573，排名 Python 周榜第 16。因其解决了 AI 写作“一眼假”的痛点，且安装使用极其简单，受到开发者社区追捧。
uses: 内容创作者 —— 将 AI 草稿润色为自然的人类风格，避免被检测
开发者 —— 集成到代理工作流中，自动优化 AI 生成的文本输出
学术写作者 —— 确保论文或报告中的 AI 辅助内容更符合人类写作习惯

en.tag: Remove AI-generated writing signs, make text sound human
en.what: A portable agent skill that removes signs of AI-generated writing from text, making it sound more natural and human. It is based on Wikipedia's 'Signs of AI writing' guide and includes a second rewrite pass with hallucination prevention.
en.content: The repo contains a single SKILL.md file that can be installed via skills CLI or manually into any agent harness supporting skill-style instructions. Supports global or project-local install and can be used as a Claude Code plugin.
en.stack: Plain Markdown skill file with no external dependencies, runs in any harness that supports skill-style instructions.
en.hot: Gained 1504 stars this week, total 31573, ranked #16 on Python weekly trending. It addresses the pain point of AI-generated text being easily detectable, and is extremely easy to install and use.
uses: Content creators — polish AI drafts into natural human style to avoid detection
Developers — integrate into agent workflows to automatically optimize AI-generated text output
Academic writers — ensure AI-assisted content in papers or reports reads more naturally

zh.tag: Google 时序预测基础模型，支持多变量与协变量
zh.what: TimesFM 是 Google Research 开发的预训练时序基础模型，用于时间序列预测。它采用 decoder-only 架构，在大量时序数据上预训练，能够进行零样本预测。最新 3.0 版本支持原生多变量预测和协变量，并在多个基准上排名第一。
zh.content: 仓库包含模型源码、预训练权重（Hugging Face）、示例和文档。代码结构分版本管理，最新 3.0 在根目录，旧版本归档在 v1 子目录。
zh.stack: 基于 PyTorch 实现，依赖 Hugging Face Transformers 等。提供 pip 包安装，支持 Python。
zh.hot: 近期发布 3.0 版本，带来多变量预测和协变量支持，在三大基准上排名第一，引发社区关注。今日新增 1618 star，总星标超 3 万。
uses: 时间序列预测研究者：用于零样本预测和模型对比实验
数据科学家：快速进行多变量预测，无需大量训练数据
企业应用开发者：集成到 BigQuery ML 或 Vertex AI 进行规模化预测

en.tag: Google's pretrained time-series foundation model for forecasting, with multivariate & covariate support
en.what: TimesFM is a pretrained time-series foundation model by Google Research for time-series forecasting. It uses a decoder-only architecture pretrained on diverse time-series data, enabling zero-shot forecasting. The latest 3.0 version natively supports multivariate forecasting and covariates, ranking #1 on multiple benchmarks.
en.content: The repo contains model source code, pretrained weights (on Hugging Face), examples, and docs. Code is organized by version; latest 3.0 is at root, older versions archived under v1.
en.stack: Implemented in PyTorch, leveraging Hugging Face Transformers. Installable via pip, Python-based.
en.hot: The recent 3.0 release with native multivariate forecasting and covariates, achieving #1 on three major benchmarks, has sparked interest. Gained 1,618 stars today, total over 30k.
uses: Time-series researchers: for zero-shot forecasting and model benchmarking
Data scientists: for quick multivariate forecasting without extensive training data
Enterprise developers: integrating with BigQuery ML or Vertex AI for scalable forecasting

zh.tag: 自托管视频下载器，支持千余站点，界面简洁
zh.what: ReClip 是一个自托管、开源的视频和音频下载工具，提供简洁的网页界面。用户粘贴 YouTube、TikTok、Instagram 等 1000+ 网站的链接，即可下载为 MP4 或 MP3。它基于 yt-dlp 和 ffmpeg，后端仅约 150 行 Python 代码，前端无框架、无需构建步骤。
zh.content: 仓库包含一个 Python 后端（Flask 应用，约 150 行）、一个单文件前端（HTML/CSS/JS）、启动脚本 reclip.sh、Dockerfile 以及 README 和预览截图。核心功能包括批量下载、URL 去重、质量选择等。
zh.stack: 后端使用 Python + Flask，前端为原生 HTML/CSS/JS，下载引擎为 yt-dlp 和 ffmpeg，依赖仅两个：Flask 和 yt-dlp。支持 Docker 部署。
zh.hot: 凭借极简设计和强大功能，ReClip 在 GitHub 上迅速走红，7.6k+ 星标，日增 56 星，登上趋势榜第 12 名。其轻量、自托管的特点吸引了大量希望摆脱在线下载器限制的用户。
uses: 个人用户：需要从多个网站下载视频或音频，用于离线观看或剪辑。
开发者：希望部署一个轻量级、可自托管的下载服务，集成到自己的工具链中。
内容创作者：需要批量下载素材，用于二次创作或存档。

en.tag: Self-hosted video downloader for 1000+ sites with a clean web UI
en.what: ReClip is a self-hosted, open-source video and audio downloader with a clean web UI. Paste links from YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, and 1000+ other sites to download as MP4 or MP3. It leverages yt-dlp and ffmpeg, with a backend of ~150 lines of Python and a framework-free, no-build frontend.
en.content: The repo contains a Python backend (Flask app, ~150 lines), a single-file frontend (HTML/CSS/JS), a startup script reclip.sh, a Dockerfile, and README with preview screenshots. Key features include bulk downloads, URL deduplication, and quality selection.
en.stack: Backend uses Python + Flask, frontend is vanilla HTML/CSS/JS, download engine is yt-dlp and ffmpeg, with only two dependencies: Flask and yt-dlp. Docker deployment is supported.
en.hot: With its minimal design and powerful features, ReClip has quickly gained popularity on GitHub, amassing 7.6k+ stars with 56 new stars today, ranking #12 on the trending list. Its lightweight, self-hosted nature appeals to users seeking an alternative to online downloaders.
uses: Individual users who need to download videos or audio from multiple sites for offline viewing or editing.
Developers looking to deploy a lightweight, self-hosted download service to integrate into their own toolchain.
Content creators who need to bulk download materials for remixing or archiving.

zh.tag: 翻墙工具与教程大全，覆盖多平台多协议

zh.hot: 拥有超过5.2万星标，今日新增522星，位列日榜第11，因其提供实用的翻墙解决方案而持续受到关注。

开发者或运维人员可参考自建V2ray/SS服务器教程。

en.tag: Comprehensive circumvention tools and tutorials for multiple platforms and protocols

zh.tag: 为AI编码代理提供生产级工程技能的技能包
zh.what: 这个仓库提供了一套编码技能，将资深工程师的工作流程、质量门禁和最佳实践编码成AI代理可以遵循的规范。它通过斜杠命令和自动触发机制，覆盖从规格定义到部署的整个开发周期。
zh.content: 仓库包含24个技能，每个技能位于skills/目录下，并配有references/目录存放参考文档。提供8个斜杠命令（如/spec、/plan、/build）对应开发阶段，还支持通过skills CLI安装到70多种AI代理中。
zh.stack: 主要语言是JavaScript，依赖Vercel Labs的skills CLI进行安装和管理。技能本身是Markdown格式的指令集，可被Claude Code、Cursor、Codex等代理识别。
zh.hot: 该仓库在GitHub Trending上排名靠前，拥有近9万星标，因为AI编码代理的普及使得开发者急需标准化的工程实践来提升代码质量。它提供即插即用的技能，简化了代理的工作流程。
uses: AI代理用户：希望让Claude Code、Cursor等代理遵循资深工程师的最佳实践。
开发团队：需要统一编码规范和质量门禁，提升代码审查和测试效率。
技术管理者：希望自动化开发流程，减少人工干预，同时保持质量。

en.tag: Production-grade engineering skills for AI coding agents
en.what: This repository provides a set of coding skills that encode the workflows, quality gates, and best practices of senior engineers into guidelines AI agents can follow. It covers the entire development lifecycle from spec to deployment via slash commands and automatic triggers.
en.content: The repo contains 24 skills, each in the skills/ directory, with a references/ directory for supporting docs. It offers 8 slash commands (e.g., /spec, /plan, /build) mapped to development phases, and can be installed into 70+ AI agents via the skills CLI.
en.stack: Primary language is JavaScript, with the Vercel Labs skills CLI for installation and management. The skills are Markdown-formatted instruction sets recognized by agents like Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, etc.
en.hot: With nearly 90k stars and trending on GitHub, this repo addresses the growing need for standardized engineering practices in AI coding agents. It offers plug-and-play skills that streamline agent workflows and improve code quality.
uses: AI agent users: want agents like Claude Code, Cursor to follow senior engineer best practices.
Development teams: need unified coding standards and quality gates to improve code review and testing efficiency.
Tech leads: want to automate development workflows, reduce manual steps, while maintaining quality.

zh.tag: 用图解和通俗语言讲解系统设计的开源指南
zh.what: 这是一个通过大量图表和通俗易懂的语言，深入浅出地解释复杂系统原理的仓库，旨在帮助用户准备系统设计面试或理解系统底层运作。内容覆盖API、网络协议、负载均衡、HTTP状态码等广泛主题。
zh.content: 仓库包含一系列图文指南，每个主题都有详细的图解和简洁的文字说明，并附有目录索引和外部链接。内容以Markdown和图片为主，结构清晰，便于查阅。
zh.stack: 主要使用Markdown编写，辅以图片和外部链接，无特定编程语言依赖。可能使用GitHub Pages或静态站点生成器来展示内容。
zh.hot: 该仓库已获得超过8.8万星标，今日新增171星，位居Trending日榜第13名。其内容直观易懂，非常适合准备系统设计面试的开发者，因此持续受到欢迎。
uses: 准备系统设计面试的软件工程师，可快速掌握核心概念。
希望理解大型系统内部工作原理的技术爱好者或学生。
需要快速查阅API、网络协议等基础知识的开发者。

en.tag: Open-source guide explaining complex systems with visuals and simple terms
en.what: This repository explains complex systems using visuals and simple terms, helping users prepare for system design interviews or understand how systems work under the hood. It covers topics like APIs, network protocols, load balancers, HTTP status codes, and more.
en.content: The repository contains a collection of illustrated guides, each with detailed diagrams and concise text explanations, organized with a table of contents and external links. Content is primarily Markdown and images, structured for easy navigation.

Tech enthusiasts or students wanting to understand how large-scale systems work internally.
Developers needing quick reference on APIs, network protocols, and other fundamentals.

zh.tag: 本地模型推理服务器，让 AI 代理离线运行
zh.what: Magnitude 是一个开源推理服务器，能自动检测你的硬件配置，推荐并运行最适合的本地模型，并接入你正在使用的 AI 代理（如 Pi、OpenCode、Claude Code 等）。它让代理完全离线、私密且免费地运行，无需 API 密钥或令牌费用。
zh.content: 仓库包含 CLI 工具（@magnitudedev/cli）、推理服务器核心、模型管理功能（下载、调优、运行），以及支持多种代理的集成层。提供交互式设置向导和文档，帮助用户快速配置本地模型。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript 编写，通过 npm 分发 CLI。支持 macOS、Linux（Windows 通过 WSL），依赖本地硬件资源进行模型推理，兼容多种代理框架。
zh.hot: 今日新增 161 星，总星数达 1950，登上 GitHub Trending 日榜。它解决了 AI 代理依赖云端 API 的痛点，提供免费、私密、离线的本地推理方案，吸引大量开发者关注。
uses: 开发者希望让 Claude Code、Codex 等代理完全本地运行，保护代码隐私并节省 API 成本。
硬件配置不高的用户，需要自动推荐并优化适合自己设备的本地模型。
追求离线工作的场景，如无网络环境或对数据安全要求高的团队。

en.tag: Open-source inference server to run local models with your existing AI agents
en.what: Magnitude is an open-source inference server that profiles your hardware, recommends and runs the best local models, and plugs into the AI agents you already use (e.g., Pi, OpenCode, Claude Code). It enables fully offline, private, and free agent operation without API keys or token costs.
en.content: The repo includes a CLI tool (@magnitudedev/cli), the inference server core, model management (download, tune, run), and integrations for multiple agents. It offers an interactive setup wizard and documentation for quick configuration.
en.stack: Written primarily in TypeScript, distributed via npm. Supports macOS and Linux (Windows via WSL), leverages local hardware for inference, and integrates with various agent frameworks.
en.hot: Gained 161 stars today, reaching 1,950 total, and hit #14 on GitHub Trending. It addresses the pain point of cloud-dependent AI agents by offering free, private, offline local inference, attracting many developers.
uses: Developers who want agents like Claude Code or Codex to run fully locally, protecting code privacy and saving API costs.
Users with modest hardware who need automatic recommendations and tuning of local models for their devices.
Offline-first scenarios, such as no-network environments or teams with strict data security requirements.

zh.tag: 为 Claude Code 打造的全流程学术研究技能套件
zh.what: 这是一套为 Claude Code 设计的学术研究技能包，覆盖从研究到发表的完整流程，包括文献检索、写作、评审、修订和定稿。它强调人机协作，AI 作为副驾驶，帮助处理引用格式化、数据验证等繁琐工作，而研究者专注于核心思考。

uses: 学术研究者：希望利用 AI 辅助论文写作，但保持对研究过程和内容的掌控。
学生和学者：需要高效管理参考文献、检查逻辑一致性，并提升写作质量。
AI 工具爱好者：探索 Claude Code 在专业领域的深度应用，学习如何构建技能插件。

en.tag: A comprehensive suite of Claude Code skills for the full academic research pipeline
en.what: This is a suite of skills for Claude Code covering the full academic research pipeline from research to publication, including literature search, writing, review, revision, and finalization. It emphasizes human-AI collaboration, with AI as a copilot handling grunt work like citation formatting and data verification, while researchers focus on core thinking.
en.content: The repository contains multiple skill modules such as research planning, writing quality check, style calibration, and review, along with detailed documentation and reference materials including a list of AI research failure modes. Installation is simple, supporting CLI, VS Code, and JetBrains.
en.stack: Primarily based on Python, used as a plugin for Claude Code, relying on Claude Code's plugin system.
en.hot: With nearly 45k stars and 193 new stars today, it precisely addresses academic writing pain points, offering a human-in-the-loop rather than fully automated approach, gaining wide attention from researchers and AI tool users.
uses: Academic researchers who want AI assistance in paper writing while maintaining control over the research process and content.
Students and scholars needing efficient reference management, logical consistency checks, and writing quality improvement.
AI tool enthusiasts exploring deep applications of Claude Code in professional domains and learning to build skill plugins.

zh.tag: 开源终端编码代理，兼容任意 LLM 后端
zh.what: OpenClaude 是一个开源的编码代理 CLI，支持云端和本地模型提供商。它允许用户通过统一的终端工作流使用 OpenAI 兼容 API、Gemini、GitHub Models、Codex OAuth、Ollama 等，同时保留提示、工具、代理、MCP、斜杠命令和流式输出等功能。

zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript 构建，依赖 Node.js 环境，支持多种 LLM 提供商 API。
zh.hot: 凭借 31k+ stars 和日增 80 的势头，OpenClaude 凭借其‘随处运行、使用任何东西’的灵活性和对多种模型后端的支持，迅速成为开发者首选。
uses: 开发者希望在终端中统一管理多种 LLM 提供商，无需切换工具。
团队需要将编码代理集成到 CI/CD 或自动化工作流中。
喜欢使用 Ollama 等本地模型进行离线开发的用户。

en.tag: Open-source terminal coding agent for any LLM backend
en.what: OpenClaude is an open-source coding-agent CLI for cloud and local model providers. It lets you use OpenAI-compatible APIs, Gemini, GitHub Models, Codex OAuth, Codex, Ollama, Atomic Chat, and other supported backends while keeping one terminal-first workflow: prompts, tools, agents, MCP, slash commands, and streaming output.

en.hot: With 31k+ stars and 80 daily additions, OpenClaude's flexibility to run anywhere and use any model backend has made it a top choice for developers.

Teams looking to integrate a coding agent into CI/CD or automated workflows.
Users who prefer local models like Ollama for offline development.

zh.tag: 本地优先的全能语音工作室
zh.what: VoiceStudio 是一个开源的、完全本地运行的语音工具集，提供类似 ElevenLabs 的功能，包括声音克隆、语音设计、视频配音、听写、转录和有声书制作，支持 646 种语言。无需账户、API 密钥或订阅，所有处理都在用户自己的硬件上完成。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的应用代码、文档、安装指南、架构说明和 API 文档，支持 macOS、Windows、Linux 及 Docker。集成了 16 种 TTS 引擎和 11 种 ASR 引擎，提供图形界面和命令行工具。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python 构建，依赖多种开源 TTS/ASR 引擎（如 Coqui、Whisper 等），支持跨平台桌面环境与 Docker 部署。
zh.hot: 作为本地优先的 ElevenLabs 替代品，VoiceStudio 在隐私和成本敏感的用户中迅速走红，单日新增 1672 星，总星数达 16279，反映出对自主语音处理工具的高需求。
uses: 内容创作者：需要为视频配音或制作多语言音频，但不想依赖云服务。
隐私敏感用户：希望语音数据完全留在本地，避免上传到第三方。
开发者：需要集成语音克隆或转录功能的 API，且要求离线运行。
语言学习者：利用 646 种语言支持进行听力练习或生成自定义语音内容。

en.tag: Fully-local voice studio: clone, dub, transcribe & more
en.what: VoiceStudio is an open-source, fully-local voice toolkit offering ElevenLabs-like features: voice cloning, voice design, video dubbing, dictation, transcription, and audiobook creation across 646 languages. No account, API key, or subscription required—everything runs on your own hardware.
en.content: The repository includes full application code, docs, installation guides, architecture, and API docs, supporting macOS, Windows, Linux, and Docker. It integrates 16 TTS engines and 11 ASR engines, offering both GUI and CLI tools.
en.stack: Built primarily with Python, leveraging various open-source TTS/ASR engines (e.g., Coqui, Whisper), with cross-platform desktop support and Docker deployment.
en.hot: As a local-first ElevenLabs alternative, VoiceStudio is gaining rapid traction among privacy- and cost-conscious users, adding 1,672 stars in a day to reach 16,279 total, reflecting high demand for self-hosted voice tools.
uses: Content creators needing video dubbing or multilingual audio without cloud dependency.
Privacy-conscious users who want voice data to stay entirely on-device.
Developers seeking offline APIs for voice cloning or transcription integration.
Language learners leveraging 646-language support for listening practice or custom audio.

zh.tag: 全球最大开源 AI 提示词库，支持多模型与自托管
zh.what: prompts.chat 是一个社区驱动的 AI 提示词（prompt）集合，最初面向 ChatGPT，现在兼容 Claude、Gemini、Llama 等多种模型。用户可以浏览、分享、发现并收藏提示词，同时支持完全隐私的自托管部署。

uses: AI 爱好者与开发者：寻找高质量提示词以提升 ChatGPT、Claude 等模型的输出效果。
企业与团队：通过自托管部署，在内部安全地共享和管理提示词。

zh.tag: 为编码代理打造的一整套技能框架与软件开发方法论
zh.what: Superpowers 是一套完整的软件开发方法论，专为编码代理（如 Claude Code、Cursor 等）设计。它通过组合式技能和初始指令，让代理在编码前先明确需求、制定计划，并采用严格的 TDD、YAGNI 和 DRY 原则，实现自主开发。
zh.content: 仓库包含技能集、初始指令、安装指南（支持多种代理工具如 Claude Code、Cursor、Gemini CLI 等）、工作流程说明、哲学理念和贡献指南。

uses: 希望提升 AI 编码代理效率与代码质量的开发者
使用 Claude Code、Cursor 等 AI 编程工具的团队，需要标准化开发流程
对 TDD、YAGNI 等敏捷实践感兴趣的工程师，想将方法论融入 AI 工作流
探索 AI 代理自主开发复杂项目的技术爱好者

en.tag: A complete agentic skills framework and software development methodology for coding agents
en.what: Superpowers is a complete software development methodology for coding agents, built on composable skills and initial instructions. It guides agents to clarify requirements, create implementation plans, and follow TDD, YAGNI, and DRY principles for autonomous development.
en.content: The repository contains a set of composable skills, initial instructions, installation guides for various harnesses (Claude Code, Cursor, Gemini CLI, etc.), workflow descriptions, philosophy, and contributing guidelines.
en.stack: Primarily Shell scripts, leveraging plugin/skill systems of coding agents like Claude Code's plugin marketplace.
en.hot: With 281k+ stars and 462 daily additions, it addresses the urgent need for efficient autonomous coding with AI agents, offering a systematic, reusable methodology.
uses: Developers seeking to enhance efficiency and code quality of AI coding agents
Teams using AI coding tools like Claude Code or Cursor needing standardized workflows
Engineers interested in agile practices like TDD and YAGNI, integrating them into AI workflows
Tech enthusiasts exploring autonomous development of complex projects with AI agents

视频创作者：为科普内容添加精确的数学动画

en.tag: Animation engine for explanatory math videos by 3Blue1Brown

zh.tag: 2小时从零训练64M超小语言模型，全流程开源教程
zh.what: MiniMind 是一个从零开始训练超小语言模型（64M参数）的开源项目，仅需3块钱成本和2小时即可在单张消费级GPU上完成训练。项目覆盖从数据清洗、预训练到SFT、RLHF、Agentic RL等完整链路，并扩展了视觉、多模态等变体。

个人开发者/研究者：在消费级GPU上快速实验预训练、微调、RLHF等全流程。

Individual developers/researchers: quickly experiment with pretraining, fine-tuning, RLHF on consumer GPUs.
Educational settings: as a hands-on project for AI courses, reproducing cutting-edge techniques at low cost.
Those interested in model compression and efficient training: explore the performance limits of 64M small models.

zh.tag: 一条命令微调大模型，无需SSH和复杂配置

zh.tag: 面向前沿编程代理的原创长周期工程任务基准
zh.what: DeepSWE 是一个用于评估前沿编程代理的基准测试，包含来自活跃开源仓库的 113 个原创长周期软件工程任务，覆盖多种语言。每个任务提供隔离环境和基于程序的验证器，确保评分客观可靠。

en.tag: Benchmark for frontier coding agents on original, long-horizon engineering tasks

Developers test their agents' end-to-end capabilities, identify weaknesses, and iterate
AI educators demonstrate limitations and potential of frontier agents in teaching

zh.tag: 把整个项目文件夹变成可查询知识图谱的 AI 技能
zh.what: 给 Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode、Cursor、Gemini CLI 等 AI 编码助手用的 skill：输入 /graphify，它就把整个项目（代码、SQL schema、文档、PDF、图片、视频）映射成一张可查询的知识图谱，代替 grep 翻文件。代码解析走 tree-sitter AST —— 确定性、不用 LLM、完全本地；文档类内容才走模型做语义处理。不是向量索引，是真图谱，每条边标注 EXTRACTED（直接读到）还是 INFERRED（推断出来）。
zh.content: 以 CLI 形式分发（PyPI 包 graphifyy，uv tool install 或 pipx 安装），仓库含 docs/（30 多种语言 README 翻译）和交互式 graph.html 可视化产物；默认分支 v8，迭代很快。
zh.stack: Python + tree-sitter 代码解析，产出力导向 HTML 图；挂到各家 CLI 助手上当 skill 用。
zh.hot: 它用知识图谱补足纯向量检索的局限，直接回应团队构建上下文型 AI 助手时遇到的 RAG 难题。
uses: 接手中大型老项目的开发者 —— 一条命令生成知识图谱，快速搞清代码结构
AI 重度用户 —— 给 agent 换图谱上下文，替代检索不准的向量 RAG
技术文档团队 —— 把文档 / PDF / 图纸一起纳入可查询图谱

en.tag: An AI skill that turns a whole project folder into a queryable knowledge graph
en.what: A skill for Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Cursor, Gemini CLI and more: type /graphify and your entire project — code, SQL schemas, docs, PDFs, images, videos — is mapped into a queryable knowledge graph, replacing grep-and-scroll. Code parsing uses tree-sitter AST: deterministic, no LLM, fully local; only document content goes through a model. Not a vector index — a real graph, with every edge labeled EXTRACTED (read directly) or INFERRED.
en.content: Distributed as a CLI (PyPI package graphifyy, install via uv tool install or pipx); the repo holds docs/ (README translations in 30+ languages) and interactive graph.html visualizations; default branch v8, iterating fast.
en.stack: Python + tree-sitter, outputting force-directed HTML graphs; hooks into each CLI assistant as a skill.
en.hot: Its knowledge-graph alternative to vector-only retrieval speaks directly to limitations teams encounter when building contextual AI assistants.
uses: Developers inheriting large legacy projects — one command maps the codebase into a knowledge graph
Heavy AI users — swap vector RAG for graph context that retrieves the right thing
Docs teams — fold docs, PDFs and diagrams into one queryable graph

zh.tag: 用稳定命名本地URL替代端口号，面向开发者和AI代理
zh.what: Portless 是一个开发工具，让你用像 https://myapp.localhost 这样的稳定命名 URL 替代 localhost:3000 之类的端口号。它自动管理 HTTPS、端口分配和代理，简化本地开发体验，尤其适合人类和 AI 代理。

zh.stack: 主要用 TypeScript 编写，依赖 Node.js 生态，通过 npm 分发。涉及 HTTPS/HTTP2、代理、进程管理等技术。
zh.hot: 今日新增 450 星，总星数 12052，登上 GitHub Trending 日榜。它解决了开发中端口记忆和冲突的痛点，并迎合了 AI 代理对稳定 URL 的需求。
uses: 本地开发人员：告别端口号，使用易记的命名 URL 访问多个项目。
AI 代理开发者：为代理提供稳定的本地端点，便于自动化测试和交互。
团队协作：统一开发环境，减少端口冲突和配置问题。

en.tag: Replace port numbers with stable named local URLs for dev and agents
en.what: Portless is a dev tool that replaces port numbers with stable named URLs like https://myapp.localhost. It automatically handles HTTPS, port assignment, and proxying, simplifying local development for both humans and AI agents.
en.content: The repo contains a CLI tool installable globally or as a project dependency. It generates a local CA, binds port 443, and starts a proxy that routes named URLs to assigned ports, with support for many frameworks and configuration options.
en.stack: Written in TypeScript, distributed via npm, leveraging Node.js ecosystem. Involves HTTPS/HTTP2, proxying, and process management.
en.hot: Gained 450 stars today, total 12052, trending on GitHub. It solves the pain of remembering and conflicting ports, and caters to AI agents needing stable URLs.
uses: Local developers: replace port numbers with memorable named URLs for multiple projects.
AI agent developers: provide stable local endpoints for agents to automate testing and interaction.
Team collaboration: unify dev environment, reduce port conflicts and configuration issues.

zh.tag: 多 AI 编程代理并行编排的桌面与移动工作平台
zh.what: Orca 是一款 Agent Development Environment（ADE），让用户能够并行运行多种主流 AI 编程代理（如 Codex、Claude Code、OpenCode 等），各自在隔离的 git worktree 中执行任务。同时提供移动端伴侣应用，方便用户随时随地监控、接收通知并追加指令。

追求随时随地掌控编码任务的技术团队——通过移动端伴侣应用远程监控代理状态并追加指令
希望统一调度自有 AI 订阅工具的高级用户——将 Codex、Claude Code 等集中在一套桌面环境中管理

en.tag: Parallel AI coding agent orchestrator for desktop and mobile
en.what: Orca is an Agent Development Environment (ADE) that lets developers run a fleet of popular coding agents—such as Codex, Claude Code, and OpenCode—in parallel within isolated git worktrees. It also offers a mobile companion app to monitor progress, receive notifications, and send follow-up instructions from anywhere.

Teams needing on-the-go oversight—monitor and steer agents from the mobile companion app anywhere
Power users with multiple AI subscriptions—unify Codex, Claude Code, and others under one desktop orchestrator
Engineers prioritizing code safety—each agent operates in its own git worktree to avoid polluting the main branch

zh.tag: 让 AI 编程助手直接操控 Chrome 的 MCP 服务器

uses: Developers using AI coding assistants (e.g., Claude, Cursor) to automate browser tasks or debug frontend code
QA or performance engineers needing to analyze page performance, network requests, and console errors
MCP users who want to integrate browser control into custom AI workflows
Developers interested in extending Chrome DevTools automation capabilities

zh.tag: 给设计工程师准备的一套 UI 类 Agent Skills

zh.hot: 把设计判断封装成 AI Agent 可复用技能，这一思路对设计工程师直观易懂，也便于立刻试用。
uses: 前端开发者 —— 让 agent 按设计规范生成和改进 UI，告别「能跑但丑」
设计工程师 —— 把无障碍、metadata、动效性能检查自动化
独立开发者 —— 一人兼顾开发和设计时的品味兜底

en.tag: A set of UI Agent Skills for design engineers
en.what: A UI skill-pack collection from well-known design engineer ibelick: routes your AI coding agent through the right UI skill workflow per task — run npx ui-skills start and the agent picks the appropriate skill set.
en.content: Six skills under skills/: baseline-ui, improve-ui, fixing-accessibility, fixing-metadata, fixing-motion-performance and ui-skills-root; plus bin/ (the CLI entry) and the companion site (Astro on Cloudflare Workers).
en.stack: TypeScript, CLI distributed via npx, MIT; created January 2026, site at ui-skills.com.
en.hot: The idea of packaging design judgment as reusable skills for AI agents is easy for design engineers to understand and immediately test.
uses: Frontend developers — let agents generate and improve UI to design standards, no more 'works but ugly'
Design engineers — automate accessibility, metadata and motion-performance checks
Indie hackers — a taste safety net when you cover both dev and design

zh.tag: 一套核心，多端适配的 AI 编码代理工作流编排引擎
zh.what: AI-DLC Workflows 将 AI 编码代理转化为可验证、自纠错的工程工作流。它基于 AI-DLC 方法论，提供 14 个代理角色（11 个领域专家、2 个审查代理、1 个自适应工作流编排器）和 33 阶段流程，每个关卡需人工批准。
zh.content: 仓库包含一个与工具无关的 core/ 目录，定义方法论；以及针对 Claude Code、Kiro IDE/CLI、Codex CLI、Cursor、opencode、GitHub Copilot 等工具的薄适配层，从单一源生成各工具的分发版本。
zh.stack: 主要语言为 TypeScript；依赖各 AI 编码工具（如 Claude Code、Codex CLI 等）的接口，遵循 AI-DLC 2.0 规范（含白皮书）。
zh.hot: AWS 官方出品，将 AI 代理从单点工具升级为可治理的完整开发生命周期，契合企业级 AI 工程化需求。4.3k stars 且持续增长，登上 TypeScript 趋势榜。
uses: 使用 Claude Code、Cursor 等 AI 编程助手的开发者，希望获得结构化、可审查的开发流程
技术负责人或平台团队，需要统一不同 AI 工具的工作流规范，确保代码质量与合规
对 AI 驱动开发方法论感兴趣的研究者，可参考其 14 代理、33 阶段的编排设计

en.tag: One harness-neutral core, many harnesses: AI agents as verifiable, self-correcting engineering workflows
en.what: AI-DLC Workflows turns AI coding agents into verifiable, self-correcting engineering workflows. Based on the AI-DLC methodology, it provides a 14-agent roster (11 domain experts, 2 review-only agents, and an adaptive-workflows composer) working through a 33-stage workflow with human approval at every gate.
en.content: The repository includes a harness-neutral core/ directory defining the methodology, plus thin adapters for Claude Code, Kiro IDE/CLI, Codex CLI, Cursor, opencode, and GitHub Copilot, generating distributions for each harness from a single source.
en.stack: Primarily TypeScript; interfaces with various AI coding tools (Claude Code, Codex CLI, etc.), following the AI-DLC 2.0 Specification (including whitepaper).
en.hot: Official AWS project that elevates AI agents from point tools to a governed full development lifecycle, meeting enterprise AI engineering needs. 4.3k stars and growing, trending on TypeScript daily.
uses: Developers using AI coding assistants like Claude Code or Cursor who want a structured, reviewable development process
Tech leads or platform teams needing to unify workflow standards across different AI tools for quality and compliance
Researchers interested in AI-driven development methodologies, referencing its 14-agent, 33-stage orchestration design

zh.tag: AI 智能体工具链：统一 LLM API、代理循环、TUI 与编程代理 CLI
zh.what: 提供模块化 AI 代理开发框架，整合多厂商 LLM API、代理运行时与终端交互界面。内置可自扩展的编程代理 CLI，支持工具调用、状态管理与交互式编码任务。
zh.content: 仓库采用 monorepo 结构，包含 pi-ai（统一 LLM 接口）、pi-agent-core（代理运行时）、pi-coding-agent（交互式编码 CLI）和 pi-tui（差分渲染终端 UI）四个核心包。README 还提供了容器化与沙箱隔离方案，以及面向人类和代理的协作规范。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript 构建，使用 npm 管理 monorepo 依赖与生命周期脚本。支持 OpenAI、Anthropic、Google 等主流 LLM 提供商，并可通过 Docker 或 Gondolin micro-VM 进行容器化隔离。
zh.hot: 一周内新增 2,741 Star 使其冲上 TypeScript 周榜第 17 名，目前总 Star 数已突破 7.2 万。开发者对统一 LLM 接口与自扩展编程代理的结合表现出强烈兴趣。
uses: 需要构建多模型 AI 代理的开发者——统一接口降低集成成本
追求终端原生体验的 CLI 用户——内置 TUI 与差分渲染提升交互效率
关注代码安全隔离的团队——提供 Docker、micro-VM 等多种沙箱方案
希望人机与 AI 代理协作的项目维护者——贡献指南同时面向人类与 Agent

en.tag: AI agent toolkit with unified LLM API, agent loop, TUI and coding agent CLI
en.what: A modular AI agent development framework that unifies multi-provider LLM APIs, agent runtime, and terminal UI. It features a self-extensible coding agent CLI with tool calling, state management, and interactive coding capabilities.
en.content: The monorepo houses four core packages: pi-ai (unified LLM API), pi-agent-core (agent runtime), pi-coding-agent (interactive CLI), and pi-tui (diff-rendered terminal UI). It also includes containerization guides and contribution rules for both humans and agents.
en.stack: Built on TypeScript with npm-based monorepo tooling and lifecycle scripts. Supports major LLM providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google) and offers containerization via Docker or Gondolin micro-VM.
en.hot: It gained 2,741 stars this week, landing at #17 on GitHub's TypeScript Weekly Trending with over 72.2k total stars. The combination of a unified LLM API and a self-extensible coding agent has drawn strong developer interest.
uses: Developers building multi-model AI agents — unified API reduces integration overhead
CLI users preferring terminal-native experiences — built-in TUI with diff rendering
Teams requiring secure isolation — supports Docker, micro-VM, and sandbox patterns
Project maintainers enabling human and AI co-contribution — guidelines cover both humans and agents

zh.tag: 将 Claude Code 变成虚拟工程团队的 23 个工具
zh.what: gstack 是 Garry Tan（YC 总裁）公开的 Claude Code 配置集，包含 23 个专业工具和 8 个强力工具，模拟 CEO、设计师、工程经理、发布经理、文档工程师和 QA 等角色。它通过斜杠命令和 Markdown 文件，将 AI 编码助手扩展为完整的软件工厂。
zh.content: 仓库包含工具定义（Markdown 格式）、配置示例、使用文档，以及关于 LOC 争议的详细方法论和复现脚本。所有工具均为斜杠命令，MIT 许可。
zh.stack: 基于 Claude Code，使用 TypeScript 编写，依赖 Markdown 和斜杠命令，无额外运行时。
zh.hot: 该仓库在短时间内获得 13 万+ star，因其来自 YC 总裁的实战配置，展示了 AI 代理如何将个人生产力提升数百倍，引发广泛讨论。
uses: 希望用 AI 代理实现一人团队效率的独立开发者或创业者。
对 Claude Code 高级用法和自定义工具感兴趣的 AI 工程师。
关注 AI 编程生产力争议，想了解 LOC 方法论的研究者。

en.tag: 23 opinionated tools turning Claude Code into a virtual engineering team
en.what: gstack is Garry Tan's (YC CEO) public Claude Code setup with 23 specialist tools and 8 power tools, simulating roles like CEO, designer, eng manager, release manager, doc engineer, and QA. It extends the AI coding assistant into a full software factory via slash commands and Markdown.
en.content: The repo contains tool definitions (Markdown), configuration examples, usage docs, and a detailed methodology with reproduction script on the LOC controversy. All tools are slash commands, MIT licensed.
en.stack: Built on Claude Code, written in TypeScript, relies on Markdown and slash commands, no extra runtime.
en.hot: The repo amassed 130K+ stars quickly, thanks to YC CEO's battle-tested config showing how AI agents boost individual productivity by hundreds of times, sparking wide debate.
uses: Indie developers or founders aiming for one-person team efficiency with AI agents.
AI engineers interested in advanced Claude Code usage and custom tools.
Researchers following the AI coding productivity debate and LOC methodology.

zh.tag: 自托管会话回放与产品分析平台
zh.what: OpenReplay 是一个开源的会话回放套件，可自托管，让你看到用户在 Web 应用上的操作，帮助更快排查问题。它不仅能回放用户行为，还能捕获网络活动、控制台日志、JS 错误、状态管理等底层细节。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的平台代码，包括前端、后端、追踪器（约 26KB）以及部署脚本，支持 AWS、GCP、Azure 和 DigitalOcean。还提供 Chrome 扩展 Spot 用于录制 bug，以及 Assist 功能支持实时查看和 WebRTC 通话。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript，后端可能涉及 Go 和 Python，前端使用 React 等。依赖包括 Kafka、PostgreSQL、ClickHouse 等用于数据处理和存储。
zh.hot: 作为自托管会话回放工具，它解决了数据隐私和合规问题，同时提供丰富的功能。12.6k 星且持续增长，今日新增 30 星，位列 TypeScript 日榜第 10，说明开发者对开源替代品需求旺盛。
uses: 产品团队：用于复现用户问题，理解用户行为，优化产品体验。
开发人员：通过技术细节（网络、控制台、状态）快速调试和修复 bug。
注重隐私的企业：需要自托管解决方案以完全控制用户数据，避免第三方处理。
客户支持：使用 Assist 功能实时查看用户屏幕并协助解决问题。

en.tag: Self-hosted session replay and product analytics platform
en.what: OpenReplay is an open-source session replay suite you can host yourself, letting you see what users do on your web app to troubleshoot issues faster. It replays user actions and also captures under-the-hood details like network activity, console logs, JS errors, and state management.
en.content: The repository contains the full platform code including frontend, backend, tracker (~26KB), and deployment scripts for AWS, GCP, Azure, and DigitalOcean. It also includes a Chrome extension Spot for recording bugs and Assist for live view and WebRTC calls.
en.stack: Primarily TypeScript, with backend possibly in Go and Python, frontend using React. Dependencies include Kafka, PostgreSQL, ClickHouse for data processing and storage.
en.hot: As a self-hosted session replay tool, it addresses data privacy and compliance while offering rich features. With 12.6k stars and steady growth (30 today), ranking #10 on TypeScript daily, it shows strong demand for open-source alternatives.
uses: Product teams: to reproduce user issues, understand behavior, and improve UX.
Developers: to debug and fix bugs quickly with technical details (network, console, state).
Privacy-conscious companies: needing self-hosted solutions for full data control and no third-party processing.
Customer support: using Assist to view live screens and assist users in real-time.

zh.tag: 自托管 WhatsApp API 网关，开源免费可插拔
zh.what: OpenWA 是一个免费开源的 WhatsApp API 网关，让开发者完全掌控消息基础设施，避免供应商锁定和隐藏费用。它支持多会话并发、提供完整的管理面板，并可通过配置切换数据库、存储和缓存等组件。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心网关服务、基于 React 的管理面板、Docker 部署配置、官方插件（如 Chatwoot、Typebot）以及社区适配器。还提供详细的文档和 API 示例。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript 和 NestJS 构建，支持 Node.js 22 LTS，使用 SQLite/PostgreSQL 作为数据库，可选 Redis 缓存，并通过 Docker 实现零配置部署。
zh.hot: 凭借 13.5k+ 星标和日增 54 星，OpenWA 因提供免费开源的 WhatsApp API 替代方案而受到关注，其可插拔架构和官方插件生态吸引了大量开发者。
uses: 开发者需要自托管 WhatsApp 消息服务，避免依赖商业 API 提供商。
团队希望集成 WhatsApp 到现有工作流，如通过 n8n 或 Chatwoot 实现自动化客服。
对数据隐私和控制有高要求的企业，希望完全掌控消息数据和基础设施。

en.tag: Self-hosted, open-source WhatsApp API gateway with pluggable architecture
en.what: OpenWA is a free, open-source WhatsApp API gateway that gives developers full control over their messaging infrastructure without vendor lock-in or hidden costs. It supports multiple concurrent sessions, offers a full dashboard, and allows swapping database, storage, and cache components via configuration.
en.content: The repository includes the core gateway service, a React-based dashboard, Docker deployment configs, official plugins (e.g., Chatwoot, Typebot), and community adapters. It also provides extensive documentation and API examples.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript and NestJS, supports Node.js 22 LTS, uses SQLite/PostgreSQL for database, optional Redis cache, and Docker for zero-config deployment.
en.hot: With 13.5k+ stars and 54 new stars today, OpenWA gains traction as a free, open-source WhatsApp API alternative, attracting developers with its pluggable architecture and official plugin ecosystem.
uses: Developers needing a self-hosted WhatsApp messaging service to avoid reliance on commercial API providers.
Teams looking to integrate WhatsApp into existing workflows, such as automation with n8n or customer support via Chatwoot.
Enterprises with high data privacy and control requirements, wanting full ownership of message data and infrastructure.

zh.tag: 无限画布上的终端与AI代理管理器
zh.what: nodeterm 是一个基于节点的终端管理器，将多个真实终端作为可拖拽节点放在无限平移/缩放画布上，支持 macOS、Linux 和浏览器服务器版。它专为 AI 编码代理设计，每个项目可变成 Trello 风格的看板，实时管理 Claude Code 会话。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Electron 桌面应用源码（macOS/Linux/Windows beta）、自托管浏览器服务器版、文档与演示视频。核心是画布界面、终端节点、代理会话看板及服务层架构。
zh.stack: 基于 Electron 和 TypeScript 构建，使用 tmux 作为终端后端，支持 Claude Code 等 AI 代理集成。跨平台打包为 .dmg、.AppImage、.deb 和 .exe。
zh.hot: 今日新增 234 星，总星数 1692，登上 GitHub Trending TypeScript 日榜第 12 名。其空间化布局替代传统标签页，契合 ADHD 人群和分散工作流的需求，且支持 AI 代理并行会话，解决开发者痛点。
uses: 适合 ADHD 或工作流分散的开发者，用空间画布管理多个终端和任务，避免上下文丢失。
AI 编码代理用户，可在看板式界面中并行运行和监控多个 Claude Code 会话。
需要跨设备访问终端环境的团队，可通过浏览器服务器版从任何地方连接。

en.tag: Node-based terminal manager for AI coding agents on an infinite canvas
en.what: nodeterm is a node-based terminal manager that places multiple real terminals as draggable nodes on an infinite pan/zoom canvas, supporting macOS, Linux, and a browser Server Edition. Built for AI coding agents, it turns every project into a Trello-style board of live Claude Code sessions.
en.content: The repository contains the Electron desktop app source (macOS/Linux/Windows beta), a self-hosted browser Server Edition, docs, and demo videos. Core features include the canvas UI, terminal nodes, agent session kanban, and a clean service seam architecture.
en.stack: Built with Electron and TypeScript, using tmux as the terminal backend, with integrations for AI agents like Claude Code. Packaged cross-platform as .dmg, .AppImage, .deb, and .exe.
en.hot: Gained 234 stars today, reaching 1692 total, and ranked #12 on GitHub Trending TypeScript daily. Its spatial layout replaces hidden tabs, appealing to ADHD users and scattered workflows, while supporting parallel AI agent sessions, addressing developer pain points.
uses: For developers with ADHD or scattered workflows who need a spatial canvas to manage multiple terminals and tasks without losing context.
For AI coding agent users who want to run and monitor multiple Claude Code sessions in parallel on a kanban-style board.
For teams needing remote terminal access, using the browser Server Edition to connect from anywhere.

zh.tag: 为 AI 代理打造的市场营销技能库
zh.what: 这是一个为 AI 代理（如 Claude Code）设计的营销技能集合，涵盖转化率优化、文案写作、SEO、分析和增长工程。它帮助技术营销人员和创始人利用 AI 编码代理自动执行营销任务，并遵循 Agent Skills 规范。
zh.content: 仓库包含多个 Markdown 格式的技能文件，每个技能提供特定营销任务的框架和最佳实践。技能之间相互引用，以 product-marketing 为基础，其他技能先读取它来了解产品、受众和定位。
zh.stack: 主要使用 JavaScript 编写，但核心是 Markdown 技能文件。兼容支持 Agent Skills 规范的代理，如 Claude Code、OpenAI Codex、Cursor 等。
zh.hot: 星标数达 4.6 万，今日新增 154，登上 JavaScript 日榜。它填补了 AI 代理在营销领域的空白，将营销专业知识结构化，让 AI 代理能直接应用，因此受到技术营销者和创始人的追捧。
uses: 技术营销人员：希望利用 AI 代理自动执行营销任务，提升效率。
创始人：需要 AI 辅助进行转化优化、文案和 SEO，以驱动增长。
AI 代理开发者：希望集成营销技能到自己的代理中，扩展功能。

en.tag: Marketing skills library for AI agents
en.what: A collection of AI agent skills for marketing tasks, including CRO, copywriting, SEO, analytics, and growth engineering. It enables technical marketers and founders to leverage AI coding agents for marketing automation, following the Agent Skills spec.
en.content: The repo contains multiple Markdown skill files, each providing frameworks and best practices for specific marketing tasks. Skills reference each other, with product-marketing as the foundation that others read first to understand product, audience, and positioning.
en.stack: Primarily JavaScript, but the core is Markdown skill files. Compatible with agents supporting the Agent Skills spec, such as Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Cursor, and others.
en.hot: With 46k stars and 154 new today, it hit the JavaScript daily trending. It fills a gap by structuring marketing expertise for AI agents, making it directly applicable, thus attracting technical marketers and founders.
uses: Technical marketers: want to automate marketing tasks with AI agents for efficiency.
Founders: need AI assistance for CRO, copywriting, and SEO to drive growth.
AI agent developers: integrate marketing skills into their agents to extend capabilities.

zh.tag: GitHub Copilot 定制资源大全，含代理、技能与插件
zh.what: 这是一个社区驱动的精选资源库，汇集了用于定制 GitHub Copilot 的各类指令、代理、技能、钩子、工作流和插件。它帮助用户通过安装插件或使用文档来增强 Copilot 的功能，并提供了配套网站支持全文搜索和过滤。
zh.content: 仓库按资源类型分目录组织，包括 agents、instructions、skills、plugins 和 cookbook，每个目录都有对应的 README 文档。还提供了 llms.txt 供 AI 代理使用，以及学习中心链接。
zh.stack: 主要语言为 JavaScript，但内容本身是 Markdown 文档和配置，依赖 GitHub Copilot 生态，支持通过 CLI 安装插件。
zh.hot: 随着 GitHub Copilot 的普及和定制需求的增长，该仓库成为一站式资源中心，star 数已达 3.8 万，今日新增 49，位列 JavaScript 趋势榜第五。
uses: 希望扩展 Copilot 功能的开发者，可快速安装现成插件。
需要为团队制定编码规范或自动化工作流的工程管理者。
对 AI 编程代理和 MCP 集成感兴趣的技术爱好者。
想要学习 Copilot 定制技巧的初学者，可借助学习中心。

en.tag: A curated collection of agents, skills, plugins, and instructions to supercharge GitHub Copilot
en.what: A community-driven curated collection of instructions, agents, skills, hooks, workflows, and plugins to customize GitHub Copilot. It helps users enhance Copilot by installing plugins or using documentation, with a companion website offering full-text search and filtering.
en.content: The repo is organized by resource type into directories: agents, instructions, skills, plugins, and cookbook, each with corresponding README docs. It also provides an llms.txt for AI agents and links to a Learning Hub.
en.stack: Primary language is JavaScript, but the content is Markdown docs and configs, relying on the GitHub Copilot ecosystem, with plugin installation via CLI.
en.hot: With the rise of GitHub Copilot and customization demand, this repo serves as a one-stop resource hub, amassing 38.6k stars with 49 new today, ranking #5 on the JavaScript trending list.
uses: Developers seeking to extend Copilot with ready-made plugins for immediate use.
Engineering managers needing to enforce coding standards or automate workflows.
Tech enthusiasts interested in AI coding agents and MCP integrations.
Beginners wanting to learn Copilot customization via the Learning Hub.

zh.tag: AI 构建者情报摘要，对话式订阅推送
zh.what: 这是一个 AI 驱动的摘要工具，跟踪 X 和 YouTube 上顶级 AI 构建者（研究者、创始人、PM、工程师）的动态，将播客、推文和博客文章提炼成简洁摘要，并通过 Telegram、Discord 或邮件等渠道定期推送。
zh.content: 仓库包含一个技能（skill），可安装到 OpenClaw 或 Claude Code 中，通过对话引导用户设置推送频率、语言和渠道。内含提示词文件夹（prompts/）用于定制摘要风格，以及默认的播客和 X 账号源列表。
zh.stack: 主要语言为 JavaScript，依赖代理框架（如 OpenClaw/Claude Code）来运行技能，内容获取由中心化服务处理，无需用户提供 API 密钥。
zh.hot: 该仓库今日新增 53 星，总星数 6608，登上 GitHub 趋势榜（JavaScript）第 6 名。其理念“关注构建者而非网红”契合 AI 社区对高质量原始内容的需求，且设置简单、支持多语言，迅速获得关注。
uses: AI 从业者（研究者、工程师、PM）希望高效跟踪领域内顶级构建者的最新观点和动态。
对播客和 X 内容感兴趣但时间有限，需要每日/每周精华摘要的忙碌人士。
偏好中文或双语阅读，希望将英文 AI 内容自动翻译成中文的用户。
使用 Claude Code 或 OpenClaw 等代理工具，希望扩展技能以获取定制化信息流的用户。

en.tag: AI builders digest, conversational setup, daily/weekly summaries
en.what: An AI-powered digest that tracks top AI builders on X and YouTube podcasts, summarizing their content into concise digests delivered via messaging apps like Telegram, Discord, or email.
en.content: Contains a skill installable into OpenClaw or Claude Code, guiding users through conversational setup. Includes a prompts/ folder for customizing summary styles, plus default lists of podcasts and X accounts.
en.stack: Primarily JavaScript, relies on agent frameworks like OpenClaw or Claude Code to run the skill. Content fetching is centralized, requiring no user API keys.
en.hot: Gained 53 stars today, total 6608, ranking #6 on GitHub Trending (JavaScript). Its philosophy of 'follow builders, not influencers' resonates with the AI community's demand for high-quality original content, and its easy setup with multilingual support has quickly attracted attention.
uses: AI practitioners (researchers, engineers, PMs) who want to efficiently track top builders' latest insights and activities.
Busy individuals interested in podcasts and X content but with limited time, needing daily or weekly digests.
Users preferring Chinese or bilingual reading, wanting automatic translation of English AI content.
Users of agent tools like Claude Code or OpenClaw who want to extend skills for customized information feeds.

zh.tag: 隐私优先的跨平台语音转文字听写应用
zh.what: OpenWhispr 是一款开源的语音转文字听写应用，支持本地离线模型（如 Whisper、NVIDIA Parakeet）和云端模型（自带密钥），确保音频数据不离开设备。它提供热键唤起、光标处插入文本、会议转录和笔记功能，是 WisprFlow 和 Granola 的免费替代品。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的桌面应用源码，覆盖 macOS、Windows 和 Linux 平台，提供安装包（DMG、EXE、AppImage 等）。项目包含前端界面、语音引擎集成、系统托盘、热键监听等模块，并配有文档和 API 参考。
zh.stack: 主要使用 JavaScript，可能基于 Electron 或类似框架构建跨平台桌面应用。语音识别依赖本地引擎（如 Whisper、NVIDIA Parakeet）和 ONNX Runtime，支持云端 API 集成。
zh.hot: 凭借隐私优先和跨平台特性，在 GitHub 上迅速走红，已获近 6000 星，今日新增 50 星，位列 JavaScript 日榜第五。作为商业产品的开源替代，吸引了大量关注。
uses: 需要高效语音输入的文字工作者，如记者、作家、程序员，可用热键快速听写。
注重隐私的用户，希望在本地完成语音转文字，避免音频上传云端。
经常开会的人士，利用会议转录功能自动生成笔记和行动项。
开发者或技术爱好者，可自定义模型或集成自有 API 密钥。

en.tag: Privacy-first cross-platform voice-to-text dictation app
en.what: OpenWhispr is an open-source voice-to-text dictation app supporting local offline models (e.g., Whisper, NVIDIA Parakeet) and cloud models (bring your own key), ensuring audio data never leaves the device. It offers hotkey activation, text insertion at cursor, meeting transcription, and note-taking, serving as a free alternative to WisprFlow and Granola.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code of the desktop app, covering macOS, Windows, and Linux, with installers (DMG, EXE, AppImage, etc.). It includes frontend UI, speech engine integration, system tray, hotkey listener, and is accompanied by docs and API reference.
en.stack: Primarily JavaScript, likely built with Electron or similar cross-platform framework. Speech recognition relies on local engines (e.g., Whisper, NVIDIA Parakeet) and ONNX Runtime, with cloud API integration.
en.hot: Rapidly gaining popularity on GitHub due to privacy-first and cross-platform features, amassing nearly 6k stars with 50 new stars today, ranking 5th on the JavaScript daily trending. As an open-source alternative to commercial products, it attracts significant attention.
uses: For writers, journalists, and programmers who need efficient voice input with hotkey dictation.
For privacy-conscious users who want on-device speech-to-text without uploading audio to the cloud.
For frequent meeting attendees who use transcription to auto-generate notes and action items.
For developers and tech enthusiasts who can customize models or integrate their own API keys.

zh.tag: 为 AI 编码代理打造的设计语言与技能集，终结千篇一律的 SaaS 模板风
zh.what: Impeccable 是一套面向 AI 编码代理（如 Claude、Cursor 等）的设计指导语言与 CLI 工具。它通过 23 条标准化命令和 46 条确定性检测规则，帮助 AI 在生成前端界面时摆脱千篇一律的 SaaS 模板风格，产出更具品牌感与专业度的设计。开发者只需在项目中运行初始化命令，即可建立包含品牌语境、视觉规范与组件库的设计上下文。
zh.content: 仓库包含可安装在 AI 工具中的核心技能包、用于本地检测的 CLI 与浏览器扩展，以及一套由 PRODUCT.md 和 DESIGN.md 驱动的设计上下文系统。整体以命令式交互为主，支持实时浏览器迭代与无需 LLM 的离线规则检测。
zh.stack: 基于 JavaScript/Node.js 构建，通过 npm 分发并以 npx 方式安装，同时提供浏览器扩展用于实时迭代检测。设计规则以确定性逻辑实现，可独立于 LLM 运行。
zh.hot: 该仓库在 GitHub 上已获得 47.7K Star，本周新增 2,331 星并跻身 Trending 周榜第 14 名，反映出开发者对「AI 生成前端同质化」的强烈痛点共鸣。它精准击中了当前 AI 编码工具产出界面千篇一律的普遍问题，提供了可落地的设计工程化方案。
uses: 前端开发者 —— 希望让 AI 助手生成更专业、不千篇一律的界面代码
独立创始人/产品经理 —— 需要快速建立品牌感强、视觉一致的产品界面
设计工程师 —— 想将设计规范转化为 AI 可执行的确定性规则与检测流程

en.tag: A design language and skillset for AI coding agents to escape generic SaaS templates
en.what: Impeccable is a design guidance language and CLI tool for AI coding agents like Claude and Cursor. It provides 23 standardized commands and 46 deterministic detection rules to help AI-generated frontend designs break away from generic SaaS templates and achieve stronger brand identity. Developers can set up a comprehensive design context—including brand voice, visual guidelines, and component libraries—through a single initialization command.
en.content: The repository includes a core skill package for AI tools, a CLI and browser extension for local auditing, and a design context system driven by PRODUCT.md and DESIGN.md. It focuses on command-based interactions, supporting live browser iteration and offline deterministic rule checks without requiring an LLM or API key.
en.stack: Built on JavaScript/Node.js, distributed via npm and installed through npx, with a browser extension for real-time iteration and auditing. The design rules are implemented as deterministic logic that can run independently of any LLM or API key.
en.hot: With 47.7K stars and 2,331 new stars this week landing it at #14 on GitHub Trending, the project resonates strongly with developers frustrated by homogenized AI-generated frontend designs. It directly addresses the pain point of repetitive SaaS templates by offering a practical, engineering-grade design system for AI agents.
uses: Frontend developers who want their AI assistants to generate professional, non-generic UI code
Indie founders and product managers looking to quickly build brand-conscious, visually consistent interfaces
Design engineers seeking to convert design specifications into deterministic, AI-executable rules and audit workflows

zh.tag: 各大 AI 聊天机器人系统提示词泄露合集
zh.what: 该仓库收集并整理了 ChatGPT、Claude、Gemini、Grok 等主流 AI 聊天机器人的系统提示词原文，这些隐藏指令在用户发送第一条消息前就已生效。项目持续更新，并已被华盛顿邮报等媒体用于报道。
zh.content: 仓库按公司分类存放各模型的系统提示词 Markdown 文件，例如 Anthropic 的 Claude Fable 5.1、OpenAI 的 GPT-5.6、Google 的 Gemini 3.7 Flash 等，并附有最近更新列表和外部报道链接。
zh.stack: 主要使用 JavaScript 编写，仓库本身为纯文档集合，无复杂依赖，通过 GitHub 托管。
zh.hot: 凭借 64k+ 星标和每日新增 80 星的火爆程度，它满足了人们对 AI 内部机制的好奇心，并因媒体引用而备受关注。
uses: AI 研究者与开发者：研究主流模型的行为准则与安全机制
普通用户与爱好者：了解 AI 聊天机器人背后的隐藏规则
记者与内容创作者：引用真实系统提示词撰写报道或分析

en.tag: A collection of leaked system prompts from major AI chatbots
en.what: This repository collects and organizes verbatim system prompts from major AI chatbots like ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Grok—the hidden instructions that govern AI behavior before user interaction. It is regularly updated and has been cited by media outlets like The Washington Post.
en.content: The repo contains Markdown files of system prompts organized by company, such as Anthropic's Claude Fable 5.1, OpenAI's GPT-5.6, and Google's Gemini 3.7 Flash, along with a recent additions table and links to external coverage.
en.stack: Primarily JavaScript-based, but the repo is essentially a collection of Markdown documents with no complex dependencies, hosted on GitHub.
en.hot: With over 64k stars and ~80 new stars daily, it satisfies public curiosity about AI's inner workings and gains attention through media citations.
uses: AI researchers and developers: study behavioral guidelines and safety mechanisms of mainstream models
General users and enthusiasts: understand hidden rules behind AI chatbots
Journalists and content creators: cite real system prompts for reporting or analysis

zh.tag: 为雄心勃勃的UI而生的样式系统
zh.what: StyleX 是 Facebook 开源的 JavaScript 样式系统，旨在为大型应用提供高性能、可扩展且类型安全的样式解决方案。它通过编译时优化和原子 CSS 生成，减少运行时开销，同时保持开发体验的简洁性。
zh.content: 仓库是一个 monorepo，包含核心包 @stylexjs/stylex、Babel 插件、ESLint 插件、PostCSS 插件、Rollup 插件、CLI、文档和示例等。
zh.stack: 主要使用 JavaScript，基于 Babel 插件实现编译时转换，支持与 React 等框架集成。
zh.hot: 作为 Facebook 官方出品，StyleX 旨在解决大型应用的样式性能问题，star 数已过万，今日新增 49，位列 JavaScript 趋势榜第 10，受到前端社区广泛关注。
uses: 大型 React 应用开发者，希望提升样式性能并简化样式管理
对原子 CSS 和编译时优化感兴趣的前端工程师
需要类型安全样式方案的团队，可结合 TypeScript 使用

en.tag: The styling system for ambitious user interfaces
en.what: StyleX is Facebook's open-source JavaScript styling system designed to provide a high-performance, scalable, and type-safe styling solution for large applications. It reduces runtime overhead through compile-time optimization and atomic CSS generation while maintaining a simple developer experience.
en.content: The repository is a monorepo containing the core package @stylexjs/stylex, Babel plugin, ESLint plugin, PostCSS plugin, Rollup plugin, CLI, docs, and examples.
en.stack: Primarily JavaScript, uses Babel plugin for compile-time transformation, integrates with React and other frameworks.
en.hot: As an official Facebook project, StyleX aims to solve styling performance issues in large applications. With over 10k stars and 49 new stars today, it ranks 10th on the JavaScript trending list, attracting wide attention from the frontend community.
uses: Developers of large React applications seeking to improve styling performance and simplify style management
Frontend engineers interested in atomic CSS and compile-time optimization
Teams needing type-safe styling solutions, usable with TypeScript

zh.tag: Codex 插件官方示例集，含 Figma、Notion 等丰富案例
zh.what: 这是 OpenAI 官方维护的 Codex 插件示例仓库，每个插件包含清单文件及可选配套资源，用于扩展 Codex 的功能。仓库提供了多个高质量示例，涵盖设计、项目管理、应用开发等场景。
zh.content: 仓库按 plugins/<name>/ 组织，包含 .codex-plugin/plugin.json 清单，以及 skills/、agents/、commands/ 等可选目录；默认市场指向 plugins/，另有 API 用户专用市场。
zh.stack: 主要使用 JavaScript，插件基于 JSON 清单和 MCP 协议，涉及 SwiftUI、React Native 等生态。
zh.hot: 作为 OpenAI 官方示例，为开发者提供即用型插件模板，star 数达 5.3k，日增 16，位列日榜第 10，吸引大量关注。
uses: 希望扩展 Codex 功能的开发者，可参考官方示例快速上手
需要 Figma 设计稿转代码或 Notion 项目管理集成的工作流
构建 iOS、macOS、Web 或 React Native 应用的开发者，可复用插件模板

en.tag: Official Codex plugin examples with rich cases like Figma and Notion
en.what: This is OpenAI's official repository of Codex plugin examples. Each plugin includes a manifest file and optional companion surfaces to extend Codex's capabilities. It provides high-quality examples for design, project management, app development, and more.
en.content: The repo is organized under plugins/<name>/ with a required .codex-plugin/plugin.json manifest and optional directories like skills/, agents/, commands/; the default marketplace points to plugins/, with a separate one for API users.
en.stack: Primarily JavaScript, plugins use JSON manifests and MCP protocol, involving ecosystems like SwiftUI and React Native.
en.hot: As official OpenAI examples, it offers ready-to-use plugin templates, with 5.3k stars and +16 today, ranking #10 on the daily chart, attracting significant attention.
uses: Developers looking to extend Codex can quickly get started with official examples
Workflows needing Figma design-to-code or Notion project management integration
Developers building iOS, macOS, web, or React Native apps can reuse plugin templates

zh.tag: 开源 Loom 替代品，美观可分享的屏幕录制工具
zh.what: Cap 是一款开源的屏幕录制工具，旨在替代 Loom。它提供快速录制、本地编辑、即时分享链接、评论、字幕、分析、团队工作区等功能，并支持自定义域名、S3 存储和完全自托管。
zh.content: 仓库包含桌面应用（macOS/Windows）、Web 仪表盘、编辑器等组件，支持即时模式和工作室模式两种录制方式。
zh.stack: 桌面应用使用 Rust 和 Tauri 构建，前端可能涉及 Web 技术，支持 S3 兼容存储。
zh.hot: 作为 Loom 的开源替代品，Cap 提供数据所有权和自托管选项，吸引了大量关注，今日新增 121 星，总星数超过 2.1 万。
uses: 产品演示、教程和客户更新等需要屏幕录制的场景
团队异步协作，如代码审查、设计反馈和异步站会
注重数据隐私和自托管的企业用户

en.tag: Open source Loom alternative for beautiful, shareable screen recordings
en.what: Cap is an open-source screen recording tool designed as a Loom alternative. It offers fast recording, polished local editing, instant share links, comments, transcripts, analytics, team workspaces, custom domains, custom S3 storage, and full self-hosting.
en.content: The repository includes desktop apps for macOS/Windows, a web dashboard, and an editor, supporting both Instant Mode and Studio Mode for recording.
en.stack: Desktop apps are built with Rust and Tauri, frontend likely uses web technologies, and it supports S3-compatible storage.
en.hot: As an open-source Loom alternative, Cap attracts attention with data ownership and self-hosting options, gaining 121 stars today and over 21k total.
uses: For product demos, tutorials, and client updates requiring screen recordings
For async team collaboration like code reviews, design feedback, and async standups
For enterprises prioritizing data privacy and self-hosting

zh.tag: 为编码智能体打造的版本控制与协作平台
zh.what: Atlas 是面向编码智能体的源代码控制工具，将每次智能体运行与提交关联，记录提示、工具调用和推理过程。它支持并行运行多个智能体（如 Claude Code、Codex 等），共享记忆和知识，实现无缝切换与协作。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 实现的核心引擎、命令行工具、文档、以及用于展示的 banner 等资源。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 语言开发，依赖 ACP（Agent Client Protocol）注册表，可能涉及本地文件系统与 Markdown 处理。
zh.hot: 今日新增 419 星，总星数达 3132，在 GitHub Trending 日榜（Rust）排名第二。随着多智能体协作开发兴起，开发者急需此类工具来管理和追踪智能体行为，Atlas 填补了这一空白。
uses: 使用多个编码智能体（如 Claude Code、Codex）的开发者，希望统一管理和追踪它们的变更。
需要跨智能体共享上下文和记忆的团队，避免重复工作，提升协作效率。
对智能体行为进行审计和回溯的工程师，要求每次提交都有详细解释。

en.tag: Source control for coding agents: track, query, and collaborate across agents
en.what: Atlas is source control for coding agents, linking every commit to the session that produced it, including prompts, tool calls, and reasoning. It enables running multiple agents side-by-side with shared memory, so switching agents mid-task doesn't mean starting over.
en.content: The repository contains the Rust-based core engine, CLI tools, documentation, and assets like banners for presentation.
en.stack: Primarily built with Rust, leveraging the ACP (Agent Client Protocol) registry, and likely involving local file system and Markdown processing.
en.hot: With 419 stars added today and a total of 3132, it ranks #2 on GitHub Trending (Rust) daily. As multi-agent collaborative development rises, developers need tools to manage and track agent actions, and Atlas fills this gap.
uses: Developers using multiple coding agents (e.g., Claude Code, Codex) who want to manage and track their changes in one place.
Teams needing to share context and memory across agents to avoid redundant work and boost collaboration.
Engineers auditing agent behavior, requiring detailed explanations for every commit.

zh.tag: 开源远程桌面，自托管替代 TeamViewer
zh.what: RustDesk 是一款用 Rust 编写的开源远程桌面软件，开箱即用，无需配置。它允许用户完全控制自己的数据，支持自建中继/中转服务器，是 TeamViewer 的隐私友好替代品。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的客户端和服务器端代码，支持 Windows、macOS、Linux、Android、iOS 等多平台。提供二进制下载、Docker 构建方式，以及多语言翻译文件。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 语言，依赖 Flutter 用于跨平台 UI，使用 Sciter 或原生 GUI。服务器端基于 Rust 的异步网络框架。
zh.hot: 拥有 119k+ Stars，今日新增 121，因其完全开源、自托管、隐私安全且性能优异，成为 TeamViewer 等商业软件的热门替代。
uses: 个人用户：需要安全远程访问家庭或办公电脑
企业 IT：自建远程支持平台，保障数据隐私
开发者：定制远程桌面功能或集成到自有系统

en.tag: Open-source remote desktop, self-hosted alternative to TeamViewer
en.what: RustDesk is an open-source remote desktop application written in Rust, working out of the box with no configuration. It gives users full control over their data and supports self-hosted rendezvous/relay servers, serving as a privacy-friendly alternative to TeamViewer.
en.content: The repository contains full client and server code, supporting Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, iOS, and more. It offers binary downloads, Docker build instructions, and multilingual translation files.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, with Flutter for cross-platform UI and Sciter or native GUI. The server side uses Rust's async networking framework.
en.hot: With 119k+ stars and 121 new today, it's a hot alternative to commercial software like TeamViewer due to its fully open-source, self-hosted, privacy-focused, and high-performance nature.
uses: Individual users: secure remote access to home or office computers
Enterprise IT: self-hosted remote support platform with data privacy
Developers: customize remote desktop features or integrate into own systems

zh.tag: 超快 Rust PDF 检测与文本提取库
zh.what: pdf-inspector 是一个用 Rust 编写的高性能 PDF 处理库，能快速检测 PDF 是扫描版还是文本版，并提取带位置信息的文本，转换为干净的 Markdown。它内置智能分类功能，可在几十毫秒内判断 PDF 类型，并支持选择性 OCR，从而避免不必要的昂贵 OCR 服务。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 核心库、Python/Node.js 绑定、浏览器 WebAssembly 版本，以及 CLI 工具。提供文本提取、Markdown 转换、表格检测、多栏布局处理、CID 字体支持等功能。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust，依赖 PDFium 和 ONNX Runtime（用于 OCR），支持 Python、Node.js 和 WebAssembly。OCR 集成使用 PP-OCRv6 Small 模型。
zh.hot: 本月新增 15341 星，总星数达 17007，位居 GitHub 趋势榜第二。其极快的速度和智能分类能力解决了 PDF 处理中的痛点，且由 Firecrawl 团队开发，信誉度高。
uses: 开发者需要快速将 PDF 转换为 Markdown 或提取文本，用于 RAG 或数据管道。
处理大量 PDF 的文档管理系统，需要区分扫描件和文本件以优化流程。
需要本地化、低延迟 PDF 解析的浏览器应用或边缘计算场景。

en.tag: Ultra-fast Rust library for PDF inspection and text extraction
en.what: pdf-inspector is a high-performance Rust library for PDF processing that quickly detects whether a PDF is scanned or text-based, extracts position-aware text, and converts it to clean Markdown. It features smart classification in tens of milliseconds and supports selective OCR to avoid unnecessary expensive OCR services.
en.content: The repo contains the Rust core library, Python/Node.js bindings, browser WebAssembly build, and a CLI tool. It offers text extraction, Markdown conversion, table detection, multi-column layout handling, CID font support, and more.
en.stack: Primarily Rust, with PDFium and ONNX Runtime for OCR, and bindings for Python, Node.js, and WebAssembly. OCR uses PP-OCRv6 Small model.
en.hot: Gained 15,341 stars this month, reaching 17,007 total, ranking #2 on GitHub Trending. Its blazing speed and smart classification solve a common pain point, backed by the reputable Firecrawl team.
uses: Developers needing fast PDF-to-Markdown conversion or text extraction for RAG or data pipelines.
Document management systems processing large volumes of PDFs, needing to distinguish scanned vs text-based for workflow optimization.
Browser or edge applications requiring local, low-latency PDF parsing without server round trips.

zh.tag: X 平台 For You 信息流核心算法开源
zh.what: 该仓库包含 X（原 Twitter）For You 信息流中决定用户看到哪些帖子的核心代码。它结合用户关注的内容（网络内）和通过机器学习检索发现的内容（网络外），经过过滤和排序后，使用 Transformer 模型对帖子进行排名。
zh.content: 仓库包含系统架构文档、请求路径和标注路径说明，以及多个组件目录，如 home-mixer（含评分器、过滤器、参数）、可见性过滤、模型训练代码和合成数据生成代码。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编写，涉及机器学习模型（如 Transformer）、参数配置、过滤逻辑和实验框架。依赖包括用于模型训练的 Phoenix 模型相关代码。
zh.hot: 作为 X 平台核心算法的开源实现，吸引了大量关注，GitHub 星标超过 3.2 万，月榜第 11 名。其透明化举措和近期更新（如巴西选举过滤）引发热议。
uses: 对推荐系统、信息流排序感兴趣的开发者，可研究其架构和实现细节。
希望了解 X 平台内容过滤和排名机制的研究者或记者。
需要参考大规模生产级算法工程实践的工程师。

en.tag: Open-source core algorithm powering X's For You feed
en.what: This repository contains the core code that determines which posts a viewer sees in the For You feed on X. It combines in-network content from followed accounts with out-of-network content discovered via ML-based retrieval, filters based on various inputs, and ranks posts using a transformer model.

Engineers seeking reference for large-scale production-grade algorithm engineering practices.

en.tag: CLI proxy that cuts LLM token usage by 60-90% on dev commands

en.content: The repo contains Rust source code, documentation (multi-language READMEs), architecture docs, installation scripts, and CI config. The core is a single Rust binary with zero dependencies, installable via Homebrew or prebuilt binaries.
en.stack: Pure Rust implementation with zero dependencies, leveraging Rust's performance and memory safety. Cross-platform (Linux, macOS, Windows), integrated via shell hooks or command wrapping.
en.hot: Amid the LLM agent boom, token costs are a pain point; RTK directly cuts input tokens by 60-90%, with simple install and <10ms overhead, quickly amassing 78k+ stars and 163 new stars today.
uses: Developers using AI coding assistants like Claude Code or Codex to reduce token costs
Automation scripts or CI pipelines that generate large command outputs and feed LLMs, optimizing context
Rust enthusiasts interested in building high-performance system-level CLIs

en.what: Limusic is a native desktop YouTube Music client built with Tauri + Rust + SvelteKit, directly using YouTube's internal API and playing audio via libmpv for ad-free playback. It supports login, browsing, queue, lyrics, mini player, Last.fm scrobbling, Discord Rich Presence, and local music playback.
en.content: The repository contains the full desktop client source code, with a Rust backend and SvelteKit frontend, packaged via Tauri 2 for cross-platform distribution. It provides Linux/Windows installers and supports multilingual translations via Weblate.
en.stack: Tech stack includes Rust (backend), Tauri 2 (desktop framework), SvelteKit (frontend), libmpv (audio playback), and YouTube internal API (data source).
en.hot: Gained 20 stars today, ranking #15 on the Rust trending list. Its ad-free, Electron-free lightweight native approach, plus rich features (lyrics, Last.fm, Discord integration), attracts privacy- and performance-conscious users.
uses: Heavy YouTube Music users who want an ad-free and resource-efficient desktop client
Privacy-conscious users who avoid Electron apps due to high memory usage
Music enthusiasts needing lyrics, Last.fm scrobbling, and Discord Rich Presence
Developers interested in Tauri + Rust + SvelteKit architecture for native desktop apps

zh.tag: 用WiFi穿墙感知人体姿态、呼吸与心率，无需摄像头
zh.what: RuView 是一个基于 WiFi 信号（CSI）的感知平台，利用普通路由器发射的无线电波，通过低成本的 ESP32 传感器捕获人体扰动，实现穿墙的人体存在检测、姿态估计、呼吸和心率监测。它无需任何摄像头或可穿戴设备，仅依赖物理信号即可感知房间内的人员状态。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 RuView 平台代码，包括 ESP32 固件、信号处理算法、推理引擎，以及与 Home Assistant、Apple Home、Google Home、Alexa 等智能家居生态的集成文档和 Matter 桥接支持。还提供了 21 种实体（11 种原始信号 + 10 种推断语义状态）和 3 个 HA Blueprints。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 语言开发，依赖 ESP32 硬件和 CSI 数据采集，集成 MQTT、HAP-1.1、Matter 等协议，支持 Home Assistant 等智能家居平台。
zh.hot: 凭借 92k+ 的 star 数，RuView 因将科幻般的‘穿墙感知’变为现实而爆火，且完全基于 WiFi 信号，无需摄像头，兼顾隐私与实用性。今日新增 86 星，在 Rust 日榜位列第 16，显示出持续高涨的关注度。
uses: 智能家居爱好者：通过 Home Assistant 等平台实现房间级的人员检测与生命体征监测，无需额外硬件。
养老与医疗监护：监测老人或病人的呼吸、心率及异常状态（如跌倒风险、长时间不动），及时预警。
安防与空间管理：在黑暗或遮挡环境下检测入侵者或统计房间占用情况，适用于办公室、仓库等场景。

en.tag: Turn commodity WiFi into spatial intelligence & vital sign sensing, no cameras needed
en.what: RuView is a WiFi sensing platform that uses Channel State Information (CSI) from commodity routers and low-cost ESP32 sensors to detect human presence, estimate poses, and monitor breathing and heart rate through walls. It requires no cameras or wearables, relying purely on radio wave disturbances caused by human movement and vital signs.
en.content: The repository contains the full RuView platform code, including ESP32 firmware, signal processing algorithms, inference engines, and integration docs for Home Assistant, Apple Home, Google Home, Alexa, plus Matter bridge support. It ships 21 entities per node (11 raw signals + 10 inferred semantic states) and 3 starter HA Blueprints.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, leveraging ESP32 hardware and CSI data capture, with integrations via MQTT, HAP-1.1, and Matter protocols for smart home platforms.
en.hot: With over 92k stars, RuView has gone viral for turning sci-fi 'see-through-walls' sensing into reality, using only WiFi signals without cameras, balancing privacy and utility. Gaining 86 stars today and ranking #16 on the Rust daily trending list, it continues to attract significant attention.
uses: Smart home enthusiasts: Integrate with Home Assistant to achieve room-level presence and vital sign monitoring without extra hardware.
Elderly and healthcare monitoring: Track breathing, heart rate, and anomalies (e.g., fall risk, inactivity) for timely alerts.
Security and space management: Detect intruders or count occupancy in dark or obstructed environments, suitable for offices and warehouses.

zh.tag: macOS 上的开源容器与虚拟机运行时
zh.what: ArcBox 是一个用 Rust 从零构建的快速、开源的容器和虚拟机运行时，专为 macOS 设计。它提供 Docker 兼容引擎、原生 Kubernetes、AI 代理沙箱以及完整的 Linux 和 macOS 虚拟机，旨在替代 Docker Desktop 和 OrbStack。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心运行时（自己的 VMM、VirtIO 设备、文件系统共享和网络数据路径）以及 CLI 工具（abctl），支持容器、沙箱、Linux 机器和 macOS 客户机四种工作负载。
zh.stack: 纯 Rust 实现，自带 VMM 和 VirtIO 设备，OCI 兼容，支持 Kubernetes。
zh.hot: 今日新增 543 星，总星数 2874，登上 GitHub Trending（Rust）第 17 名。作为 OrbStack 的开源替代品，它提供了快速、低开销的 Docker 和 VM 体验，同时保持完全开源。
uses: 开发者希望在 macOS 上使用 Docker 兼容环境，但不想依赖闭源的 Docker Desktop 或 OrbStack。
AI 工程师需要为代理或不可信代码提供隔离的沙箱环境，且要求快速启动和本地优先。
系统管理员或 DevOps 人员需要原生 Kubernetes 支持，以及完整的 Linux 虚拟机。
需要临时 macOS 虚拟机进行测试或开发的用户。

en.tag: Open-source container & VM runtime for macOS
en.what: ArcBox is a fast, open-source container and VM runtime for macOS, built from scratch in Rust. It offers Docker-compatible engine, native Kubernetes, AI agent sandboxes, and full Linux and macOS VMs, aiming to replace Docker Desktop and OrbStack.
en.content: The repository contains the core runtime (its own VMM, VirtIO devices, filesystem sharing, and network datapath) and the CLI tool (abctl), supporting four types of workloads: containers, sandboxes, Linux machines, and macOS guests.
en.stack: Pure Rust implementation with its own VMM and VirtIO devices, OCI compatible, supports Kubernetes.
en.hot: Gained 543 stars today, total 2874, ranking #17 in GitHub Trending (Rust). As an open-source alternative to OrbStack, it offers fast, low-overhead Docker and VM experience while being fully open source.
uses: Developers who want Docker-compatible environment on macOS without relying on closed-source Docker Desktop or OrbStack.
AI engineers needing isolated sandboxes for agents or untrusted code with fast boot and local-first.
Sysadmins or DevOps needing native Kubernetes support and full Linux VMs.
Users needing disposable macOS VMs for testing or development.

zh.tag: AI 原生网络安全作战系统，集规划、执行、审计于一体
zh.what: CyberStrikeAI 是一个用 Go 构建的 AI 原生网络安全平台，将意图转化为受治理的执行，证据转化为可操作记忆。它连接规划、执行、人工监督、证据和回放，形成一个可审计的工作空间，用于授权安全操作。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的平台代码，包括仪表盘、Web 控制台、任务管理、漏洞管理、WebShell 管理、MCP 管理、知识库、技能管理和代理管理等功能模块。还提供文档、安全模型和加固指南。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言，集成 Eino 驱动的代理、MCP 原生工具、RAG 知识库、可视化工作流和攻击链建模分析。
zh.hot: 随着 AI 与网络安全的结合成为热点，CyberStrikeAI 提供全面的 AI 驱动安全操作平台，在 GitHub 上迅速获得关注，今日新增 121 星，总星数达 6215。
uses: 安全团队进行授权渗透测试和红队演练，利用 AI 代理自动化攻击链建模与执行。
安全分析师通过可视化工作流和证据回放，审计和复盘安全事件。
开发者或研究者探索 AI 原生安全工具链，集成 MCP 和 RAG 技术。
企业安全运营中心（SOC）用于统一管理漏洞、WebShell 和知识库。

en.tag: AI-native cybersecurity system of action integrating planning, execution, and audit
