en.what: CyberStrikeAI is an AI-native cybersecurity platform built in Go that turns intent into governed execution and evidence into operational memory. It connects planning, execution, human oversight, evidence, and replay in one auditable workspace for authorized security operations.
en.content: The repository contains the full platform code, including dashboard, web console, task management, vulnerability management, WebShell management, MCP management, knowledge base, skills management, and agent management modules. It also includes documentation, security model, and hardening guides.
en.stack: Primarily built with Go, integrating Eino-powered agents, MCP-native tools, RAG knowledge, visual workflows, and attack-chain modeling and analysis.
en.hot: As AI and cybersecurity convergence becomes a hot topic, CyberStrikeAI offers a comprehensive AI-driven security operations platform, quickly gaining traction on GitHub with 121 stars today and 6,215 total.
uses: Security teams conducting authorized penetration testing and red team exercises, using AI agents to automate attack chain modeling and execution.
Security analysts auditing and replaying security incidents via visual workflows and evidence replay.
Developers or researchers exploring AI-native security toolchains, integrating MCP and RAG technologies.
Enterprise Security Operations Centers (SOC) for unified management of vulnerabilities, WebShells, and knowledge bases.

zh.tag: 高密度多路复用、亚秒级挂起/恢复的 Agent 运行时基础设施
zh.what: Agent Substrate 是一个为大规模 Agent 部署提供高性能、高密度运行时环境的系统。它通过控制平面管理 Agent 沙箱的完整生命周期，支持亚秒级的挂起/恢复操作，并允许将大量 Agent 多路复用到底层计算基础设施上。该系统并非用于构建 Agent 的 SDK，而是用于大规模运行 Agent 的底层系统。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心控制平面实现，支持多种沙箱技术（如 microVM 和 gVisor），并基于 Kubernetes 进行基础设施供给和 Worker 生命周期管理。提供演示视频和详细文档，展示如何将约 250 个有状态 Actor 多路复用到 8 个物理 Pod 上。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 Kubernetes（Pod 和自动扩缩容）进行基础设施管理，并集成 microVM 和 gVisor 等沙箱技术。
zh.hot: 该仓库在 GitHub Trending 日榜（Go）排名第 3，今日新增 26 颗星，总星数达 1270。其核心卖点——亚秒级挂起/恢复和高密度多路复用——解决了 Agent 部署中的关键痛点，因此受到广泛关注。
uses: 需要大规模运行 AI Agent 的团队，希望降低基础设施成本并提高资源利用率
构建 Agent 编排平台的开发者，需要底层生命周期管理和流量路由
从事强化学习（RL）场景的工程师，需要统一管理 Agent、推理和训练基础设施

en.tag: High-density, sub-second suspend/resume runtime infrastructure for large-scale agent deployments
en.what: Agent Substrate is a system that provides a performant, high-density runtime environment for large-scale agent deployments. Its control plane manages the full lifecycle of agent sandboxes, enabling sub-second suspend/resume operations and heavy multiplexing of agents onto shared compute infrastructure. It is not an SDK for building agents but a system for running them at scale.
en.content: The repository contains the core control plane implementation, supporting multiple sandbox technologies (e.g., microVMs and gVisor), and leverages Kubernetes for infrastructure provisioning and worker lifecycle management. It includes a demo video and detailed documentation showing how to multiplex ~250 stateful actors across just 8 physical pods.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, it leverages Kubernetes (Pods and autoscaling) for infrastructure management and integrates sandbox technologies like microVMs and gVisor.
en.hot: Ranked #3 on GitHub Trending (Go) daily, gaining 26 stars today to reach 1270 total. Its key selling points—sub-second suspend/resume and high-density multiplexing—address critical pain points in agent deployment, driving significant interest.
uses: Teams deploying AI agents at scale, aiming to reduce infrastructure costs and improve resource utilization
Developers building agent orchestration platforms that require underlying lifecycle management and traffic routing
Engineers working on reinforcement learning (RL) scenarios needing unified management of agentic, inference, and training infrastructure

zh.tag: 跨平台快速安全备份工具，支持加密与去重
zh.what: Kopia 是一个开源备份/恢复工具，支持 Windows、macOS 和 Linux。它提供快速增量备份、客户端端到端加密、压缩和数据去重，并同时提供命令行和图形界面。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Kopia 的完整源代码、文档、图标资源以及构建配置。项目采用 Go 编写，支持通过 Docker 部署，并提供丰富的命令行和图形界面功能。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖多种 Go 库，支持跨平台编译。项目包含持续集成、代码覆盖率测试和 Docker 镜像构建。
zh.hot: Kopia 因其强大的备份功能和易用性而广受欢迎，在 GitHub 上拥有超过 14k 星标。它结合了加密、去重和压缩等高级特性，同时提供 CLI 和 GUI，满足了不同用户的需求。
uses: 个人用户需要可靠且安全的备份解决方案，保护重要文件和数据。
系统管理员和 IT 专业人员希望自动化备份流程，并支持远程或云存储。
开发者需要可编程的备份工具，以便集成到脚本或 CI/CD 流程中。

en.tag: Fast and secure cross-platform backup with encryption and deduplication
en.what: Kopia is an open-source backup/restore tool for Windows, macOS, and Linux. It offers fast incremental backups, client-side end-to-end encryption, compression, and data deduplication, with both CLI and GUI.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code, documentation, icons, and build configurations. Written in Go, it supports Docker deployment and offers extensive CLI and GUI features.
en.stack: Developed primarily in Go, leveraging various Go libraries, with cross-platform compilation support. Includes CI, code coverage, and Docker image builds.
en.hot: Kopia is popular for its robust backup capabilities and ease of use, with over 14k stars on GitHub. It combines advanced features like encryption, deduplication, and compression, while offering both CLI and GUI to cater to diverse users.
uses: Individual users seeking a reliable and secure backup solution to protect important files and data.
System administrators and IT professionals who want to automate backup workflows with remote or cloud storage support.
Developers needing a programmable backup tool for integration into scripts or CI/CD pipelines.

zh.tag: 可扩展的覆盖网络工具，兼顾性能、简单与安全
zh.what: Nebula 是一个可扩展的覆盖网络工具，旨在让分布在世界各地的计算机无缝连接。它基于 Noise 协议框架，使用证书认证节点身份，并通过灯塔节点实现 NAT 穿透，支持从少量到数万台设备的组网。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Nebula 的核心代码，包括证书管理、加密通信、安全组、灯塔节点等模块，以及适用于 Linux、Windows、macOS、FreeBSD 等平台的构建文件。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 Noise 协议框架、椭圆曲线 Diffie-Hellman 密钥交换和 AES-256-GCM 加密。
zh.hot: Nebula 在 GitHub 上拥有 18k+ stars，今日新增 25 个，位列 Go 趋势榜第五，因其高性能、简单易用和安全性受到广泛关注。
uses: 适用于需要跨地域、跨云服务商安全组网的开发者和运维人员。
适合构建分布式系统或边缘计算场景，需要低延迟、高安全性的网络连接。
可用于个人或企业快速搭建虚拟专用网络，替代传统 VPN 方案。

en.tag: A scalable overlay networking tool focusing on performance, simplicity, and security
en.what: Nebula is a scalable overlay networking tool that enables seamless connection of computers worldwide. Built on the Noise Protocol Framework, it uses certificates for node authentication and lighthouse nodes for NAT traversal, supporting networks from a few to tens of thousands of devices.
en.content: The repository contains the core code of Nebula, including modules for certificate management, encrypted communication, security groups, lighthouse nodes, and build files for Linux, Windows, macOS, FreeBSD, etc.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, leveraging the Noise Protocol Framework, Elliptic-curve Diffie-Hellman key exchange, and AES-256-GCM encryption.
en.hot: With over 18k stars and 25 new stars today, ranking 5th on the Go trending list, Nebula gains attention for its high performance, simplicity, and security.
uses: For developers and operators needing secure networking across regions and cloud providers.
Ideal for distributed systems or edge computing requiring low-latency, high-security connections.
Can be used to quickly set up virtual private networks for individuals or enterprises, replacing traditional VPN solutions.

zh.tag: 为AI代理打造的即时、并发、安全、轻量级沙箱服务
zh.what: CubeSandbox 是一个高性能的沙箱服务，基于 RustVMM 和 KVM 构建，为 AI 代理提供硬件级隔离的运行环境。它能在 60 毫秒内创建沙箱，内存开销小于 5MB，支持单节点部署和轻松扩展到多节点集群。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的沙箱服务实现，包括 RustVMM 和 KVM 集成、E2B 兼容的 API、Python SDK（PyPI 包）、文档、快速入门指南和变更日志。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，底层依赖 RustVMM 和 KVM 实现硬件级虚拟化。提供 Python SDK，兼容 E2B SDK。
zh.hot: 凭借极快的启动速度（60ms）和极低的内存开销（<5MB），以及 E2B 兼容性，迅速获得开发者关注，GitHub 日榜 Go 语言第 2 名，star 数已超 1.1 万。
uses: AI 代理开发者：需要安全、隔离的环境来执行代码或运行工具，确保代理行为可控。
平台工程师：构建多租户沙箱服务，用于代码执行、数据处理或安全测试。
教育场景：为学生提供安全的编程练习环境，避免影响宿主机。

en.tag: Instant, concurrent, secure & lightweight sandbox service for AI agents
en.what: CubeSandbox is a high-performance sandbox service built on RustVMM and KVM, providing hardware-isolated runtime environments for AI agents. It can create a sandbox in under 60ms with less than 5MB memory overhead, supporting single-node deployment and easy scaling to multi-node clusters.
en.content: The repository contains the full sandbox service implementation, including RustVMM and KVM integration, E2B-compatible API, Python SDK (PyPI package), documentation, quickstart guide, and changelog.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, leveraging RustVMM and KVM for hardware-level virtualization. Provides a Python SDK and is compatible with the E2B SDK.
en.hot: With ultra-fast startup (60ms) and low memory overhead (<5MB), plus E2B compatibility, it quickly gained developer attention, ranking #2 on GitHub Trending for Go and amassing over 11k stars.
uses: AI agent developers: need secure, isolated environments to execute code or run tools, ensuring agent behavior is controlled.
Platform engineers: build multi-tenant sandbox services for code execution, data processing, or security testing.
Educational scenarios: provide students with safe programming practice environments without affecting the host machine.

zh.tag: 终端里的 Git 可视化神器，让版本控制更直观高效
zh.what: lazygit 是一个运行在终端中的 Git 图形界面工具，将常用的 Git 命令封装成直观的界面操作。它支持分支管理、暂存、提交、合并、变基等核心功能，并提供了快捷键和鼠标支持，让开发者无需记忆复杂命令即可完成版本控制。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 Go 源码、演示 GIF、赞助商列表和详细的 README 文档。项目采用模块化结构，包含核心逻辑、UI 渲染、Git 命令封装等部分，并提供了丰富的配置选项和主题支持。
zh.stack: 基于 Go 语言开发，使用 gocui 库构建终端 UI，依赖 Git 命令行工具。项目还集成了 golangci-lint 进行代码检查，并通过 GitHub Actions 进行持续集成。
zh.hot: 拥有超过 8 万 Star，是终端 Git 工具中最受欢迎的项目之一。其简洁的界面和强大的功能吸引了大量开发者，今日新增 56 个 Star，持续保持热度。
uses: 适合经常在终端中操作 Git 的开发者，提升日常版本控制效率
适合希望可视化理解 Git 分支和提交历史的初学者，降低学习门槛
适合需要快速进行代码审查和冲突解决的团队协作场景

en.tag: A simple terminal UI for git commands, making version control visual and efficient
en.what: lazygit is a terminal-based GUI for Git commands, wrapping common Git operations into an intuitive interface. It supports branch management, staging, committing, merging, rebasing, and more, with keyboard shortcuts and mouse support, enabling developers to handle version control without memorizing complex commands.
en.content: The repository contains complete Go source code, demo GIFs, sponsor lists, and detailed README documentation. The project is modular, including core logic, UI rendering, Git command wrappers, and offers extensive configuration options and theme support.
en.stack: Developed in Go, using the gocui library for terminal UI, and depends on the Git command-line tool. The project integrates golangci-lint for code linting and uses GitHub Actions for CI.
en.hot: With over 80k stars, it's one of the most popular terminal Git tools. Its simple interface and powerful features attract many developers, gaining 56 stars today and maintaining steady popularity.
uses: Ideal for developers who frequently use Git in the terminal, boosting daily version control efficiency
Great for beginners who want to visualize Git branches and commit history, lowering the learning curve
Useful for team collaboration scenarios requiring quick code review and conflict resolution

zh.tag: 开源 Agent 优先的 IAM 与 MCP 网关，统一身份认证
zh.what: Casdoor 是一个开源、自托管的身份与访问管理（IAM）平台，提供单点登录（SSO）和认证服务器，并带有 Web 控制台。它支持多种标准协议（OAuth 2.0、OIDC、SAML、CAS、LDAP、SCIM、WebAuthn、TOTP/MFA）以及 MCP，可连接 Google Workspace、Azure AD 等身份提供商。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 Casdoor 源代码，包括后端（Go 编写）、前端 Web 控制台（React 等）以及部署配置。提供 Docker 镜像、GitHub Actions 工作流、文档和演示站点。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，前端采用 React 等现代框架。依赖包括 OAuth/OIDC 库、LDAP 客户端、WebAuthn 实现等，并支持 Docker 部署。
zh.hot: 随着 AI 代理和 MCP 的兴起，Casdoor 作为 Agent-first 的 IAM 和 MCP 网关，满足了代理身份认证和授权的新需求。尽管今日新增 star 仅 9 个，但总星数 14340 表明其持续受到关注，尤其在 Go 社区中排名靠前。
uses: 开发 AI 代理或 MCP 服务的团队，需要为代理提供身份认证和授权网关
企业或开发者希望自托管 SSO 和 IAM 系统，支持多种协议和身份提供商
需要将现有应用与 Google Workspace、Azure AD 等企业身份源集成的场景

en.tag: Open-source Agent-first IAM and MCP gateway for unified identity and access
en.what: Casdoor is an open-source, self-hosted identity and access management (IAM) platform that provides single sign-on (SSO) and an authentication server with a web console. It supports standard protocols (OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SAML, CAS, LDAP, SCIM, WebAuthn, TOTP/MFA) as well as MCP, and connects to identity providers like Google Workspace and Azure AD.
en.content: The repository contains the full Casdoor source code, including the backend (written in Go), the frontend web console (React, etc.), and deployment configurations. It provides Docker images, GitHub Actions workflows, documentation, and a live demo.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, with a frontend using modern frameworks like React. Dependencies include OAuth/OIDC libraries, LDAP clients, WebAuthn implementations, etc., and it supports Docker deployment.
en.hot: With the rise of AI agents and MCP, Casdoor as an Agent-first IAM and MCP gateway addresses new needs for agent identity and authorization. Although only 9 stars were added today, the total of 14,340 stars indicates sustained attention, especially ranking high in the Go community.
uses: Teams building AI agents or MCP services that need an identity and authorization gateway for agents
Enterprises or developers wanting a self-hosted SSO and IAM system supporting multiple protocols and identity providers
Scenarios requiring integration of existing apps with enterprise identity sources like Google Workspace and Azure AD

zh.tag: 基于 WireGuard 的安全组网与远程访问平台
zh.what: NetBird 是一个开源平台，用于创建基于 WireGuard 的加密覆盖网络，自动连接设备，无需配置端口转发或复杂防火墙规则。它集成了集中式访问控制，支持 SSO、MFA 和细粒度权限策略，适用于企业或家庭网络。
zh.content: 仓库包含 NetBird 客户端、服务端组件、管理 UI（dashboard）、公共 API、命令行工具以及 agent-network 子目录（用于 AI 代理的身份感知访问控制）。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，基于 WireGuard 协议，支持 Linux、Windows、macOS、iOS 和 Android 等平台。
zh.hot: NetBird 提供零配置的 P2P 组网和集中管理，简化了 VPN 的复杂性，同时新增的 AI 代理网络功能吸引了关注。28k+ 星标表明其作为安全远程访问解决方案的受欢迎程度。
uses: 企业 IT 团队：快速搭建安全的远程访问网络，替代传统 VPN，实现细粒度访问控制。
开发者与运维：用于跨云、混合云环境的设备互联，简化网络配置和密钥管理。
个人用户：在家用网络中安全连接多台设备，无需公网 IP 或端口转发。
AI 应用开发者：通过 agent-network 功能，为 AI 代理提供无密钥的 LLM API 和私有资源访问。

en.tag: Secure WireGuard-based overlay network with SSO and access control
en.what: NetBird is an open-source platform for creating WireGuard-based encrypted overlay networks, automatically connecting devices without port forwarding or complex firewall rules. It integrates centralized access control with SSO, MFA, and granular policies, suitable for organizations or home networks.
en.content: The repository contains NetBird client, server components, admin dashboard, public API, CLI tools, and an agent-network subdirectory for identity-aware access control for AI agents.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, built on WireGuard protocol, supporting Linux, Windows, macOS, iOS, and Android platforms.
en.hot: NetBird offers zero-config P2P networking with centralized management, simplifying VPN complexity, and its new AI agent network feature attracts attention. 28k+ stars indicate its popularity as a secure remote access solution.
uses: Enterprise IT teams: Quickly set up secure remote access networks replacing traditional VPNs with granular access control.
Developers and DevOps: Interconnect devices across cloud and hybrid environments, simplifying network configuration and key management.
Personal users: Securely connect multiple devices in home networks without public IP or port forwarding.
AI application developers: Use agent-network to provide keyless access to LLM APIs and private resources for AI agents.

zh.tag: 可编程的异构LLM推理路由层，构建混合模型系统
zh.what: vLLM Semantic Router 是一个可编程的路由层，用于在异构 LLM 基础设施上构建 Mixture-of-Models 系统。它评估请求信号、用户偏好和应用策略，为每个请求选择或组合合适的模型路径，从而在不硬编码路由逻辑的情况下优化质量、成本、延迟、隐私和安全性。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 实现的路由器核心、安装脚本、文档站点（website/）、以及示例和配置。提供在线 Playground 和 Hugging Face 集成，支持 v0.3 Themis 等版本发布。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 vLLM 生态，可能集成 Hugging Face 模型和云/边缘计算资源。
zh.hot: 随着 LLM 应用多样化，对混合模型路由的需求增长，该仓库提供可编程路由方案，今日新增 28 星，登上 Go 趋势榜第 3 名。
uses: 需要优化 LLM 推理成本与延迟的工程团队，通过路由策略动态选择模型。
构建多模型系统（MoM）的开发者，希望根据请求内容智能组合模型输出。
关注数据隐私的企业，利用路由将敏感数据保留在本地或私有云。
研究人员探索信号驱动的路由算法，可基于此进行实验和扩展。

en.tag: Programmable routing layer for heterogeneous LLM inference to build Mixture-of-Models systems
en.what: vLLM Semantic Router is a programmable routing layer for building Mixture-of-Models systems across heterogeneous LLM infrastructure. It evaluates request signals, user preferences, and application policies to select or compose the right model path for each request, improving quality, cost, latency, privacy, and safety without hard-coding routing logic.
en.content: The repository contains the Go-based router core, installation scripts, documentation site (website/), examples, and configurations. It offers an online Playground and Hugging Face integration, with releases like v0.3 Themis.
en.stack: Developed primarily in Go, leveraging the vLLM ecosystem, with potential integrations with Hugging Face models and cloud/edge compute resources.
en.hot: As LLM applications diversify, the need for Mixture-of-Models routing grows; this repo offers a programmable solution, gaining 28 stars today and ranking #3 on Go trending.
uses: Engineering teams optimizing LLM inference cost and latency by dynamically routing requests to appropriate models.
Developers building Mixture-of-Models systems who want to intelligently compose model outputs based on request content.
Enterprises concerned with data privacy, using routing to keep sensitive data within local or private cloud boundaries.
Researchers exploring signal-driven routing algorithms, can experiment and extend based on this project.

zh.tag: OpenTelemetry Collector 的官方扩展组件库
zh.what: 这是 OpenTelemetry Collector 的贡献仓库，包含大量由社区维护的接收器、处理器、导出器和扩展组件。它用于扩展 Collector 的核心功能，支持多种数据源和后端，实现可观测性数据的采集、处理和导出。
zh.content: 仓库按组件类型组织，包含数百个子目录，每个对应一个独立的 Go 模块，提供编译好的二进制或库。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言，基于 OpenTelemetry Collector 核心框架，依赖多种开源库和协议实现。
zh.hot: 作为可观测性标准 OpenTelemetry 的关键扩展库，star 数近 5000，持续获得社区贡献，是构建统一遥测管道的热门选择。
uses: 需要为 OpenTelemetry Collector 添加自定义接收器或导出器的开发者
构建统一可观测性数据管道的平台工程师
希望利用社区现成组件快速集成多种数据源和监控后端的团队

en.tag: Official extension repository for OpenTelemetry Collector
en.what: This is the contrib repository for the OpenTelemetry Collector, containing a wide range of community-maintained receivers, processors, exporters, and extensions. It extends the core Collector to support diverse data sources and backends for observability data collection, processing, and export.
en.content: Organized by component type, it contains hundreds of subdirectories, each a separate Go module, providing binaries or libraries.
en.stack: Primarily Go, built on the OpenTelemetry Collector core framework, with dependencies on various open-source libraries and protocol implementations.
en.hot: As a key extension library for the observability standard OpenTelemetry, it has nearly 5000 stars and continuous community contributions, making it a popular choice for unified telemetry pipelines.
uses: Developers who need to add custom receivers or exporters to the OpenTelemetry Collector
Platform engineers building unified observability data pipelines
Teams looking to quickly integrate diverse data sources and monitoring backends using community components

zh.tag: GitHub 官方命令行工具，将 PR、Issue 等带到终端
zh.what: gh 是 GitHub 官方推出的命令行工具，让你在终端中直接管理仓库、PR、Issue、Actions 等。它与 git 无缝协作，支持 GitHub.com、GitHub Enterprise Cloud 和 Server。
zh.content: 仓库包含 gh 的完整源码、安装脚本、文档以及用于编码代理的 Agent skill。支持 macOS、Windows、Linux 多种安装方式。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 git 和 GitHub API。
zh.hot: 作为 GitHub 官方 CLI，拥有 45k+ Star，是开发者日常高频使用的工具。今日新增 16 Star，持续活跃。
uses: 开发者 —— 在终端中快速管理 GitHub 仓库、PR、Issue 等
DevOps 工程师 —— 集成到 CI/CD 脚本中自动化 GitHub 操作
编码代理 —— 通过 Agent skill 让 AI 代理直接调用 gh 命令

en.tag: GitHub's official CLI, bringing PRs, issues, and more to your terminal
en.what: gh is GitHub's official command-line tool that lets you manage repositories, pull requests, issues, Actions, and more directly from your terminal. It works seamlessly with git and supports GitHub.com, GitHub Enterprise Cloud, and Server.
en.content: The repo contains the full source code, installation scripts, documentation, and an Agent skill for coding agents. It supports multiple installation methods on macOS, Windows, and Linux.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, depends on git and the GitHub API.
en.hot: As the official GitHub CLI, it has over 45k stars and is a daily essential for developers. It gained 16 stars today, showing sustained activity.
uses: Developers — manage GitHub repos, PRs, issues quickly from the terminal
DevOps engineers — automate GitHub operations in CI/CD scripts
Coding agents — use the Agent skill to let AI agents invoke gh commands

zh.tag: 极简自托管 Git 服务，轻松搭建代码仓库
zh.what: Gogs 是一个用 Go 编写的自托管 Git 服务，旨在以最简单的方式搭建自己的代码托管平台。它支持多平台独立二进制分发，包括 Linux、macOS、Windows 和 ARM 系统，适合个人或小团队使用。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 Gogs 源代码、文档、国际化资源（31 种语言）、CI 配置和 Docker 部署支持。主要目录包括 docs（文档）、conf（配置）、templates（HTML 模板）等。
zh.stack: 后端使用 Go 语言，支持多种数据库后端（PostgreSQL、MySQL、MariaDB、SQLite3）。前端使用 HTML 模板和 JavaScript，支持通过 SSH、HTTP/HTTPS 访问仓库。
zh.hot: Gogs 已有 47.8k star，因其轻量、易部署而广受欢迎，尤其适合资源受限的环境（如树莓派）。今日新增 8 star，仍保持稳定热度。
uses: 个人开发者或小团队希望快速搭建私有 Git 服务，无需依赖 GitHub 等外部平台。
需要在低配硬件（如树莓派、小型 VPS）上运行 Git 服务，节省成本。
企业内网需要完全可控的代码托管，支持 LDAP、SMTP 等认证集成。
开源项目或教育机构希望提供本地化的代码托管和协作功能。

en.tag: Painless self-hosted Git service with simple setup
en.what: Gogs is a self-hosted Git service written in Go, aiming to set up your own code hosting platform in the most painless way. It provides standalone binaries for all platforms Go supports, including Linux, macOS, Windows, and ARM, suitable for individuals or small teams.
en.content: The repository contains the full Gogs source code, documentation, localization resources (31 languages), CI configurations, and Docker deployment support. Key directories include docs, conf, templates, etc.
en.stack: Backend is written in Go, supporting multiple database backends (PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB, SQLite3). Frontend uses HTML templates and JavaScript, with repository access via SSH and HTTP/HTTPS.
en.hot: With 47.8k stars, Gogs is popular for its lightweight and easy deployment, especially in resource-constrained environments like Raspberry Pi. It gained 8 stars today, maintaining steady popularity.
uses: Individual developers or small teams wanting to quickly set up a private Git service without relying on external platforms like GitHub.
Running Git service on low-spec hardware (e.g., Raspberry Pi, small VPS) to save costs.
Enterprises needing fully controlled code hosting on intranet, with LDAP, SMTP authentication integration.
Open-source projects or educational institutions wanting localized code hosting and collaboration features.

zh.tag: CNCF 毕业级分布式链路追踪平台
zh.what: Jaeger 是一个开源的分布式追踪系统，用于监控和排查微服务架构中的事务传播。它由 Uber 创建并捐赠给 CNCF，是云原生可观测性的核心组件。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Jaeger 的完整源代码，包括收集器、查询服务、UI 以及内存存储等组件。支持通过 Docker 快速启动 all-in-one 模式，并兼容 OpenTelemetry SDK 和 OTLP 协议。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 OpenTelemetry Collector 组件，支持多种存储后端（如 Cassandra、Elasticsearch）及存储插件。
zh.hot: 尽管今日新增 star 不多（5 个），但作为 CNCF 毕业项目，Jaeger 在分布式追踪领域具有标杆地位，v2 版本的发布持续吸引关注。
uses: 微服务架构开发者：用于排查跨服务请求延迟和错误，定位性能瓶颈。
SRE 与运维团队：在生产环境中监控服务依赖，辅助容量规划与故障恢复。
平台工程师：集成 OpenTelemetry 生态，构建统一的可观测性基础设施。

en.tag: CNCF-graduated distributed tracing platform
en.what: Jaeger is an open-source distributed tracing system used for monitoring and troubleshooting transaction propagation in microservices architectures. Created by Uber and donated to CNCF, it is a core component of cloud-native observability.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code of Jaeger, including collector, query service, UI, and in-memory storage components. It supports quick start via Docker all-in-one mode and is compatible with OpenTelemetry SDK and OTLP protocol.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, it leverages OpenTelemetry Collector components and supports multiple storage backends (e.g., Cassandra, Elasticsearch) and storage plugins.
en.hot: Despite modest daily star growth (5), Jaeger is a benchmark in distributed tracing as a CNCF graduated project, and the v2 release continues to attract attention.
uses: Microservices developers: troubleshoot cross-service latency and errors to identify performance bottlenecks.
SRE and operations teams: monitor service dependencies in production, aiding capacity planning and incident recovery.
Platform engineers: integrate with OpenTelemetry ecosystem to build unified observability infrastructure.

zh.tag: 穿透一切的网络代理核心，开源平台
zh.what: Xray-core 是 Project X 的核心网络工具，提供 VLESS、XTLS、REALITY 等协议，用于构建安全、灵活的代理服务。它支持多种传输方式，可穿透防火墙，实现高效、隐蔽的网络通信。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Xray-core 的源代码、文档、安装脚本（如 Xray-install）、Docker 镜像，以及赞助商和捐赠信息。还提供 Project X 官网、Telegram 群组等资源链接。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖底层网络库，支持多平台。安装可通过官方脚本或 Docker 进行，配置采用 JSON 格式。
zh.hot: 拥有 41k+ stars，因其强大的穿透能力和先进协议（如 REALITY）而广受关注。今日新增 18 stars，持续活跃。
uses: 网络受限环境下的科学上网工具，如访问被屏蔽的网站。
构建个人或企业级安全代理服务，用于数据加密传输。
开发人员研究网络协议和代理技术的参考实现。

en.tag: Open platform for network proxies, penetrates everything.
en.what: Xray-core is the core network tool of Project X, providing protocols like VLESS, XTLS, and REALITY for building secure and flexible proxy services. It supports various transport methods to penetrate firewalls and achieve efficient, covert communication.
en.content: The repository contains Xray-core source code, documentation, installation scripts (e.g., Xray-install), Docker images, and sponsor/donation info. It also links to Project X official website, Telegram groups, etc.
en.stack: Developed in Go, leveraging low-level networking libraries, cross-platform. Installation via official scripts or Docker, configuration in JSON.
en.hot: With 41k+ stars, it's popular for its powerful penetration capabilities and advanced protocols like REALITY. Gained 18 stars today, showing ongoing activity.
uses: For circumventing censorship in restricted networks, e.g., accessing blocked sites.
For building personal or enterprise secure proxy services for encrypted data transmission.
For developers researching network protocols and proxy technology as reference implementation.

zh.tag: 开源众包安全引擎，检测并封禁恶意IP
zh.what: CrowdSec 是一个开源、参与式的安全解决方案，通过分析日志和 HTTP 请求来检测恶意行为，并利用社区共享的威胁情报自动封禁恶意 IP。它集成了 IDS/IPS 和 WAF 功能，支持主动防御。
zh.content: 仓库包含安全引擎核心代码、检测规则集（hub）、社区黑名单、控制台（Console）监控界面，以及多种平台支持（Linux、Windows、Docker 等）。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 YAML 配置、Prometheus 监控等，支持多种日志源和数据库（如 SQLite、PostgreSQL）。
zh.hot: 作为开源众包安全方案，CrowdSec 通过社区共享威胁情报实现协同防御，吸引了大量关注。当前 14.7k stars，今日新增 19，登上 GitHub 趋势榜，体现了其受欢迎程度。
uses: 适用于需要防护服务器免受恶意 IP 攻击的系统管理员和安全工程师，可快速部署并自动封禁威胁。
适合希望利用社区威胁情报增强自身安全防护的中小型企业或独立开发者，无需昂贵商业方案。
适用于需要监控和响应网络攻击的安全运营中心（SOC）团队，可集成现有日志分析流程。

en.tag: Open-source collaborative security engine to detect and block malicious IPs
en.what: CrowdSec is an open-source, participative security solution that detects malicious behavior by analyzing logs and HTTP requests, and automatically blocks malicious IPs using community-shared threat intelligence. It integrates IDS/IPS and WAF capabilities for proactive defense.
en.content: The repository contains the core security engine, detection rules (hub), community blocklist, Console monitoring UI, and support for multiple platforms (Linux, Windows, Docker, etc.).
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, with dependencies on YAML config, Prometheus monitoring, and support for various log sources and databases (e.g., SQLite, PostgreSQL).
en.hot: As an open-source crowdsourced security solution, CrowdSec enables collaborative defense via community-shared threat intelligence, attracting significant attention. With 14.7k stars and +19 today, it's trending on GitHub, reflecting its popularity.
uses: For sysadmins and security engineers needing to protect servers from malicious IPs, with rapid deployment and automatic blocking.
Ideal for SMBs or independent developers wanting to leverage community threat intel to enhance security without costly commercial solutions.
For SOC teams requiring monitoring and response to cyber attacks, integrating with existing log analysis workflows.

zh.tag: Go 语言打造的终极 LLM/AI 应用开发框架
zh.what: Eino 是一个基于 Go 语言的 LLM 应用开发框架，借鉴了 LangChain 和 Google ADK 等框架的设计，遵循 Go 语言惯例。它提供可复用的组件（如 ChatModel、Tool、Retriever）和代理开发工具包（ADK），支持构建复杂的 AI 代理和图工作流。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心框架代码、组件定义、ADK 实现，以及示例代码（eino-examples）和扩展组件（eino-ext）的引用。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言，依赖 OpenAI、Ollama 等模型提供方的 SDK，以及可选的工具库。
zh.hot: 作为 Go 生态中少有的成熟 LLM 框架，Eino 填补了空白，star 数已超 1.2 万，今日新增 17，登上 Go 语言趋势榜。
uses: Go 开发者希望构建 LLM 应用或 AI 代理，需要原生 Go 框架。
需要将 LangChain 或 Python 生态的 AI 应用迁移到 Go 的团队。
对高性能、低延迟 AI 服务有需求，并偏好 Go 的并发模型。

en.tag: The ultimate LLM/AI application development framework in Go
en.what: Eino is an LLM application development framework in Go, drawing from LangChain and Google ADK, designed to follow Go conventions. It provides reusable components like ChatModel, Tool, Retriever, and an Agent Development Kit (ADK) for building complex AI agents and graph workflows.
en.content: The repository contains the core framework code, component definitions, ADK implementation, and references to examples (eino-examples) and extended components (eino-ext).
en.stack: Primarily Go, with dependencies on model provider SDKs like OpenAI and Ollama, and optional tool libraries.
en.hot: As a rare mature LLM framework in the Go ecosystem, Eino fills a gap, with over 12k stars and 17 new today, trending on Go language list.
uses: Go developers building LLM apps or AI agents needing a native Go framework.
Teams migrating AI applications from LangChain or Python ecosystems to Go.
Those requiring high-performance, low-latency AI services and preferring Go's concurrency model.

zh.tag: 自托管直播服务器，掌控内容与观众
zh.what: Owncast 是一个开源、自托管的单用户直播视频和聊天服务器，让你可以运行自己的直播服务，风格类似主流平台。它提供对内容、界面、审核和观众的完全所有权。
zh.content: 仓库包含后端（Go 编写）和前端（React）代码，提供完整的直播和聊天功能，支持与现有广播软件（如 OBS）通过 RTMP 集成。
zh.stack: 后端使用 Go 语言，前端使用 React，支持 Docker 部署，兼容任何使用 RTMP 协议的广播软件。
zh.hot: Owncast 因提供去中心化的直播替代方案而流行，用户希望摆脱平台限制，完全掌控自己的内容。尽管今日新增 star 不多，但累计 11k+ stars 和大量 Docker 拉取表明其持续受到关注。
uses: 个人主播或创作者希望拥有自己的直播平台，避免平台审核和算法限制。
社区或组织需要私密或品牌化的直播解决方案，同时要求数据自主可控。
技术爱好者希望学习和定制直播服务器，探索流媒体技术。

en.tag: Self-hosted live streaming server with chat, full control over content and audience.
en.what: Owncast is an open-source, self-hosted, single-user live video streaming and chat server for running your own live streams similar to mainstream platforms. It offers complete ownership over content, interface, moderation, and audience.
en.content: The repository contains backend (Go) and frontend (React) code, providing full live streaming and chat features, with integration for existing broadcasting software via RTMP.
en.stack: Backend in Go, frontend in React, Docker deployment supported, compatible with any broadcasting software using RTMP.
en.hot: Owncast is popular for offering a decentralized live streaming alternative, appealing to users who want to escape platform restrictions and fully control their content. Despite modest daily stars, its 11k+ cumulative stars and significant Docker pulls show sustained interest.
uses: Individual streamers or creators who want their own live streaming platform without platform moderation and algorithm restrictions.
Communities or organizations needing private or branded live streaming solutions with full data ownership.
Tech enthusiasts interested in learning and customizing a live streaming server to explore streaming technology.

zh.tag: 自托管AI网关，多渠道多凭据统一接入
zh.what: GPT-Load 是一个自托管的 AI 网关，为多通道、多凭据的 AI 服务提供统一入口。它支持 API 密钥和订阅账号，具备流量调度、故障转移、请求日志和用量统计功能。应用只需配置一个基础 URL 和一个 AccessKey，即可管理所有上游提供商。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的后端服务、Web 管理界面（位于 web 目录）、Docker 镜像配置、多语言 README（英文、中文、日文）以及架构截图。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，提供 Docker 镜像（ghcr.io/tbphp/gpt-load:2），依赖管理通过 go.mod，前端为 Web 界面。
zh.hot: 随着 AI 应用增多，开发者需要管理多个 API 密钥和订阅账号，GPT-Load 提供了集中管理、调度和容错方案，解决了实际痛点。在 GitHub 上获得 6520 星，今日新增 63 星，登上 Go 语言趋势榜第 19 名。
uses: 开发者或团队需要统一管理多个 AI 服务提供商的 API 密钥和订阅账号，降低集成成本。
需要实现流量调度、故障转移和请求日志记录的生产环境 AI 应用。
自托管偏好者希望避免依赖第三方网关，完全掌控数据和配置。

en.tag: Self-hosted AI gateway for unified multi-channel, multi-credential access
en.what: GPT-Load is a self-hosted AI gateway that provides a unified entry point for multi-channel, multi-credential AI services. It supports API keys and subscription accounts, with traffic scheduling, failover, request logging, and usage accounting. Apps only need one base URL and one AccessKey to manage all upstream providers.
en.content: The repository contains a Go backend, a web management UI (in the web directory), Docker image config, multilingual READMEs (English, Chinese, Japanese), and architecture screenshots.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, with Docker images (ghcr.io/tbphp/gpt-load:2), dependency management via go.mod, and a web-based frontend.
en.hot: As AI apps proliferate, developers need to manage multiple API keys and subscriptions; GPT-Load offers centralized management, scheduling, and failover, solving real pain points. It has 6,520 stars on GitHub, with 63 new today, ranking 19th on the Go trending list.
uses: Developers or teams needing to centrally manage API keys and subscriptions across multiple AI providers, reducing integration overhead.
Production AI applications requiring traffic scheduling, failover, and request logging.
Self-hosting enthusiasts who prefer avoiding third-party gateways and want full control over data and configuration.

zh.tag: 可插拔插件的 DNS 服务器/转发器
zh.what: CoreDNS 是一个用 Go 编写的 DNS 服务器和转发器，通过链式插件实现灵活功能。它支持多种协议（如 UDP/TCP、DoT、DoH、DoQ 等），并可作为 Kubernetes 集群的 DNS 组件。
zh.content: 仓库包含 CoreDNS 的完整源代码、插件系统、文档和构建配置。插件涵盖文件、etcd、kubernetes、缓存、转发、指标等功能。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言，依赖 etcd、Kubernetes、Prometheus 等生态，支持多种 DNS 协议。
zh.hot: 作为 CNCF 毕业项目，CoreDNS 是 Kubernetes 默认 DNS 组件，拥有 14k+ star，持续活跃。
uses: Kubernetes 集群管理员，用于提供集群内 DNS 服务
需要灵活 DNS 解析和转发功能的运维人员
希望扩展 DNS 功能并编写自定义插件的开发者

en.tag: A pluggable DNS server/forwarder written in Go
en.what: CoreDNS is a DNS server and forwarder written in Go that chains plugins to provide flexible DNS functionality. It supports multiple protocols (UDP/TCP, DoT, DoH, DoQ, etc.) and serves as the DNS component for Kubernetes clusters.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code, plugin system, documentation, and build configuration. Plugins cover file, etcd, kubernetes, cache, forward, metrics, and more.
en.stack: Primarily written in Go, leveraging etcd, Kubernetes, Prometheus, and supporting multiple DNS protocols.
en.hot: As a CNCF graduated project, CoreDNS is the default DNS component for Kubernetes, with 14k+ stars and ongoing activity.
uses: Kubernetes cluster administrators needing in-cluster DNS service
Operators requiring flexible DNS resolution and forwarding
Developers who want to extend DNS functionality with custom plugins

zh.tag: 跨 GPU 的图形缩放与帧生成桥接工具
zh.what: OptiScaler 是一个允许在支持 DLSS2+/FSR2+/XeSS 的游戏中替换原生缩放器的工具，并能管理帧生成，包括通过实验性的 OptiFG 在 DX12 游戏中启用帧生成。它支持 DLSS2+/XeSS/FSR2+ 输入，并可将 DLSS 帧生成替换为 FSR3 帧生成。
zh.content: 仓库包含 C++ 源代码、预编译的稳定版和夜间版发布包、详细的 Wiki 文档、Discord 社区链接以及捐赠渠道。
zh.stack: 基于 C++ 开发，依赖图形 API 如 DX12 和 Vulkan，以及 DLSS/FSR/XeSS 等缩放技术。
zh.hot: 该项目在 GitHub 上获得 10k+ 星标，今日新增 47 星，位列 C++ 趋势榜第二。它解决了跨 GPU 缩放和帧生成的兼容性问题，受到游戏玩家和模组社区的广泛关注。
uses: 游戏玩家：在非原生支持的游戏中使用 FSR 或 XeSS 替换 DLSS，提升帧率或画质。
模组制作者：利用 Nukem 模组将 DLSS 帧生成转换为 FSR3，扩展硬件兼容性。
开发者：研究图形缩放和帧生成技术的实现，参考其跨平台兼容方案。

en.tag: Bridges upscaling/frame gen across GPUs, replacing native upscalers
en.what: OptiScaler is a tool that lets you replace upscalers in games that already support DLSS2+/FSR2+/XeSS, and manage frame generation, including enabling it in DX12 games via experimental OptiFG. It supports DLSS2+/XeSS/FSR2+ inputs and can replace DLSS frame gen with FSR3.
en.content: The repository contains C++ source code, precompiled stable and nightly releases, a comprehensive Wiki, Discord community link, and donation channels.
en.stack: Developed in C++, relies on graphics APIs like DX12 and Vulkan, and upscaling technologies such as DLSS, FSR, and XeSS.
en.hot: With over 10k stars and 47 new stars today, ranking #2 on the C++ trending list, it addresses cross-GPU upscaling and frame gen compatibility, gaining attention from gamers and modders.
uses: Gamers: Replace DLSS with FSR or XeSS in games that don't natively support them, improving FPS or quality.
Modders: Use the Nukem mod to convert DLSS frame gen to FSR3, extending hardware compatibility.
Developers: Study the implementation of upscaling and frame gen techniques, referencing its cross-platform compatibility approach.

zh.tag: 3D打印切片与G代码生成工具
zh.what: PrusaSlicer 是一款将 3D 模型转换为 3D 打印指令（G-code）的软件，支持 FDM 和 mSLA 打印机。它由 Prusa Research 开发，兼容多种品牌打印机，并提供丰富的打印参数设置和模型编辑功能。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 C++ 源代码、构建文档（doc/Build.md）、资源文件（如图标）以及贡献指南。主要功能包括精确的打印参数设置、模型编辑（如涂色、切割、排列）、多项目多平台支持、多材料打印、3D 预览和命令行接口。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 开发，基于 Slic3r 构建，依赖常见的图形和几何库。支持 Windows、macOS 和 Linux 平台，Linux 通过 Flathub 分发。
zh.hot: 作为 3D 打印领域的知名开源切片软件，PrusaSlicer 持续获得关注，今日新增 13 颗星，总星数达 9296，位列 C++ 趋势榜第三。其强大的功能和活跃的社区是热度来源。
uses: 3D 打印爱好者：使用 PrusaSlicer 将模型切片并生成打印指令，支持多种打印机。
专业用户：需要精细控制打印参数和进行多材料打印的工程师或设计师。
自动化工作流：通过命令行接口在无 GUI 环境下集成切片功能。

en.tag: 3D printing slicer and G-code generator
en.what: PrusaSlicer is a software that converts 3D models into 3D printing instructions (G-code), supporting FDM and mSLA printers. Developed by Prusa Research, it is compatible with a wide range of printer brands and offers extensive printing parameter settings and model editing features.
en.content: The repository contains the complete C++ source code, build documentation (doc/Build.md), resource files (e.g., icons), and contribution guidelines. Key features include precise printing parameter settings, model editing (painting, cutting, arranging), multi-project and multi-bed support, multi-material printing, 3D preview, and a command-line interface.
en.stack: Primarily developed in C++, built on Slic3r, and relies on common graphics and geometry libraries. Supports Windows, macOS, and Linux; Linux is distributed via Flathub.
en.hot: As a well-known open-source slicer in 3D printing, PrusaSlicer continues to gain attention, adding 13 stars today, reaching 9296 total, ranking third on the C++ trending list. Its powerful features and active community drive its popularity.
uses: 3D printing enthusiasts: use PrusaSlicer to slice models and generate print instructions for various printers.
Professional users: engineers or designers needing precise control over print parameters and multi-material printing.
Automation workflows: integrate slicing via command-line interface in headless environments.

zh.tag: 通用运动恢复结构与多视角立体视觉管线
zh.what: COLMAP 是一个通用的运动恢复结构（SfM）和多视角立体（MVS）处理流程，提供图形界面和命令行界面。它能够从有序或无序的图像集合中重建三维场景，广泛应用于计算机视觉和摄影测量领域。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 C++ 源代码、文档、示例数据集、预编译二进制文件、Docker 镜像、Conda 包以及 Python 绑定（PyCOLMAP）。支持 CUDA 和 HIP/ROCm（AMD GPU），并提供自动重建功能。
zh.stack: 基于 C++ 实现，依赖 ceres-solver、poselib、sift-gpu、vlfeat 等库。提供 Python 绑定，支持 CUDA 和 ROCm 加速。
zh.hot: 作为三维重建领域的标杆工具，COLMAP 拥有 12642 颗星，今日新增 11 颗，在 C++ 日榜排名第 4，持续受到研究者和开发者的青睐。
uses: 计算机视觉研究者进行三维重建、SLAM 或神经辐射场（NeRF）等实验
摄影测量与测绘从业者处理航拍或地面图像生成三维模型
开发者利用 PyCOLMAP 集成重建功能到自己的 Python 应用中

en.tag: General-purpose Structure-from-Motion and Multi-View Stereo pipeline
en.what: COLMAP is a general-purpose Structure-from-Motion (SfM) and Multi-View Stereo (MVS) pipeline with graphical and command-line interfaces. It reconstructs 3D scenes from ordered or unordered image collections, widely used in computer vision and photogrammetry.
en.content: The repository contains full C++ source code, documentation, sample datasets, pre-built binaries, Docker images, Conda packages, and Python bindings (PyCOLMAP). It supports CUDA and HIP/ROCm (AMD GPUs) and offers automatic reconstruction.
en.stack: Implemented in C++, relying on libraries such as ceres-solver, poselib, sift-gpu, and vlfeat. Provides Python bindings and supports CUDA and ROCm acceleration.
en.hot: As a benchmark tool in 3D reconstruction, COLMAP has 12,642 stars, with 11 added today, ranking 4th on the C++ daily trending list, continuously favored by researchers and developers.
uses: Computer vision researchers experimenting with 3D reconstruction, SLAM, or NeRF
Photogrammetry and surveying professionals generating 3D models from aerial or ground images
Developers integrating reconstruction capabilities into Python applications via PyCOLMAP

zh.tag: 现代 C++ 的 JSON 解析与序列化库
zh.what: 这是一个为现代 C++ 设计的 JSON 库，提供直观的 API，支持 JSON 的解析、序列化以及与 STL 容器的无缝集成。它旨在让 C++ 开发者能够像使用 Python 或 JavaScript 一样轻松地处理 JSON 数据。
zh.content: 仓库包含单一头文件 json.hpp，以及完整的文档、测试套件和示例代码。支持多种平台和编译器，并提供了在线演示和详细的 API 参考。
zh.stack: 纯 C++11 及以上实现，无外部依赖，使用 CMake 构建，支持跨平台（Windows、Linux、macOS）。
zh.hot: 因其易用性和高性能而广受欢迎，拥有超过 5 万 star，是 C++ 社区最常用的 JSON 库之一。今日新增 16 星，持续活跃。
uses: C++ 开发者需要在项目中快速集成 JSON 解析和生成功能
需要跨平台且无依赖的 JSON 库的嵌入式或桌面应用开发
希望简化 JSON 数据处理流程的软件工程师

en.tag: JSON parser and serializer for modern C++
en.what: A JSON library for modern C++ that provides an intuitive API for parsing, serializing, and integrating with STL containers. It aims to make JSON handling in C++ as easy as in Python or JavaScript.
en.content: The repository contains a single header file json.hpp, along with comprehensive documentation, test suites, and examples. It supports multiple platforms and compilers, offering an online demo and detailed API reference.
en.stack: Implemented in pure C++11 or later with no external dependencies, built with CMake, and cross-platform (Windows, Linux, macOS).
en.hot: Popular for its ease of use and high performance, with over 50k stars, it is one of the most used JSON libraries in the C++ community. Gaining 16 stars today, it remains actively maintained.
uses: C++ developers needing to quickly integrate JSON parsing and generation in their projects
Embedded or desktop app development requiring a cross-platform, dependency-free JSON library
Software engineers looking to simplify JSON data handling in their code

zh.tag: 极速链接器，替代 Unix 链接器，加速大型构建
zh.what: mold 是一个高性能的 Unix 链接器替代品，旨在加速构建过程。它由 LLVM lld 的原创开发者编写，从零开始设计，突破了 lld 的架构限制。在基准测试中，mold 比 LLVM lld 快 4.9 倍，比 wild 快 1.9 倍（中位数）。
zh.content: 仓库包含 mold 链接器的完整源代码，支持多种 CPU 架构（x86-64, ARM, RISC-V 等），并提供性能基准测试套件。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖系统库和标准工具链，支持 Linux 和 macOS 等 Unix 系统。
zh.hot: 作为 lld 作者的新作，mold 凭借显著的性能提升（比 lld 快 5-10 倍）吸引了大量关注，star 数已达 16.9k，在 C++ 趋势榜上排名第六。
uses: 大型 C/C++/Rust 项目的开发者，希望缩短链接时间，加快调试-编辑-重建循环。
需要频繁构建大型软件（如 Chromium、Firefox）的持续集成系统。
对链接器技术感兴趣，希望了解高性能系统编程的开发者。

en.tag: High-performance drop-in Unix linker replacement, speeding up large builds
en.what: mold is a high-performance drop-in replacement for existing Unix linkers, designed to speed up builds. Written by the original developer of LLVM lld, it was built from scratch to overcome architectural limits. In benchmarks, it links 4.9x faster than LLVM lld and 1.9x faster than wild at the median.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code of the mold linker, supporting multiple CPU architectures (x86-64, ARM, RISC-V, etc.), along with a benchmark suite.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, depends on system libraries and standard toolchain, supports Unix-like systems such as Linux and macOS.
en.hot: As the new work by the lld author, mold attracts attention with significant speedups (5-10x faster than lld), amassing 16.9k stars and ranking #6 on C++ trending.
uses: Developers of large C/C++/Rust projects who want to reduce link time and speed up debug-edit-rebuild cycles.
Continuous integration systems that build large software frequently, such as Chromium or Firefox.
Developers interested in linker technology and high-performance systems programming.

zh.tag: 开源 Windows 输入法，支持中/日文、辅助码、AI 联想与语音输入
zh.what: 水杉输入法是一款面向 Windows 10/11 的开源自由输入法，采用纯 TSF 方案。它支持全拼、双拼、五笔和日文罗马字输入，并提供辅助码、AI 联想、语音输入等高级功能。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心 TSF 模块、Server 端（算法与渲染）、HTML UI、词库、辅助码、语音输入等子项目。提供多种皮肤、剪贴板历史、手写识别等实用功能。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 开发，UI 部分采用 HTML，语音输入集成豆包、OpenAI 等 API。
zh.hot: 今日新增 26 星，总星数 827，位列 GitHub Trending C++ 日榜第 3。因其功能丰富、开源免费且支持 AI 特性而受到关注。
uses: Windows 用户寻找免费开源、功能强大的输入法替代品
对辅助码、双拼、五笔等高效输入方案有需求的用户
希望集成 AI 联想和语音输入以提高输入效率的用户
对输入法开发感兴趣的开发者，可学习 TSF 架构和实现

en.tag: Open-source Windows IME with CJK, assist codes, AI suggestions, and voice input
en.what: Metasequoia IME is an open-source free input method for Windows 10/11, built on pure TSF. It supports Pinyin, Shuangpin, Wubi, and Japanese Romaji, with assist codes, AI suggestions, and voice input.
en.content: The repo includes core TSF, server (algorithms and rendering), HTML UI, dictionaries, assist codes, and voice input subprojects. It offers multiple skins, clipboard history, handwriting recognition, etc.
en.stack: Primarily C++, with HTML for UI, and voice input integrating Doubao, OpenAI, etc.
en.hot: Gained 26 stars today, total 827, ranking #3 on GitHub Trending C++ daily. Its rich features, open-source nature, and AI capabilities attract attention.
uses: Windows users seeking a free, open-source, feature-rich IME alternative
Users needing efficient input methods like assist codes, Shuangpin, or Wubi
Users wanting AI-based suggestions and voice input for faster typing
Developers interested in IME development, learning TSF architecture and implementation

zh.tag: Google 跨语言数据序列化标准
zh.what: Protocol Buffers（protobuf）是 Google 开发的语言中立、平台中立、可扩展的结构化数据序列化机制，用于高效编码和交换数据。它通过 .proto 文件定义数据结构，并生成多种语言的代码，广泛应用于 RPC 系统和数据存储。
zh.content: 仓库包含 protobuf 的完整实现，包括 C++ 编写的编译器（protoc）、各语言运行时库（如 C++、Java、Python、Go 等）、测试和文档。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写编译器，支持 Bazel 和 CMake 构建系统，并依赖多种语言运行时。
zh.hot: 作为数据序列化的行业标准，protobuf 拥有超过 7 万星标，今日新增 96 星，持续受到开发者关注，因其高效、跨语言特性成为微服务和分布式系统的基石。
uses: 后端开发人员：在微服务间定义高效、版本兼容的通信协议。
数据工程师：用于大数据管道和存储格式（如与 gRPC 结合）。
跨语言团队：需要统一数据交换格式，支持多语言生成代码。

en.tag: Google's cross-language data serialization standard
en.what: Protocol Buffers (protobuf) is Google's language-neutral, platform-neutral, extensible mechanism for serializing structured data. It defines data structures in .proto files and generates code in multiple languages, widely used in RPC systems and data storage.
en.content: The repository contains the full implementation of protobuf, including the compiler (protoc) written in C++, runtime libraries for various languages (C++, Java, Python, Go, etc.), tests, and documentation.
en.stack: The compiler is primarily written in C++, supporting Bazel and CMake build systems, with dependencies on various language runtimes.
en.hot: As an industry standard for data serialization, protobuf has over 71k stars, with 96 added today, continuing to attract developers due to its efficiency and cross-language capabilities, making it a cornerstone of microservices and distributed systems.
uses: Backend developers: define efficient, version-tolerant communication protocols between microservices.
Data engineers: use in big data pipelines and storage formats (e.g., with gRPC).
Cross-language teams: need a unified data interchange format with multi-language code generation.

zh.tag: 高性能内存数据存储，兼容 Redis 与 Memcached
zh.what: Dragonfly 是一个现代化的内存数据存储，专为现代应用负载设计。它完全兼容 Redis 和 Memcached API，无需修改代码即可迁移。相比传统内存存储，吞吐量提升 25 倍，资源消耗降低 80%。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心引擎源码、文档、基准测试、构建指南以及多语言 README。还提供了 Docker 镜像和云服务入口。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 Linux 内核特性如 epoll 和 io_uring。支持 Docker 部署，并提供 Helm charts 用于 Kubernetes。
zh.hot: 作为 Redis 和 Memcached 的现代替代品，凭借惊人的性能提升和资源节省，在 C++ 社区持续火爆，今日新增 77 星，总星数达 31150。
uses: 需要高吞吐、低延迟缓存服务的后端开发团队，可无缝替代 Redis。
希望在降低基础设施成本的同时提升性能的运维和架构师。
对内存数据库内部实现感兴趣的 C++ 开发者，可阅读源码学习。

en.tag: High-performance in-memory data store, Redis & Memcached compatible
en.what: Dragonfly is a modern in-memory data store built for modern application workloads. It is fully compatible with Redis and Memcached APIs, requiring no code changes to adopt. Compared to legacy in-memory datastores, it delivers 25X more throughput and uses up to 80% less resources.
en.content: The repository contains core engine source code, documentation, benchmarks, build guides, and multi-language READMEs. It also provides Docker images and a cloud service entry point.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, leveraging Linux kernel features like epoll and io_uring. Supports Docker deployment and provides Helm charts for Kubernetes.
en.hot: As a modern replacement for Redis and Memcached, it gains popularity in the C++ community due to its impressive performance gains and resource savings, with 77 new stars today and 31,150 total.
uses: Backend teams needing high-throughput, low-latency caching, seamlessly replacing Redis.
Ops and architects aiming to cut infrastructure costs while boosting performance.
C++ developers interested in the internals of in-memory databases for learning.

zh.tag: 轻量级进程内向量数据库，极速相似搜索
zh.what: Zvec 是一个开源的、嵌入式的向量数据库，专为低延迟和高性能设计，可直接集成到应用中。它已在阿里巴巴集团内部经过实战检验，提供生产级的相似性搜索能力，且部署简单。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心 C++ 引擎、Python 和 Node.js 客户端库、文档、基准测试以及示例。最新版本引入了 zvec-grep 命令行工具和 ReMe 集成，支持 DiskANN 和索引优化。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 实现，提供 Python（3.10~3.14）和 npm 包，支持 Linux/macOS（含 ARM64），采用 io_uring 异步 I/O，集成 HNSW 和 IVF 索引算法。
zh.hot: 凭借阿里背书和极简部署，在 GitHub 上获得 15.7k 星，今日新增 97 星，位列 C++ 趋势榜第 10。其轻量级进程内设计契合 AI 代理和本地搜索需求。
uses: 开发者需要在应用中嵌入向量数据库，实现低延迟相似搜索，如推荐系统或语义缓存。
AI 代理开发者利用 zvec 作为记忆存储后端，支持 HNSW 近似最近邻搜索。
本地优先工具链用户通过 zvec-grep 统一关键词与向量搜索，提升工作区检索效率。
对性能敏感的场景，如大规模向量检索，需要生产级且易部署的解决方案。

en.tag: Lightweight in-process vector DB for lightning-fast similarity search
en.what: Zvec is an open-source, in-process vector database designed for low-latency, high-performance similarity search. It can be embedded directly into applications, and has been battle-tested within Alibaba Group for production-grade use.
en.content: The repository contains the core C++ engine, Python and Node.js client libraries, documentation, benchmarks, and examples. The latest release adds zvec-grep CLI tool and ReMe integration, with DiskANN support and index optimizations.
en.stack: Primarily implemented in C++, with Python (3.10~3.14) and npm packages, supporting Linux/macOS (incl. ARM64), using io_uring async I/O, integrating HNSW and IVF index algorithms.
en.hot: With Alibaba's backing and minimal setup, it has gained 15.7k stars on GitHub, +97 today, ranking #10 on the C++ trending list. Its lightweight in-process design suits AI agents and local search needs.
uses: Developers needing an embedded vector DB for low-latency similarity search in apps like recommendation or semantic cache.
AI agent developers using zvec as a memory backend with HNSW ANN search.
Local-first toolchain users leveraging zvec-grep to unify keyword and vector search for workspace retrieval.
Performance-sensitive scenarios requiring production-grade, easy-to-deploy vector search.

zh.tag: 为GTA IV注入RTX Remix光线追踪的兼容性模组
zh.what: 这是一个非重制版的模组，允许GTA IV完整版与NVIDIA的RTX Remix工具配合使用，实现光线追踪效果。它包含基线模组和自动PBR模组，并附带自定义运行时和修复补丁。
zh.content: 仓库包含模组源代码、安装说明、使用指南，以及用于自定义RTX Remix运行时和FusionFix分支的链接。
zh.stack: 主要使用C++，依赖RTX Remix、DXVK-Remix、Ultimate ASI Loader和FusionFix。
zh.hot: 该模组为经典游戏GTA IV带来现代光线追踪，支持DLSS 4.5和5.0，在C++日榜上排名第11，今日新增15星，总星数710，吸引了大量玩家和模组爱好者。
uses: GTA IV玩家希望以光线追踪增强画质，体验次世代视觉效果。
模组制作者和开发者参考其实现，学习RTX Remix集成技术。
对NVIDIA RTX Remix兼容性感兴趣的社区成员。

en.tag: Compatibility mod enabling NVIDIA RTX Remix path tracing in GTA IV
en.what: This is a mod, not a remaster, that allows GTA IV: The Complete Edition to be used with NVIDIA's RTX Remix for ray tracing. It includes a baseline mod, an auto-PBR mod, and comes with a custom runtime and fixes.
en.content: The repository contains the mod's source code, installation and usage instructions, and links to custom RTX Remix runtime and FusionFix fork.
en.stack: Primarily C++, relies on RTX Remix, DXVK-Remix, Ultimate ASI Loader, and FusionFix.
en.hot: This mod brings modern ray tracing to the classic GTA IV with DLSS 4.5 and 5.0 support, ranking #11 on the C++ daily trending with 15 new stars today (710 total), attracting gamers and modders.
uses: GTA IV players seeking enhanced graphics with ray tracing for a next-gen visual experience.
Modders and developers studying the implementation to learn RTX Remix integration techniques.
Community members interested in NVIDIA RTX Remix compatibility and modding.

zh.tag: 视觉-惯性标定工具箱
zh.what: Kalibr 是一个用于相机和 IMU 标定的工具箱，支持多相机、相机-IMU、多 IMU 以及卷帘快门相机的标定。它提供空间和时间上的精确校准，广泛应用于机器人视觉和自动驾驶领域。
zh.content: 仓库包含 C++ 源代码、ROS 节点、Docker 脚本、Python 工具以及详细的 Wiki 文档。主要模块包括标定算法、相机模型、可视化工具和报告生成器。
zh.stack: 基于 C++ 和 ROS（支持 Ubuntu 16.04/18.04/20.04），依赖 Eigen、OpenCV 等库，提供 Docker 支持以简化安装。
zh.hot: 作为视觉惯性标定的标准工具，Kalibr 拥有 5698 星，虽今日新增仅 2 星，但因其在机器人领域的核心地位和持续维护，仍稳居 C++ 趋势榜。
uses: 机器人研究者：需要精确标定相机和 IMU 以进行视觉惯性导航。
自动驾驶工程师：用于多传感器融合系统的标定，确保数据同步。
SLAM 开发者：在构建视觉 SLAM 系统前，对相机和 IMU 进行校准。
学术研究者：作为基准工具，验证新的标定算法或传感器配置。

en.tag: Visual-inertial calibration toolbox
en.what: Kalibr is a toolbox for calibrating cameras and IMUs, supporting multi-camera, camera-IMU, multi-IMU, and rolling shutter camera calibration. It provides accurate spatial and temporal calibration, widely used in robotics and autonomous driving.
en.content: The repository contains C++ source code, ROS nodes, Docker scripts, Python tools, and detailed Wiki documentation. Main modules include calibration algorithms, camera models, visualization tools, and report generators.
en.stack: Built on C++ and ROS (supports Ubuntu 16.04/18.04/20.04), depends on Eigen, OpenCV, etc., and provides Docker support for easy installation.
en.hot: As a standard tool for visual-inertial calibration, Kalibr has 5698 stars, and despite only 2 new stars today, its core role in robotics and continuous maintenance keeps it on the C++ trending list.
uses: Robotics researchers: need precise camera and IMU calibration for visual-inertial navigation.
Autonomous driving engineers: calibrate multi-sensor fusion systems to ensure data synchronization.
SLAM developers: calibrate cameras and IMUs before building visual SLAM systems.
Academic researchers: use as a baseline tool to validate new calibration algorithms or sensor setups.

zh.tag: 分布式存储平台，统一对象、块与文件存储
zh.what: Ceph 是一个开源的分布式存储系统，提供对象存储、块存储和文件系统存储，设计用于大规模扩展和高可用性。它通过统一的集群将存储资源池化，支持多种接口，适用于云基础设施和大数据场景。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Ceph 的完整源代码，包括核心守护进程（如 MON、OSD、MDS）、管理工具（ceph CLI）、以及构建脚本和文档。代码主要用 C++ 编写，并包含 Python 辅助脚本。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 Boost、gRPC、RocksDB 等库，构建系统采用 CMake 和 Ninja。支持多种操作系统，包括 Linux 发行版。
zh.hot: 作为老牌分布式存储项目，Ceph 持续活跃，今日新增 9 星，总星数近 1.7 万，在 C++ 日榜中位列第 17，体现了其长期稳定的社区关注度。
uses: 云平台和 OpenStack 部署中提供统一存储后端，支持块、对象和文件接口。
大数据分析和 AI 训练场景中作为高可靠、可扩展的存储层。
企业级存储解决方案，用于替代传统 SAN/NAS，降低硬件成本。
开发者和研究人员学习分布式系统设计和实现。

en.tag: Scalable distributed storage unifying object, block, and file
en.what: Ceph is an open-source distributed storage system providing object, block, and file storage, designed for massive scalability and high availability. It pools storage resources into a unified cluster, supporting multiple interfaces for cloud infrastructure and big data.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code of Ceph, including core daemons (MON, OSD, MDS), management tools (ceph CLI), build scripts, and documentation. The code is primarily C++ with Python helper scripts.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, depends on Boost, gRPC, RocksDB, etc., built with CMake and Ninja. Supports various Linux distributions.
en.hot: As a veteran distributed storage project, Ceph remains active, gaining 9 stars today and nearly 17k total, ranking 17th on the C++ daily trending list, reflecting sustained community interest.
uses: Provides unified storage backend for cloud platforms and OpenStack, supporting block, object, and file interfaces.
Serves as a reliable, scalable storage layer for big data analytics and AI training.
Enterprise storage solution to replace traditional SAN/NAS, reducing hardware costs.
Developers and researchers learning distributed system design and implementation.

zh.tag: 全球最流行的开源关系型数据库
zh.what: MySQL Server 是全球最流行的开源关系型数据库管理系统，提供高性能、可靠的数据存储与查询。MySQL Cluster 则提供实时、开源的分布式事务数据库能力。
zh.content: 仓库包含 MySQL 服务器和 MySQL Cluster 的完整源代码，涵盖存储引擎（如 InnoDB）、SQL 解析器、优化器、复制、集群管理等核心组件。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C/C++ 编写，依赖多种平台库，支持 Linux、Windows、macOS 等主流操作系统。
zh.hot: 作为数据库领域的基石项目，MySQL 拥有庞大的用户基础和生态，尽管今日新增 star 不多，但持续保持高关注度，位列 C++ 趋势榜。
uses: 后端开发者：作为 Web 应用、微服务等场景的首选数据库，提供稳定可靠的数据存储。
数据库管理员：用于生产环境的部署、调优、监控和备份恢复。
数据架构师：评估和设计基于 MySQL 或 MySQL Cluster 的高可用、分布式数据方案。

en.tag: The world's most popular open-source relational database
en.what: MySQL Server is the world's most popular open-source relational database management system, offering high-performance, reliable data storage and querying. MySQL Cluster provides real-time, open-source distributed transactional database capabilities.
en.content: The repository contains the complete source code for MySQL Server and MySQL Cluster, including core components such as storage engines (e.g., InnoDB), SQL parser, optimizer, replication, and cluster management.
en.stack: Primarily written in C/C++, with dependencies on various platform libraries, supporting major operating systems like Linux, Windows, and macOS.
en.hot: As a cornerstone project in the database field, MySQL has a massive user base and ecosystem. Despite modest daily star gains, it maintains high visibility, ranking on the C++ trending list.
uses: Backend developers: use MySQL as the go-to database for web applications, microservices, and more, ensuring reliable data storage.
Database administrators: deploy, tune, monitor, and back up MySQL in production environments.
Data architects: evaluate and design high-availability, distributed data solutions based on MySQL or MySQL Cluster.

zh.tag: 跨厂商 GPU 的 3D 高斯泼溅训练器，视频到网格一站式
zh.what: Spirula Studio 是一个独立的 3D 高斯泼溅（3DGS）训练工具，能从原始照片或视频直接生成高斯模型，并进一步转换为带纹理的网格。它无需 Python/PyTorch 或单独安装 COLMAP，支持 NVIDIA、AMD、Intel 和 Apple GPU，并原生支持鱼眼和 360° 相机。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的训练 GUI 和 CLI，内置 SfM、AI 遮罩、视频帧提取、网格化等功能，并提供预编译的 Windows/Linux/macOS 二进制文件。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++，后端基于 Vulkan 计算（也支持 CUDA），采用量化训练以节省显存，并集成了改进的 MCMC/IGS+/MRNF 策略。
zh.hot: 今日新增 53 星，登上 C++ 趋势榜，因为它提供了跨厂商 GPU 支持、无需 COLMAP 的一体化流程，以及 8GB 显存即可训练千万级高斯的极致效率。
uses: 3D 重建爱好者和研究者，希望快速从视频生成高质量高斯泼溅模型。
需要处理 360° 或鱼眼相机数据的开发者，无需预处理畸变。
寻求跨平台（Windows/Linux/macOS）且支持多种 GPU 品牌的用户。

en.tag: Cross-vendor 3D Gaussian Splatting trainer: video to splat to mesh, Vulkan or CUDA
en.what: Spirula Studio is a self-contained 3D Gaussian Splatting trainer that turns raw photos/videos into Gaussian models and then into textured meshes. It requires no Python/PyTorch or separate COLMAP install, runs on NVIDIA, AMD, Intel, and Apple GPUs, and natively supports fisheye and 360° cameras.
en.content: The repo includes a full training GUI and CLI, with built-in SfM, AI masking, video frame extraction, meshing, and more, plus prebuilt binaries for Windows/Linux/macOS.
en.stack: Primarily C++, with a Vulkan compute backend (CUDA also supported), quantized training for VRAM efficiency, and a combined MCMC/IGS+/MRNF strategy.
en.hot: Gaining 53 stars today and trending in C++, it stands out for cross-vendor GPU support, an all-in-one pipeline without COLMAP, and extreme VRAM efficiency enabling 10M Gaussians in 8GB.
uses: 3D reconstruction enthusiasts and researchers who want to quickly generate high-quality splats from video.
Developers working with 360° or fisheye camera data, without needing undistortion preprocessing.
Users seeking a cross-platform tool (Windows/Linux/macOS) that supports multiple GPU vendors.

zh.tag: 智能家居互操作标准 Matter 的官方开源 SDK
zh.what: Matter（原 Project CHIP）旨在统一智能家居设备通信协议，让不同品牌设备能无缝协作。该仓库提供完整的参考实现，帮助制造商快速开发兼容 Matter 的设备，同时提升消费者的设备兼容性。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Matter 协议栈的 C++ 实现、多平台示例（如 ESP32、EFR32、Android 等）以及丰富的文档和测试仪表盘。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++，支持多种嵌入式平台和操作系统，依赖 Zephyr/FreeRTOS 等 RTOS，并集成 CI 自动化构建与测试。
zh.hot: 作为智能家居互操作标准的官方实现，持续获得关注，当前 8.9k star 且每日新增，反映了 Matter 生态的活跃。
uses: 智能家居设备制造商：快速实现 Matter 兼容，缩短产品上市时间。
嵌入式开发者：学习参考协议栈实现，适配新硬件平台。
测试与认证机构：利用测试用例和仪表盘验证设备互操作性。

en.tag: Official open-source SDK for Matter, the smart home interoperability standard
en.what: Matter (formerly Project CHIP) unifies smart home device communication protocols, enabling seamless interoperability across brands. This repository provides a full reference implementation, helping manufacturers build Matter-compatible devices and improving consumer compatibility.
en.content: The repo contains the Matter protocol stack in C++, multi-platform examples (e.g., ESP32, EFR32, Android), plus extensive docs and test dashboards.
en.stack: Primarily C++, supporting various embedded platforms and OSes, with dependencies on RTOS like Zephyr/FreeRTOS, and integrated CI for automated builds and tests.
en.hot: As the official implementation of the smart home interoperability standard, it maintains steady attention, with 8.9k stars and daily additions, reflecting the vibrant Matter ecosystem.
uses: Smart home device manufacturers: quickly achieve Matter compliance and shorten time-to-market.
Embedded developers: study the reference stack and port to new hardware platforms.
Testing and certification bodies: use test suites and dashboards to verify interoperability.

zh.tag: Google 开源的 C++ 通用库，补充标准库
zh.what: Abseil 是 Google 内部 C++ 代码库的开源版本，旨在补充 C++ 标准库的不足。它提供标准库缺失的组件，或针对特殊需求提供替代实现，并已在 Google 生产环境中广泛测试和使用。
zh.content: 仓库包含多个库组件，如 base、algorithm、cleanup、container 等，每个组件位于独立的子目录中，并附有构建配置和文档。
zh.stack: 使用 C++17 编写，支持 Bazel 和 CMake 构建系统，依赖 C++ 标准库。
zh.hot: 作为 Google 官方开源库，拥有 18k+ stars，是 C++ 开发者的常用工具集，虽然今日新增不多，但长期稳定受欢迎。
uses: C++ 开发者需要标准库之外的实用工具时，可快速引入 Abseil 组件。
希望借鉴 Google 内部 C++ 最佳实践和代码风格的项目团队。
需要跨平台、高性能且经过生产验证的基础库的应用程序。

en.tag: Google's open-source C++ common libraries augmenting the standard library
en.what: Abseil is an open-source collection of C++ library code from Google's internal codebase, designed to augment the C++ standard library. It provides missing pieces or alternatives for special needs, extensively tested in production.
en.content: The repository contains multiple library components such as base, algorithm, cleanup, container, each in separate subdirectories with build configurations and documentation.
en.stack: Written in C++17, supports Bazel and CMake build systems, depends on the C++ standard library.
en.hot: As an official Google open-source library with 18k+ stars, it's a common toolkit for C++ developers. Although today's increment is small, it remains consistently popular.
uses: C++ developers needing utilities beyond the standard library can quickly adopt Abseil components.
Teams looking to follow Google's internal C++ best practices and coding style.
Applications requiring a cross-platform, high-performance, production-proven base library.

zh.tag: 开源自动驾驶仪系统，支持多旋翼、固定翼、地面车辆与潜艇
zh.what: ArduPilot 是一套成熟的开源自动驾驶仪软件，支持无人机、固定翼飞机、地面车辆和水下航行器。它提供飞行控制、导航和任务规划功能，广泛应用于业余爱好者和专业领域。
zh.content: 仓库包含 ArduPlane、ArduCopter、ArduRover、ArduSub 等主要飞行器固件，以及库、工具和测试套件。代码结构清晰，支持多种硬件平台。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 ChibiOS/RTOS 或 Linux 等实时操作系统，支持多种传感器和通信协议。
zh.hot: ArduPilot 拥有超过 15,000 颗星，是无人机和自动驾驶领域最受欢迎的开源项目之一。其持续的更新和强大的社区支持使其在 GitHub 上保持热度。
uses: 无人机爱好者和 DIY 玩家，用于构建和定制自己的飞行器。
专业无人机服务商，用于农业、测绘、巡检等商业应用。
研究人员和开发者，用于自动驾驶和机器人技术的实验与开发。

en.tag: Open-source autopilot system for copters, planes, rovers, and subs
en.what: ArduPilot is a mature open-source autopilot software suite supporting drones, fixed-wing aircraft, ground vehicles, and underwater vehicles. It provides flight control, navigation, and mission planning capabilities, widely used by hobbyists and professionals.
en.content: The repository contains firmware for ArduPlane, ArduCopter, ArduRover, ArduSub, along with libraries, tools, and test suites. The code is well-structured and supports multiple hardware platforms.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, relies on real-time operating systems like ChibiOS/RTOS or Linux, and supports various sensors and communication protocols.
en.hot: With over 15,000 stars, ArduPilot is one of the most popular open-source projects in the drone and autopilot domain. Its continuous updates and strong community support keep it trending on GitHub.
uses: Drone enthusiasts and DIY builders who want to create and customize their own aircraft.
Professional drone service providers for commercial applications like agriculture, mapping, and inspection.
Researchers and developers experimenting with autonomous navigation and robotics.

zh.tag: Tenstorrent AI 芯片的低层内核编程与神经网络算子库
zh.what: TT-Metal 是 Tenstorrent 面向其 AI 加速器的软件栈，包含 TT-NN（Python/C++ 神经网络算子库）和 TT-Metalium（低层内核编程模型）。它让开发者能够为 Tenstorrent 硬件编写高性能内核，并运行优化过的 LLM 等模型。
zh.content: 仓库包含 TT-NN 算子库、TT-Metalium 内核编程接口、模型演示（如 Llama 3.3 70B、Qwen 2.5 7B）、安装指南和 API 文档。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++，提供 Python 绑定；依赖硬件（如 Wormhole、Blackhole），并集成 vLLM 等推理服务器。
zh.hot: 尽管 star 数相对较低（1660），但作为 Tenstorrent 官方软件栈，它吸引了关注 AI 硬件和低层优化的开发者，今日新增 4 星并登上 C++ 趋势榜。
uses: 为 Tenstorrent AI 加速器编写高性能内核的开发者
在 Tenstorrent 硬件上部署和优化 LLM 的 AI 工程师
研究神经网络算子实现和硬件协同设计的爱好者

en.tag: Low-level kernel programming model and NN operator library for Tenstorrent AI accelerators
en.what: TT-Metal is Tenstorrent's software stack for its AI accelerators, featuring TT-NN (a Python/C++ neural network operator library) and TT-Metalium (a low-level kernel programming model). It enables developers to write high-performance kernels for Tenstorrent hardware and run optimized models like LLMs.
en.content: The repository includes the TT-NN operator library, TT-Metalium kernel programming interface, model demos (e.g., Llama 3.3 70B, Qwen 2.5 7B), installation guide, and API documentation.
en.stack: Primarily C++ with Python bindings; depends on Tenstorrent hardware (e.g., Wormhole, Blackhole) and integrates with inference servers like vLLM.
en.hot: Despite a relatively modest star count (1660), it's the official software stack for Tenstorrent hardware, attracting developers interested in AI accelerators and low-level optimization; it gained 4 stars today and hit the C++ trending list.
uses: Developers writing high-performance kernels for Tenstorrent AI accelerators
AI engineers deploying and optimizing LLMs on Tenstorrent hardware
Enthusiasts researching neural network operator implementation and hardware-software co-design

zh.tag: 为现代 Windows 体验打造的 7-Zip 衍生压缩工具
zh.what: NanaZip 是一款开源文件压缩/解压工具，从知名开源压缩软件 7-Zip 分叉而来，旨在提供现代化的 Windows 体验。它支持多种压缩格式，并深度集成 Windows 11 的右键菜单和系统主题。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的源代码、文档、图标资源以及用于构建和发布的 GitHub Actions 工作流。项目提供 Release 和 Preview 两个渠道，并支持通过 Microsoft Store 安装。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 开发，基于 7-Zip 的代码库，并利用 Windows 平台特性（如 WinUI、MSIX 打包）来提供现代化界面和交互。
zh.hot: 凭借对 7-Zip 的现代化改进和 Windows 11 的深度集成，NanaZip 在 GitHub 上积累了超过 1.5 万星标，今日新增 13 星，位列 C++ 趋势榜第 20 名，持续受到 Windows 用户欢迎。
uses: Windows 11 用户，希望获得更现代、更美观的压缩工具体验
需要与 Windows 资源管理器无缝集成（如右键菜单）的日常用户
关注开源、希望参与贡献或定制压缩工具的开发者和高级用户

en.tag: A 7-Zip derivative file archiver for the modern Windows experience
en.what: NanaZip is an open-source file archiver forked from 7-Zip, designed to offer a modern Windows experience. It supports various archive formats and integrates deeply with Windows 11's context menu and system themes.
en.content: The repository contains full source code, documentation, icon assets, and GitHub Actions workflows for building and releasing. It offers both Release and Preview channels and is available via Microsoft Store.
en.stack: Developed primarily in C++, based on 7-Zip's codebase, and leverages Windows platform features such as WinUI and MSIX packaging for a modern UI and interaction.
en.hot: With its modern improvements to 7-Zip and deep integration with Windows 11, NanaZip has amassed over 15k stars on GitHub, with 13 new stars today, ranking 20th on the C++ trending list, and remains popular among Windows users.
uses: Windows 11 users seeking a more modern and visually appealing archiver
Everyday users needing seamless integration with Windows Explorer, such as context menu
Developers and power users interested in open source and contributing to or customizing an archiver

zh.tag: AI 代理技能，一键生成可验证的交互式系统架构图
zh.what: Archify 是一个 AI 代理技能，可将代码库或系统描述转化为精美的交互式系统地图。它支持五种图表类型、四种预设、明暗主题和内置品牌标识，并能生成自包含的 HTML 文件，方便演示和分享。
zh.content: 仓库包含技能定义、文档、示例和生成器代码，支持通过 npx 命令安装到 Raven、Cursor、Claude Code 等代理。提供项目页面、场景指南和画廊，展示不同用例。
zh.stack: 主要基于 HTML，使用 TypeScript 生成确定性校验的 JSON IR，并输出 HTML、PNG、SVG、WebM 等格式。依赖 npx 进行安装，支持多种 AI 代理平台。
zh.hot: 凭借 18k+ 星标和日增千星的势头，Archify 满足了开发者对可视化架构文档的迫切需求，尤其在 AI 辅助开发场景下，能快速生成可验证的图表，提升代码审查和沟通效率。
uses: 开发者希望在代码审查前快速生成架构对比图，确保变更可验证。
技术写作者或架构师需要为系统设计生成交互式演示文档，便于向团队或客户展示。
AI 代理用户希望将代码库映射为可视化图表，以便更直观地理解系统结构和数据流。

en.tag: Agent skill that turns codebases into beautiful, verifiable interactive architecture diagrams
en.what: Archify is an agent skill that transforms a codebase or system description into a polished, interactive system map. It supports five diagram types, four presets, dark/light themes, and built-in brand marks, producing self-contained HTML files for easy presentation and sharing.
en.content: The repository contains skill definitions, documentation, examples, and generator code, installable via npx into agents like Raven, Cursor, and Claude Code. It includes a project page, scenario guide, and gallery showcasing various use cases.
en.stack: Primarily HTML-based, using TypeScript to generate deterministically checked JSON IR, outputting HTML, PNG, SVG, WebM, and more. Installed via npx, compatible with multiple AI agent platforms.
en.hot: With 18k+ stars and a daily gain of 1k, Archify addresses the urgent need for visual architecture documentation, especially in AI-assisted development, enabling quick generation of verifiable diagrams that boost code review and communication efficiency.
uses: Developers who want to quickly generate architecture comparison diagrams before code review to ensure changes are verifiable.
Technical writers or architects needing interactive presentation documents for system designs to share with teams or clients.
AI agent users who want to map codebases into visual diagrams for better understanding of system structure and data flow.

zh.tag: 浏览器里的实时全球态势感知模拟器
zh.what: 这是一个在浏览器中运行的间谍卫星模拟器，但数据是真实的。它在一个逼真的3D地球上实时展示飞机、船舶、卫星、地震、交通和公共摄像头等公开信号，并支持语音控制。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的Web应用源码，包括3D地球渲染、实时数据图层、语音控制AI代理、以及清晰的标注（如模拟与实时区分）。
zh.stack: 主要使用JavaScript，可能涉及Three.js或类似3D库、WebSocket实时数据、语音识别API等。
zh.hot: 该项目在GitHub Trending日榜排名第一，今日新增近2000星，因其独特的'真实数据间谍卫星'概念和病毒式传播的YouTube系列而迅速走红。
uses: 对开源情报、地理空间数据可视化感兴趣的开发者或研究者。
希望体验实时全球动态（航班、船舶、卫星等）的科技爱好者。
教育场景中用于演示实时数据源和3D可视化技术。

en.tag: A real-time global situational awareness simulator in your browser
en.what: A spy-satellite simulator in your browser with real data. It visualizes live aircraft, ships, satellites, earthquakes, traffic, and public cameras on a photorealistic 3D globe, with hands-free voice control.
en.content: The repo contains the full web app source code, including 3D globe rendering, live data layers, a voice-controlled AI agent, and clear labeling of simulated vs. live feeds.
en.stack: Primarily JavaScript, likely using Three.js or similar 3D libraries, WebSocket for real-time data, and speech recognition APIs.
en.hot: Ranked #1 on GitHub Trending daily with ~2,000 stars added today, it went viral due to its unique 'real-data spy satellite' concept and the popular YouTube series behind it.
uses: Developers or researchers interested in open-source intelligence and geospatial data visualization.
Tech enthusiasts who want to experience real-time global dynamics (flights, ships, satellites, etc.).
Educational settings for demonstrating real-time data sources and 3D visualization techniques.

zh.tag: 一键开启沉浸式多智能体课堂
zh.what: OpenMAIC 是一个开源的多智能体交互式课堂平台，让用户通过点击即可获得沉浸式的多智能体学习体验。它模拟真实课堂环境，由多个 AI 智能体扮演不同角色（如教师、学生），进行互动教学。
zh.content: 仓库包含前端界面（Next.js/React）、后端逻辑（LangGraph 编排）、智能体配置、部署模板（Vercel）、文档和社区资源。支持 OpenClaw 集成和 Lemonade 本地 AI。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript，使用 Next.js 16、React 19、LangGraph 1.1 构建，支持多种 LLM 提供商（如 OpenAI、Anthropic）的 API 密钥配置。
zh.hot: 凭借创新的多智能体教学理念和极简的一键部署体验，在 GitHub 上迅速走红，24 小时内新增 907 星，总星数突破 2.2 万，位列 Trending 日榜第 5。
uses: 教育工作者：快速搭建 AI 驱动的互动课堂，探索新型教学模式。
AI 开发者：研究多智能体协作与交互，参考其架构和实现。
学习者：通过沉浸式多智能体对话，获得个性化学习体验。
开源爱好者：部署和定制自己的智能体课堂，参与社区贡献。

en.tag: One-click immersive multi-agent learning classroom
en.what: OpenMAIC is an open-source multi-agent interactive classroom platform that provides an immersive learning experience with one click. It simulates a real classroom where multiple AI agents play different roles (e.g., teacher, students) to conduct interactive teaching.
en.content: The repo includes frontend UI (Next.js/React), backend logic (LangGraph orchestration), agent configurations, deployment templates (Vercel), documentation, and community resources. Supports OpenClaw integration and Lemonade local AI.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript, using Next.js 16, React 19, LangGraph 1.1, and supports multiple LLM providers (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic) via API keys.
en.hot: Its innovative multi-agent teaching concept and one-click deployment experience have made it viral on GitHub, gaining 907 stars in 24 hours, surpassing 22k total stars, and ranking #5 on the daily trending list.
uses: Educators: Quickly set up AI-driven interactive classrooms to explore new teaching models.
AI developers: Study multi-agent collaboration and interaction, referencing its architecture and implementation.
Learners: Gain personalized learning experiences through immersive multi-agent dialogues.
Open-source enthusiasts: Deploy and customize their own agent classroom, contributing to the community.

zh.tag: 让 AI 编码助手写出符合现代 Go 规范的代码
zh.what: JetBrains 官方项目，为 AI 编码代理提供一套规则，使其生成代码时优先使用现代 Go 语言特性和标准库 API（如 slices.Contains、cmp.Or 等）。它解决了模型训练数据滞后和频率偏差导致的过时代码问题。
zh.content: 仓库包含 FEATURES.md（完整特性列表及示例）和面向不同代理（Junie、Claude Code、Codex、Cursor）的安装说明，通过 marketplace 或 skills.sh 分发。
zh.stack: 主要基于 Go 编写，要求 Go 1.25+，通过 go install 安装 CLI，不修改用户项目。
zh.hot: 本周新增 1213 星，位列趋势榜第 4，因为 AI 编码日益普及，开发者急需让代理生成符合现代实践的代码。
uses: 使用 AI 编码助手（如 Junie、Claude Code）的 Go 开发者，希望生成更符合现代规范的代码。
团队希望统一 Go 代码风格，减少人工审查中纠正过时写法的工作量。
对 Go 新特性（如 Go 1.26 的 errors.AsType）感兴趣的开发者，可参考特性列表学习。

en.tag: Guidelines to make AI coding agents write modern Go code
en.what: An official JetBrains project providing guidelines for AI coding agents to generate modern Go code, preferring recent language features and stdlib APIs like slices.Contains and cmp.Or. It addresses outdated code caused by training data lag and frequency bias.
en.content: Contains FEATURES.md with a complete list of features and examples, plus installation instructions for various agents (Junie, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) via marketplace or skills.sh.
en.stack: Primarily Go-based, requires Go 1.25+, installs a CLI via go install, and never modifies user projects.
en.hot: Gained 1213 stars this week, ranking #4 on trending, as AI coding adoption grows and developers seek to ensure agents produce modern code.
uses: Go developers using AI coding assistants like Junie or Claude Code to generate more idiomatic code.
Teams aiming to standardize Go code style and reduce manual review effort for outdated patterns.
Developers interested in learning new Go features (e.g., errors.AsType from Go 1.26) via the feature list.

zh.tag: 把任意 AI 代理变成科学家的技能库，覆盖生物、化学、医学等 163 个技能
zh.what: 这是一个开源的科学 Agent 技能库，提供 163 个即用型技能和 100+ 科学数据库，覆盖生物学、化学、医学和药物发现。它兼容 Cursor、Claude Code、Codex 等主流 AI 代理，并遵循开放的 Agent Skills 标准，让任何 AI 代理都能执行科学任务。
zh.content: 仓库包含技能定义、测试用例、文档和示例，以及一个可选的本地 AI 协同科学家工具 K-Dense BYOK。技能以标准格式组织，便于集成和扩展。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python，依赖 Agent Skills 标准，支持多种 AI 代理平台。
zh.hot: 凭借 3.47 万星标和 17.5 万科学家用户，它填补了 AI 代理在科学领域应用的空白，成为最受欢迎的科学技能库。
uses: 科研人员：快速让 AI 代理执行文献分析、实验设计等任务。
开发者：为 AI 代理集成科学技能，构建垂直领域应用。
教育者：在教学中使用 AI 辅助科学探索，提升学生参与度。

en.tag: Turn any AI agent into an AI Scientist with 163 validated skills and 100+ scientific databases.
en.what: An open-source library of scientific Agent Skills, offering 163 ready-to-use skills and 100+ scientific databases across biology, chemistry, medicine, and drug discovery. It works with Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, and other AI agents, following the open Agent Skills standard, enabling any agent to perform scientific tasks.
en.content: The repo contains skill definitions, tests, documentation, examples, and an optional local AI co-scientist tool K-Dense BYOK. Skills are organized in a standard format for easy integration and extension.
en.stack: Primarily Python-based, relying on the Agent Skills standard, compatible with multiple AI agent platforms.
en.hot: With 34.7k stars and 175k+ scientist users, it fills a gap in AI agent applications for science, becoming the most popular scientific skills library.
uses: Researchers: quickly enable AI agents to perform literature analysis, experiment design, etc.
Developers: integrate scientific skills into AI agents to build domain-specific applications.
Educators: use AI-assisted scientific exploration in teaching to boost student engagement.

zh.tag: 开源 SEO 分析平台，支持 AI Agent 与 MCP 工具链集成
zh.what: OpenSEO 是 Semrush 和 Ahrefs 的开源替代品，提供关键词研究、排名追踪、竞品洞察、外链审计与站点诊断等核心 SEO 工作流。它采用按量付费模式，用户只需接入自己的 DataForSEO API 密钥即可使用，无需订阅。同时，它内置 MCP 服务器和可复用的 Agent Skills，让 Claude Code、OpenClaw 等 AI 代理直接调用 SEO 数据完成自动化任务。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的前后端应用代码与现代化 UI，支持 Docker 和 Cloudflare 自托管，内置 MCP 服务器以及预设的 Agent Skills（如 keyword-research、competitor-analysis、link-prospecting）。文档涵盖 API 密钥配置、Google Search Console 接入、SEO 成本参考及本地开发指南。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript 构建，前端采用现代 UI 框架，后端依赖 DataForSEO API 获取 SEO 数据，并通过 MCP 协议与外部 AI Agent 通信；支持 Docker 容器化部署与 Cloudflare 边缘托管。
zh.hot: 在 SEO 工具普遍昂贵且功能臃肿的背景下，它以开源、按量付费、可自托管的定位迅速获得关注；4,405 Stars 中本月新增 2,187 颗，登上 GitHub TypeScript 月榜第 17 名，其对 MCP 与 AI Agent 的原生集成进一步放大了开发者与增长团队的兴趣。
uses: 独立开发者 / 小团队 —— 无需订阅高价 SaaS，用自有 API 密钥低成本完成 SEO 监控与关键词研究。
AI 工程师 / Agent 开发者 —— 通过 MCP 将实时 SEO 数据接入 Claude Code、OpenClaw 等智能体，实现自动化内容策略。
增长与营销团队 —— 利用预设 Agent Skills 快速完成竞品分析、外链挖掘和排名追踪。
隐私敏感企业 —— 支持 Docker/Cloudflare 自托管，完全掌控数据与成本。

en.tag: Open-source SEO suite with AI agent & MCP integration for self-hosting
en.what: OpenSEO is an open-source alternative to Semrush and Ahrefs, offering keyword research, rank tracking, competitor insights, backlink audits, and site audits. It uses a pay-as-you-go model with your own DataForSEO API key instead of expensive subscriptions. It also exposes an MCP server and reusable Agent Skills so AI agents like Claude Code and OpenClaw can interact directly with SEO data.
en.content: The repository contains a full-stack application with a modern UI, supporting Docker and Cloudflare self-hosting, along with a built-in MCP server and pre-built Agent Skills (e.g., keyword-research, competitor-analysis, link-prospecting). Documentation covers API key setup, Google Search Console integration, SEO cost references, and local development guides.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript, it features a modern frontend UI, relies on the DataForSEO API for search data, and communicates with external AI agents via the MCP protocol. It supports Docker containerization and Cloudflare edge hosting.
en.hot: It gained rapid traction as a free, pay-as-you-go, self-hostable alternative to expensive and bloated SEO suites; with 4,405 stars and 2,187 added this month alone—ranking 17th on GitHub's monthly TypeScript trending list—its native MCP and AI Agent support has further driven interest from developers and growth teams.
uses: Indie developers and small teams —— Avoid expensive subscriptions by using your own API key for low-cost SEO monitoring and keyword research.
AI engineers and agent builders —— Feed real-time SEO data into Claude Code, OpenClaw, or other agents via MCP for automated content strategy.
Growth and marketing teams —— Use pre-built Agent Skills to quickly run competitor analysis, link prospecting, and rank tracking.
Privacy-conscious organizations —— Self-host via Docker or Cloudflare to maintain full control over data and costs.

zh.tag: DHH 打造的精致现代 Linux 发行版
zh.what: Omarchy 是一个由 DHH（Ruby on Rails 创始人）打造的 Linux 发行版，注重美观、现代和明确的观点。它提供了一套完整的桌面环境，包括终端、编辑器、AI 工具等，并配有详尽的用户手册。
zh.content: 仓库包含一个 manual/ 目录，内含 51 篇 Markdown 格式的手册章节，涵盖入门、导航、应用、配置等主题。此外还有安装脚本和配置文件，用于构建和定制系统。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Shell 脚本进行系统配置和安装，依赖 Linux 生态中的各种开源工具（如 Neovim、终端模拟器等）。手册使用 Markdown 编写，并托管在 learn.omacom.io。
zh.hot: 凭借 DHH 的知名度和对美观、现代体验的强调，Omarchy 在 GitHub 上迅速走红，本周新增 6475 星，总星数达 34824，登上趋势榜第三。
uses: 喜欢 DHH 风格、追求开箱即用且美观的 Linux 桌面用户
希望从 Mac/Windows 迁移到 Linux 并希望有完整指南的用户
对 Linux 发行版定制和配置感兴趣的开发者

en.tag: A beautiful, modern & opinionated Linux distro by DHH
en.what: Omarchy is a Linux distribution created by DHH (creator of Ruby on Rails), focusing on beauty, modernity, and strong opinions. It provides a complete desktop environment including terminal, editor, AI tools, and comes with an extensive user manual.
