en.content: The repository contains a manual/ directory with 51 Markdown chapters covering topics like getting started, navigation, applications, and configuration. It also includes installation scripts and configuration files for building and customizing the system.
en.stack: Primarily uses Shell scripts for system configuration and installation, relying on various open-source tools from the Linux ecosystem (e.g., Neovim, terminal emulators). The manual is written in Markdown and hosted on learn.omacom.io.
en.hot: Thanks to DHH's fame and the emphasis on beautiful, modern experience, Omarchy quickly gained popularity on GitHub, adding 6,475 stars this week to reach 34,824 total, ranking #3 on the trending list.
uses: Linux desktop users who appreciate DHH's style and want a beautiful, out-of-the-box experience
Users migrating from Mac/Windows to Linux who want a comprehensive guide
Developers interested in customizing and configuring a Linux distribution

zh.tag: 全自动去除语言模型审查的优化工具
zh.what: Heretic 是一个无需昂贵后训练即可移除 Transformer 语言模型审查（安全对齐）的工具。它结合方向消融（abliteration）与基于 TPE 的参数优化器，自动寻找高质量消融参数，同时最小化拒绝次数和与原始模型的 KL 散度，从而保留模型智能。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 Python 实现、命令行界面、自动优化流程、支持多种模型架构（稠密、MoE、混合如 Qwen3.5），并提供示例配置和基准测试结果。
zh.stack: 基于 Python，依赖 PyTorch、Transformers、Optuna（TPE 优化器）等，实现方向消融和参数优化。
zh.hot: 2.87 万星标，日增 150，登上日榜第 6。它让非专家也能一键去除模型审查，且效果媲美人工调优，引发广泛关注。
uses: AI 研究人员和开发者，希望快速去除模型审查而不损失性能。
对模型安全对齐机制感兴趣，想探索方向消融技术的实践者。
需要定制模型行为、去除内容限制的普通用户，无需深入理解内部原理。

en.tag: Fully automatic censorship removal for language models via TPE-based optimization
en.what: Heretic is a tool that removes censorship (safety alignment) from transformer-based language models without expensive post-training. It combines directional ablation (abliteration) with a TPE-based parameter optimizer to automatically find high-quality parameters that minimize refusals and KL divergence from the original model, preserving intelligence.
en.content: The repository contains a full Python implementation, CLI, automatic optimization pipeline, support for dense, MoE, and hybrid models (e.g., Qwen3.5), along with example configs and benchmark results.
en.stack: Built with Python, leveraging PyTorch, Transformers, and Optuna for TPE-based optimization, implementing directional ablation.
en.hot: With 28.7k stars and +150 daily, ranking #6 on the daily trend, it enables non-experts to decensor models with one command, rivaling manual abliteration, sparking wide interest.
uses: AI researchers and developers seeking to remove model censorship quickly without performance loss.
Practitioners interested in safety alignment mechanisms and directional ablation techniques.
General users who need to customize model behavior or remove content restrictions without deep technical knowledge.

zh.tag: GPT-Image2 工业级提示词引擎与模板库
zh.what: 这是一个为 GPT-Image2 图像生成模型打造的提示词工程资源库，包含 500+ 逆向工程案例和 20+ 工业级模板，将提示词视为代码进行管理和复用。项目提供可视化网站用于浏览和复制提示词，并持续更新。

uses: AI 图像生成爱好者：快速获取高质量提示词，提升生成效果。
提示词工程师：学习逆向工程案例，提炼可复用的技能。
产品团队：将提示词作为代码管理，实现工业化生成流程。

en.tag: Industrial prompt engine & template library for GPT-Image2

Prompt engineers: learn from reverse-engineered cases and extract reusable skills.
Product teams: manage prompts as code for industrial generation workflows.

zh.tag: Cursor 官方插件规范与精选插件集
zh.what: 这是 Cursor 官方发布的插件仓库，包含插件规范（manifest 格式）和一系列官方/第三方插件，覆盖代码审查、文档可视化、CLI 设计、Gmail/Drive 集成等场景。每个插件独立成目录，通过 .cursor-plugin/plugin.json 声明。
zh.content: 仓库根目录下每个插件一个文件夹，如 continual-learning、cursor-team-kit、pr-review-canvas、orchestrate 等，另有 third_party 目录存放 Gmail、Google Drive 等第三方集成。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript，基于 Cursor SDK（@cursor/sdk），插件通过 plugin.json 清单定义，可能涉及 MCP、CLI 工具等。
zh.hot: Cursor 作为 AI 编辑器热度极高，官方插件仓库是生态扩展的关键入口，今日新增 27 星，总星数 2645，登上 TypeScript 日榜第 7 名，开发者关注如何用插件增强 AI 代理工作流。
uses: Cursor 用户：安装官方插件提升代码审查、文档浏览等效率
插件开发者：参考规范与示例创建自己的 Cursor 插件
团队协作：利用 Team Kit、Orchestrate 等插件优化 CI/CD 和并行任务处理

en.tag: Official Cursor plugin spec and curated plugins
en.what: This is the official Cursor plugin repository, containing the plugin specification (manifest format) and a collection of first-party and third-party plugins for code review, docs visualization, CLI design, Gmail/Drive integration, and more. Each plugin lives in its own directory with a .cursor-plugin/plugin.json manifest.
en.content: Each plugin is a standalone folder at the repo root, e.g., continual-learning, cursor-team-kit, pr-review-canvas, orchestrate, plus a third_party directory for Gmail, Google Drive, etc.
en.stack: Primarily TypeScript, built on the Cursor SDK (@cursor/sdk), plugins defined via plugin.json manifests, may involve MCP, CLI tools, etc.
en.hot: Cursor is a hot AI editor, and this official plugin repo is a key entry point for ecosystem expansion. With +27 stars today and 2,645 total, it ranks #7 on the TypeScript daily trending list, drawing developers interested in enhancing AI agent workflows via plugins.
uses: Cursor users: install official plugins to boost code review and docs navigation
Plugin developers: reference the spec and examples to create your own plugins
Teams: leverage Team Kit, Orchestrate, etc. to streamline CI/CD and parallel task handling

zh.tag: 截图秒变前端代码的AI工具
zh.what: 这是一个利用AI将截图、设计稿、Figma设计甚至屏幕录制转换为干净、可运行的前端代码（如HTML/Tailwind/React/Vue）的工具。用户只需上传图片或录制视频，即可获得对应的功能原型或代码实现。
zh.content: 仓库包含React/Vite前端和FastAPI后端，支持多种技术栈（HTML+Tailwind、React+Tailwind、Vue+Tailwind等），并集成多个AI模型（如Gemini、GPT、Claude）用于代码生成和图像处理。
zh.stack: 主要使用Python（FastAPI）作为后端，前端采用React/Vite，依赖OpenAI、Anthropic、Gemini等AI模型API，以及Replicate用于图像生成和编辑。
zh.hot: 凭借75.5K星标和今日新增326星，该工具因其直观的“截图转代码”功能而广受欢迎，大幅降低了前端开发门槛，尤其适合快速原型制作。
uses: 前端开发者快速将设计稿或截图转化为可用的HTML/CSS/React代码
产品经理或设计师验证UI概念，无需手动编写代码
教育场景中教学前端开发，通过示例直观展示代码生成

en.tag: Turn screenshots into clean frontend code with AI
en.what: This is a tool that uses AI to convert screenshots, mockups, Figma designs, and even screen recordings into clean, functional frontend code (e.g., HTML/Tailwind/React/Vue). Users upload an image or recording and get a working prototype or code implementation.
en.content: The repo includes a React/Vite frontend and a FastAPI backend, supporting multiple stacks (HTML+Tailwind, React+Tailwind, Vue+Tailwind, etc.) and integrating several AI models (e.g., Gemini, GPT, Claude) for code generation and image processing.
en.stack: Primarily Python (FastAPI) backend with React/Vite frontend, relying on AI model APIs from OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, and Replicate for image generation/editing.
en.hot: With 75.5K stars and +326 today, this tool is popular for its intuitive 'screenshot-to-code' capability, significantly lowering the barrier for frontend development, especially for rapid prototyping.
uses: Frontend developers quickly convert design mockups or screenshots into usable HTML/CSS/React code
Product managers or designers validate UI concepts without manually writing code
Educational settings for teaching frontend development by visually demonstrating code generation

zh.tag: TypeScript 优先的 schema 校验与类型推断库
zh.what: Zod 是一个 TypeScript 优先的校验库，通过定义 schema 来解析数据，并返回强类型、经过验证的结果。它支持静态类型推断，让开发者无需重复定义类型。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Zod 库的源代码、文档、测试以及示例。核心功能包括 schema 定义、解析、类型推断、JSON Schema 转换等。
zh.stack: TypeScript 编写，零外部依赖，支持 Node.js 和现代浏览器，核心包 gzipped 后仅 2kb。
zh.hot: Zod 在 TypeScript 生态中广受欢迎，因其简洁的 API 和强大的类型推断能力，star 数已达 43k，今日新增 31，持续在 GitHub 趋势榜上。
uses: 适用于 TypeScript 项目中的表单验证、API 请求/响应校验等场景。
适合需要运行时数据校验和静态类型安全的前端开发者。
可用于构建数据管道、配置解析等需要严格类型保证的后端服务。

en.tag: TypeScript-first schema validation with static type inference
en.what: Zod is a TypeScript-first validation library that lets you define schemas and parse data, returning strongly-typed, validated results. It provides static type inference, eliminating the need for duplicate type definitions.
en.content: The repository contains the source code, documentation, tests, and examples for the Zod library. Core features include schema definition, parsing, type inference, and JSON Schema conversion.
en.stack: Written in TypeScript, zero external dependencies, works in Node.js and all modern browsers, core bundle is 2kb gzipped.
en.hot: Zod is widely popular in the TypeScript ecosystem for its concise API and powerful type inference, with 43k stars and 31 new stars today, consistently trending on GitHub.
uses: Ideal for form validation, API request/response validation in TypeScript projects.
Suitable for frontend developers needing runtime data validation and static type safety.
Useful for building data pipelines, config parsing, and backend services requiring strict type guarantees.

zh.tag: 注重隐私与性能的 Twitter 替代前端
zh.what: Nitter 是一个免费开源的 Twitter 前端，旨在保护用户隐私并提升浏览性能。它无需 JavaScript 和广告，所有请求通过后端代理，防止 Twitter 追踪用户的 IP 或浏览器指纹。
zh.content: 仓库包含用 Nim 编写的 Nitter 源代码、配置文件、文档和社区维护的实例列表。项目还提供捐赠渠道和路线图，计划添加账户系统、推文归档等功能。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Nim 语言，依赖 Twitter 非官方 API，无需开发者账户。支持 RSS、主题和响应式设计，采用 AGPLv3 许可证。
zh.hot: 本周新增 467 星，总星数达 14096，位列周榜第 16。由于 X Corp. 发出停止函，项目面临法律挑战，引发社区关注和支持。
uses: 注重隐私的用户，希望在不被追踪的情况下浏览 Twitter 内容
开发者或极客，希望自建轻量级 Twitter 前端或研究其实现
需要 RSS 订阅 Twitter 动态的用户，无需登录或 JavaScript

en.tag: Privacy-focused and lightweight alternative Twitter front-end
en.what: Nitter is a free and open-source Twitter front-end focused on privacy and performance. It requires no JavaScript or ads, routes all requests through the backend, and prevents Twitter from tracking your IP or browser fingerprint.
en.content: The repository contains the Nim source code, configuration files, documentation, and a community-maintained list of instances. It also includes donation links and a roadmap for future features like account system and tweet archiving.
en.stack: Built primarily with Nim, leveraging Twitter's unofficial API without requiring a developer account. Supports RSS, themes, and responsive design, licensed under AGPLv3.
en.hot: Gained 467 stars this week, reaching 14,096 total, ranking 16th on the weekly trending. The project faces legal challenges from X Corp.'s cease-and-desist letters, sparking community attention and support.
uses: Privacy-conscious users who want to browse Twitter without being tracked
Developers or enthusiasts who want to self-host a lightweight Twitter front-end or study its implementation
Users who need RSS feeds for Twitter updates without logging in or enabling JavaScript

zh.tag: 聚合34家免费LLM提供商的统一API网关
zh.what: FreeLLMAPI 是一个开源项目，将数十家免费 LLM 提供商的免费额度聚合到一个 OpenAI 兼容的 /v1 端点后面。它提供智能路由、自动故障转移和加密密钥管理，让开发者无需管理多个 API 密钥即可访问大量免费模型。
zh.content: 仓库包含一个 TypeScript 编写的 API 网关，支持 Docker 自托管、桌面应用（macOS/Windows）和 Android 应用。它提供了一个仪表板，用于监控每月 token 预算，并包含一个自动更新的模型目录。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript，支持 Docker 部署，并提供桌面和移动端应用。依赖 OpenAI 兼容 API 标准，集成多个 LLM 提供商。
zh.hot: 该项目在 GitHub 上迅速走红，已获得近 2 万星标，日增 174 星。它解决了开发者对免费 LLM 资源分散、难以管理的痛点，提供了一站式解决方案。
uses: 个人开发者：快速集成多个免费 LLM，无需单独注册和付费。
原型开发：在项目初期使用免费模型验证想法，降低开发成本。
学习与研究：探索不同 LLM 的能力，进行对比实验。
自动化工具：为聊天机器人、内容生成等应用提供统一 API 接口。

en.tag: Unified API gateway aggregating 34 free LLM providers
en.what: FreeLLMAPI is an open-source project that aggregates free tiers from dozens of LLM providers behind a single OpenAI-compatible /v1 endpoint. It offers smart routing, automatic failover, and encrypted key management, allowing developers to access a vast array of free models without managing multiple API keys.
en.content: The repository contains a TypeScript-based API gateway with Docker self-hosting, desktop apps for macOS/Windows, and an Android app. It includes a dashboard for monitoring monthly token budgets and an auto-updating model catalog.
en.stack: Primarily TypeScript, with Docker deployment and desktop/mobile apps. Relies on OpenAI-compatible API standards and integrates multiple LLM providers.
en.hot: The project has gained nearly 20k stars with 174 new stars today, addressing the pain point of scattered free LLM resources by offering a one-stop solution.
uses: Individual developers: Quickly integrate multiple free LLMs without separate registrations and payments.
Prototyping: Validate ideas with free models in early stages, reducing development costs.
Learning and research: Explore capabilities of different LLMs and run comparative experiments.
Automation tools: Provide a unified API for chatbots, content generation, and more.

zh.tag: MCP 服务器精选清单，覆盖官方与社区实现
zh.what: 这是一个精选的 Model Context Protocol (MCP) 服务器列表，旨在帮助开发者发现和选择适合的 MCP 服务器来扩展 AI 模型的能力。它涵盖了文件访问、数据库连接、API 集成等多种用途的服务器，并提供了分类和标记以便快速筛选。
zh.content: 仓库包含服务器实现列表（按语言、范围、操作系统等标记）、客户端推荐、教程、社区链接，以及一个同步的网页目录。
zh.stack: 主要是一个 Markdown 文件，无特定技术栈，但涉及多种编程语言（Python、TypeScript、Go、Rust 等）的 MCP 服务器。
zh.hot: 随着 MCP 协议的普及，开发者需要快速找到可用的服务器，这个列表成为重要参考。93.7k 的 star 数反映了其高关注度，本周新增 919 星，持续热门。
uses: AI 应用开发者：寻找现成的 MCP 服务器来集成文件、数据库或外部 API，快速增强 AI 功能。
MCP 服务器作者：参考现有实现，了解分类和标记规范，并推广自己的服务器。
技术评估者：比较不同语言和范围的服务器，选择适合项目需求的方案。

en.tag: Curated list of MCP servers, official & community implementations
en.what: A curated list of Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, helping developers discover and choose servers to extend AI capabilities. It covers file access, database connections, API integrations, and more, with categories and tags for quick filtering.
en.content: Contains a list of server implementations (tagged by language, scope, OS), client recommendations, tutorials, community links, and a synced web directory.
en.stack: Primarily a Markdown file, no specific tech stack, but references MCP servers in various languages (Python, TypeScript, Go, Rust, etc.).
en.hot: As MCP protocol gains traction, developers need a quick reference for available servers, making this list essential. 93.7k stars reflect high interest, with 919 added this week, staying hot.
uses: AI app developers: find ready-made MCP servers to integrate files, databases, or external APIs, quickly enhancing AI capabilities.
MCP server authors: reference existing implementations, learn categorization and tagging conventions, and promote their own servers.
Tech evaluators: compare servers across languages and scopes to choose the right fit for project needs.

zh.tag: 中国专利智能助手：挖掘专利点、编写交底书、通俗解读
zh.what: 这是一个面向中国专利的 Agent 技能，帮助研发人员从项目材料中挖掘可申请的专利点，编写发明、实用新型、外观设计的交底书，并支持多轮迭代修改。它还能将公开专利解读成通俗笔记和知识图谱，沉淀为个人专利知识库，并辅助审查答复和政策嗅探。
zh.content: 仓库包含技能定义（SKILL.md）、安装说明（INSTALL.md）、设计文档、示例输出（如交底书、Mermaid 图、线稿图）以及相关代码。核心功能模块包括专利点挖掘、交底书生成与迭代、专利通俗解读（输出到 Obsidian）、审查答复辅助等。
zh.stack: 基于 Python 3.9+，使用 Playwright 与 CNIPA（中国国家知识产权局）交互，遵循 AgentSkills 标准，集成 Obsidian CLI 和 Bases 生态，支持 Mermaid 图表生成。
zh.hot: 5.6k stars 且日增 62，登上 GitHub Trending 日榜第 13，因为精准解决了研发人员写专利交底书的痛点，将专利解读与知识库结合，实用性强且演示效果直观。
uses: 研发工程师：从项目代码和方案中快速挖掘专利点，生成规范交底书
专利代理人/IPR：辅助审查答复、多轮修订交底书，并跟踪政策动向
技术管理者：将公开专利解读为通俗笔记，构建团队私有专利知识库
创新爱好者：学习专利撰写技巧，理解复杂专利的技术细节

en.tag: China patent skill: mine patent points, draft disclosures, plain-language analysis
en.what: This is an Agent skill for Chinese patents, helping R&D personnel mine patentable points from project materials, draft invention, utility model, and design patent disclosures, with multi-round iteration support. It also interprets public patents into plain-language notes and knowledge graphs, building a personal patent knowledge base, and assists with office action responses and policy tracking.
en.content: The repo includes skill definition (SKILL.md), installation guide (INSTALL.md), design docs, sample outputs (disclosures, Mermaid diagrams, line drawings), and code. Core modules cover patent point mining, disclosure generation and iteration, plain-language interpretation (into Obsidian), and office action assistance.
en.stack: Built on Python 3.9+, uses Playwright for CNIPA interaction, follows AgentSkills standard, integrates Obsidian CLI and Bases ecosystem, and supports Mermaid diagram generation.
en.hot: With 5.6k stars and +62 today, ranking #13 on GitHub Trending daily, it addresses the pain point of drafting patent disclosures for engineers, combining interpretation with knowledge base, highly practical with clear demos.
uses: R&D engineers: quickly mine patent points from code and designs, generate standard disclosures
Patent attorneys/IPR: assist with office actions, multi-round revisions, and policy tracking
Tech managers: interpret public patents into plain notes, build team patent knowledge base
Innovation enthusiasts: learn patent drafting skills and understand complex patent details

zh.tag: 从零到精通的 AI 工程实战课程
zh.what: 这是一个免费开源的 AI 工程学习课程，包含 511 节课、20 个阶段，约 329 小时的学习内容。课程强调实践，每一课都会产出可复用的成果，如提示词、技能、代理或 MCP 服务器。
zh.content: 仓库包含课程内容、多语言翻译（i18n）、网站源码（site/）以及构建脚本（build.js）。课程覆盖 Python、TypeScript、Rust 和 Julia 等多种语言。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python，同时涉及 TypeScript、Rust 和 Julia。网站可能基于静态生成器，使用 build.js 构建。
zh.hot: 该仓库因提供系统化、实战导向的 AI 学习路径而迅速走红，48k+ 星标，30 天内 15 万读者，反映了市场对实用 AI 技能的巨大需求。
uses: 希望系统学习 AI 工程、从零构建项目的开发者
需要实战经验以提升职场竞争力的学生和转行者
教育者或培训师，可将其作为课程大纲或教学资源

en.tag: Hands-on AI engineering curriculum from scratch to mastery
en.what: A free, open-source AI engineering curriculum with 511 lessons, 20 phases, and ~329 hours of content. It emphasizes hands-on learning, where each lesson produces a reusable artifact like a prompt, skill, agent, or MCP server.
en.content: The repository contains curriculum content, i18n translations, website source (site/), and build scripts (build.js). The curriculum covers multiple languages including Python, TypeScript, Rust, and Julia.
en.stack: Primarily Python, with TypeScript, Rust, and Julia. The website likely uses a static site generator with build.js.
en.hot: This repo went viral for its systematic, hands-on AI learning path, amassing 48k+ stars and 150k readers in 30 days, reflecting huge demand for practical AI skills.
uses: Developers who want to systematically learn AI engineering and build projects from scratch
Students and career switchers needing hands-on experience to boost employability
Educators or trainers who can use it as a curriculum outline or teaching resource

zh.tag: 命令行下载 App Store 的 ipa 包工具
zh.what: ipatool 是一个命令行工具，允许用户从 App Store 搜索 iOS、iPadOS、tvOS 和 visionOS 应用，并下载其 ipa 文件。它支持认证、搜索、购买和列出已购应用等操作。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的命令行工具源码，提供 auth、search、purchase、list-purchases 等子命令，支持文本和 JSON 输出格式，并附带演示 GIF 和详细文档。
zh.stack: 使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 App Store 的 API，支持 Windows、Linux 和 macOS，可通过 Homebrew 安装。
zh.hot: 该工具为开发者和安全研究人员提供了便捷的 ipa 下载方式，在 GitHub 上获得 1 万+ star，今日新增 58 个，登上日榜第 8 名。
uses: iOS 开发者需要获取 ipa 包进行测试或分析
安全研究人员分析应用包内容
需要备份或归档 App Store 应用的用户

en.tag: CLI tool to search and download ipa packages from App Store
en.what: ipatool is a command-line tool that allows users to search for iOS, iPadOS, tvOS, and visionOS apps on the App Store and download their ipa files. It supports authentication, searching, purchasing, and listing purchased apps.
en.content: The repository contains the source code of a Go-based CLI tool with subcommands like auth, search, purchase, and list-purchases, supporting text and JSON output formats, along with a demo GIF and detailed documentation.
en.stack: Developed in Go, it relies on the App Store API and supports Windows, Linux, and macOS, installable via Homebrew.
en.hot: This tool provides a convenient way for developers and security researchers to download ipa files, gaining over 10k stars on GitHub with 58 new stars today, ranking 8th on the daily trending list.
uses: iOS developers needing ipa packages for testing or analysis
Security researchers analyzing app package contents
Users who want to back up or archive App Store apps

zh.tag: 基于 Claude Code 的 AI 求职申请框架
zh.what: 这是一个运行在你机器上的 AI 求职框架，利用 Claude Code 自动评估职位、定制简历、撰写求职信并准备面试。用户只需 Fork 仓库并填写个人资料，即可让 AI 代理完成求职流程。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 Claude Code 工作流（/setup、/scrape、/apply、/interview），以及针对丹麦求职市场的职位搜索技能（Jobindex、Jobnet 等），但设计为可替换为本地求职网站。
zh.stack: 主要基于 Python 和 Claude Code，利用 Anthropic 的 Claude 模型进行自然语言处理。
zh.hot: 作者用该框架成功获得 AI 工程师职位，69 份申请换来 20 次面试，真实案例引发共鸣。34k+ 星标，日增 434，登上 GitHub Trending 日榜第三。
uses: 求职者：自动化繁琐的申请流程，节省时间并提高效率。
开发者：学习如何构建基于 Claude Code 的 AI 代理工作流。
非丹麦用户：可修改代码以适配本地求职网站，实现定制化求职。

en.tag: AI job application framework built on Claude Code
en.what: This is an AI-powered job application framework that runs on your machine, using Claude Code to evaluate job postings, tailor CVs, write cover letters, and prepare for interviews. Fork it, fill in your profile, and let the AI agent handle the job search process.
en.content: The repo contains a full Claude Code workflow (/setup, /scrape, /apply, /interview) and job portal search skills for the Danish market (Jobindex, Jobnet, etc.), but the pattern is designed to be swapped for local job boards.
en.stack: Primarily based on Python and Claude Code, leveraging Anthropic's Claude models for natural language processing.
en.hot: The author used this framework to land an AI engineer job, with 69 applications leading to 20 interviews, a real success story that resonates. With 34k+ stars and 434 daily additions, it hit #3 on GitHub Trending daily.
uses: Job seekers: automate tedious application processes, saving time and increasing efficiency.
Developers: learn how to build AI agent workflows on Claude Code.
Non-Danish users: modify the code to adapt to local job boards for customized job hunting.

zh.tag: 为 LLM 打造的开源网络爬虫与抓取工具
zh.what: Crawl4AI 是一个开源网络爬虫和抓取工具，专为大型语言模型设计。它能将网页转换为干净、结构化的 Markdown 格式，方便用于 RAG、AI 代理和数据管道。该工具强调速度、可控性和易用性，并拥有超过 50k 星标的社区支持。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Python 库、Docker API 服务器、Playwright 集成、内存自适应调度器、GPU 支持，以及详细的文档和示例。最新版本 v0.9.2 修复了内存泄漏和 Docker 认证问题。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python，依赖 Playwright 进行浏览器自动化，支持 Docker 部署，并集成 GPU 加速。

zh.what: 这是一个开源硬件项目，旨在制作迪士尼BDX机器人的迷你版本，高度约42厘米，总物料成本控制在400美元以下。项目整合了机械设计、电子和强化学习训练资源，目前重点是通过sim2real让机器人学会走路。
zh.content: 仓库包含CAD设计文件（Onshape链接）、MuJoCo仿真脚本、训练好的策略模型（ONNX）、以及从设计到仿真的文档。还包含社区Discord链接和更新日志。
zh.stack: 主要使用Python，依赖MuJoCo进行仿真，使用强化学习（可能基于Playground）训练行走策略，并利用ONNX进行模型部署。
zh.hot: 该项目将迪士尼标志性机器人开源化，且成本低廉，吸引了大量机器人爱好者和AI研究者。本周新增400星，总星数近4000，反映了社区对低成本双足机器人的强烈兴趣。
uses: 机器人爱好者：想亲手搭建一个迷你双足机器人，学习机械设计和电子组装。
强化学习研究者：利用MuJoCo和sim2real技术，在真实硬件上验证行走算法。
教育场景：作为低成本教学平台，展示从CAD到AI控制的完整流程。

en.tag: Open-source mini BDX droid: CAD, RL walking, sim2real
en.what: This is an open-source hardware project to build a miniature version of Disney's BDX droid, about 42 cm tall with a BOM cost under $400. It centralizes mechanical design, electronics, and RL training resources, currently focusing on sim2real for walking.
en.content: The repo includes CAD files (Onshape link), MuJoCo simulation scripts, trained policy models (ONNX), and docs for going from design to simulation. Also contains community Discord link and update logs.
en.stack: Primarily Python, with MuJoCo for simulation, reinforcement learning (likely via Playground) for walking policies, and ONNX for model deployment.
en.hot: It open-sources a Disney-like droid at low cost, attracting robot hobbyists and AI researchers. Gaining 400 stars this week to nearly 4k total, it reflects strong interest in low-cost biped robots.
uses: Robot hobbyists: build a mini biped robot and learn mechanical design and electronics assembly.
RL researchers: validate walking algorithms on real hardware using MuJoCo and sim2real.
Educational settings: a low-cost platform to demonstrate the full pipeline from CAD to AI control.

zh.tag: 浏览器内零服务器代码知识图谱与Graph RAG代理
zh.what: GitNexus是一个完全在浏览器中运行的客户端知识图谱引擎，可导入Git仓库或ZIP文件，生成交互式知识图谱，并内置Graph RAG代理，用于代码探索。它索引代码库的依赖、调用链、集群和执行流，并通过MCP工具暴露给AI代理，使代理获得架构级上下文。
zh.content: 仓库包含CLI工具（npx gitnexus analyze/setup）、Web UI（浏览器聊天界面）、MCP配置生成器，以及自动生成的AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md上下文文件。
zh.stack: 基于TypeScript，依赖npm包分发，使用MCP协议集成AI代理，支持GitHub/GitLab/Azure/本地仓库。
zh.hot: GitNexus在GitHub Trending日榜排名第5，今日新增202星，总星数达46k。其零服务器架构和深度代码分析能力吸引了开发者，被视为DeepWiki的进阶版。
uses: 开发者快速理解陌生代码库的架构和依赖关系
AI编码代理（如Cursor、Claude Code）获取完整代码上下文，减少错误编辑
技术团队在浏览器中协作探索代码，无需配置服务器
教育场景中用于可视化代码结构和调用链

en.tag: Zero-server code knowledge graph with Graph RAG agent in browser
en.what: GitNexus is a client-side knowledge graph engine that runs entirely in the browser. Drop in a Git repo or ZIP file to get an interactive knowledge graph with a built-in Graph RAG agent for code exploration. It indexes dependencies, call chains, clusters, and execution flows, exposing them via MCP tools so AI agents gain architectural context.
en.content: The repo includes a CLI (npx gitnexus analyze/setup), a Web UI for browser chat, MCP config generator, and auto-generated AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md context files.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript, distributed via npm, uses MCP protocol for AI agent integration, supports GitHub/GitLab/Azure/local repos.
en.hot: Ranked #5 on GitHub Trending daily with +202 stars today, reaching 46k total. Its zero-server architecture and deep code analysis appeal to developers, seen as a deeper alternative to DeepWiki.
uses: Developers quickly understand architecture and dependencies of unfamiliar codebases
AI coding agents (Cursor, Claude Code) get full code context to reduce blind edits
Teams explore code collaboratively in the browser without server setup
Educational use to visualize code structure and call chains

zh.tag: 多智能体自主红队平台，让AI编码代理变零日猎手
zh.what: T3MP3ST 是一个多智能体进攻性安全框架，旨在将你已有的 AI 编码代理（如 Claude Code、Codex 等）转化为自主漏洞猎手。它自动化了从侦察到利用再到报告的攻击链，支持浏览器作战室或 CLI 操作，并可在完全离线环境下运行。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心框架代码、文档（快速入门、开发者指南）、状态表（明确标记稳定/实验/路线图功能）以及基准测试数据。所有 README 中的数字均可通过 `npm run verify-claims` 复现。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript 构建，支持多种 AI 代理后端（Claude Code、Codex、Hermes、OpenCode、Oh My Pi）以及本地模型运行器（Ollama、LM Studio、vLLM）。无 API 密钥要求，可完全自托管。
zh.hot: 凭借可复现的基准（在 XBOW 104 挑战中 pass@1 达 90.1%，超过 XBOW 自报的 85%）和无需密钥的架构，迅速获得关注。本周新增 270 星，总星数达 5973，登上 GitHub Trending 周榜 TypeScript 第 9 名。
uses: 安全研究人员和红队成员：用于对授权目标进行自动化渗透测试和漏洞挖掘。
AI 代理开发者：希望评估或增强其 AI 编码代理的安全能力。
DevSecOps 团队：集成到 CI/CD 流程中，实现持续安全验证。
CTF 玩家和漏洞猎人：利用其自动化能力解决挑战和发现真实 CVE。

en.tag: Multi-agent autonomous red-teaming platform turning AI coding agents into zero-day hunters
en.what: T3MP3ST is a multi-agent offensive-security framework designed to turn your existing AI coding agents (like Claude Code, Codex, etc.) into autonomous vulnerability hunters. It automates the kill chain from recon to exploit to report, operable via a browser War Room or CLI, and can run fully offline.
en.content: The repo contains core framework code, documentation (quick start, developer guide), a status table clearly marking stable/experimental/roadmap features, and benchmark data. All numbers in the README are reproducible via `npm run verify-claims`.
en.stack: Built on TypeScript, supports various AI agent backends (Claude Code, Codex, Hermes, OpenCode, Oh My Pi) and local model runners (Ollama, LM Studio, vLLM). No API keys required, fully self-hostable.
en.hot: Gaining traction due to reproducible benchmarks (90.1% pass@1 on XBOW's 104-challenge suite, above XBOW's self-reported 85%) and keyless architecture. Gained 270 stars this week, reaching 5973 total, ranking #9 on GitHub Trending (TypeScript) weekly.
uses: Security researchers and red teamers: for automated penetration testing and vulnerability hunting on authorized targets.
AI agent developers: looking to evaluate or enhance the security capabilities of their AI coding agents.
DevSecOps teams: to integrate into CI/CD pipelines for continuous security validation.
CTF players and bug bounty hunters: leveraging automation to solve challenges and discover real CVEs.

zh.tag: 自动构建个人知识库的跨平台桌面应用
zh.what: LLM Wiki 是一款跨平台桌面应用，能自动将你的文档转化为组织良好、相互关联的知识库。它摒弃了传统 RAG 每次从头检索的方式，而是让 LLM 增量构建并维护一个持久化的 wiki。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的桌面应用源码，支持多格式文档解析、多模态图像提取、知识图谱、社区检测、深度研究等功能，并提供详细的 README 和中文等多语言文档。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript，前端为桌面应用框架，后端包含 Rust 聊天代理，支持 LanceDB 向量搜索、MinerU PDF 处理，以及多种 LLM 模型配置。
zh.hot: 凭借自动构建知识库的独特理念和丰富的功能，在 GitHub 上获得 17k+ 星标，本周新增 453 星，登上 TypeScript 周榜第 15 名，受到知识管理爱好者和 AI 用户的广泛关注。
uses: 适合需要将大量文档转化为结构化知识库的研究人员、学生和知识工作者
适用于希望利用 AI 自动整理笔记、文献和网页剪辑的个人知识管理场景
对探索知识图谱、社区检测和深度研究功能感兴趣的技术爱好者和开发者

en.tag: Cross-platform desktop app that auto-builds a personal knowledge base
en.what: LLM Wiki is a cross-platform desktop app that automatically turns your documents into an organized, interlinked knowledge base. Instead of traditional RAG, it uses LLM to incrementally build and maintain a persistent wiki from your sources.
en.content: The repository contains the full desktop app source code, featuring multi-format document parsing, multimodal image extraction, knowledge graph, community detection, deep research, and detailed README with multi-language support.
en.stack: Primarily TypeScript, with a desktop app frontend and a Rust backend chat agent. Supports LanceDB vector search, MinerU PDF processing, and flexible LLM model configuration.
en.hot: With its unique concept of auto-building knowledge bases and rich features, it has gained 17k+ stars, adding 453 this week, ranking #15 on the TypeScript weekly trending list, attracting attention from knowledge management enthusiasts and AI users.
uses: Ideal for researchers, students, and knowledge workers who need to turn large document collections into structured knowledge bases
Perfect for personal knowledge management scenarios where AI automatically organizes notes, literature, and web clippings
Great for tech enthusiasts and developers interested in knowledge graphs, community detection, and deep research features

zh.tag: GitHub Actions 官方检出仓库 Action
zh.what: 这是 GitHub 官方维护的 Actions/checkout，用于在 GitHub Actions 工作流中把仓库代码检出到运行器上。它默认只获取触发工作流的单个提交，也支持通过 fetch-depth 获取完整历史。
zh.content: 仓库包含该 Action 的源码、文档和示例，主要逻辑在 TypeScript 中实现，并附有测试和工作流配置。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript 编写，依赖 @actions/core、@actions/github 等官方包，并迁移到 ESM 模块系统。
zh.hot: 作为 GitHub Actions 最基础的官方 Action，几乎所有工作流都会用到，本周新增 173 star，持续保持高热度。
uses: 任何使用 GitHub Actions 的开发者，用于在 CI/CD 流程中检出代码。
需要安全处理 fork 拉取请求的仓库维护者，可启用 allow-unsafe-pr-checkout 选项。
希望了解官方 Action 最佳实践和 TypeScript 实现的开发者。

en.tag: Official GitHub Action to check out a repository
en.what: This is the official GitHub Action to check out a repository in GitHub Actions workflows. It fetches a single commit by default, but can be configured to fetch full history with fetch-depth.
en.content: The repository contains the source code, documentation, and examples for the Action, implemented in TypeScript with tests and workflow configurations.
en.stack: Written in TypeScript, using official @actions/* packages, and migrated to ESM.
en.hot: As the most fundamental official Action, it's used in nearly every workflow, gaining 173 stars this week and remaining highly popular.
uses: Developers using GitHub Actions to check out code in CI/CD pipelines.
Maintainers needing secure handling of fork pull requests, with an opt-in for unsafe checkout.
Developers interested in official Action best practices and TypeScript implementation.

zh.tag: 本地多智能体编排，让终端 CLI 变成你的克隆员工
zh.what: Munder Difflin 是一个本地多智能体编排工具，能将你已有的终端编码 CLI（如 Claude Code、Codex、Grok 等）包装成可协作的智能体团队。它由你的克隆体 Michael 作为主管，为每个智能体分配长期记忆、邮箱和办公桌，并在 2D 办公楼层上可视化他们的工作状态。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Electron 桌面应用、React 前端、Pixi.js 渲染的办公楼层、xterm.js 终端集成，以及 node-pty 进程管理。支持多种 CLI 代理，提供长期记忆、消息路由和可视化界面。
zh.stack: 基于 Electron、React、TypeScript、Pixi.js、xterm.js 和 node-pty 构建，支持 macOS、Windows 和 Linux。
zh.hot: 上线即登 GitHub Trending 日榜第二，单日新增 306 star，总星数突破 2000。其“将终端 CLI 变成克隆办公室”的创意和免费开源特性吸引了大量开发者关注。
uses: 开发者：希望利用现有 AI 编码工具实现自动化任务，如代码审查、测试执行等。
团队：需要并行处理多个编码任务，通过智能体协作提高效率。
AI 爱好者：探索多智能体系统，可视化观察智能体协作过程。

en.tag: Local multi-agent harness that turns terminal CLIs into your clone office
en.what: Munder Difflin is a local multi-agent harness that wraps existing terminal coding CLIs (like Claude Code, Codex, Grok, etc.) into a collaborative agent team. Your clone, Michael, acts as the manager, giving each agent long-term memory, a mailbox, and a desk on a 2D office floor, visualizing their work in real time.
en.content: The repo includes an Electron desktop app, React frontend, Pixi.js-rendered office floor, xterm.js terminal integration, and node-pty process management. It supports multiple CLI agents with long-term memory, message routing, and a visual interface.
en.stack: Built with Electron, React, TypeScript, Pixi.js, xterm.js, and node-pty, supporting macOS, Windows, and Linux.
en.hot: Debuted at #2 on GitHub Trending daily, gaining 306 stars in one day and surpassing 2,000 total. Its creative concept of turning terminal CLIs into a clone office, combined with being free and open source, has captured developers' attention.
uses: Developers: Automate coding tasks like code review and test execution using existing AI tools.
Teams: Parallelize multiple coding tasks and boost efficiency through agent collaboration.
AI enthusiasts: Explore multi-agent systems and visualize agent collaboration in action.

zh.tag: 细粒度响应式 UI 库，无虚拟 DOM
zh.what: Solid 是一个声明式 JavaScript 库，用于构建用户界面。它不使用虚拟 DOM，而是将模板编译为真实 DOM 节点，并通过细粒度的响应式更新来高效管理状态变化。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Solid 核心库的源码、文档、示例和测试。核心 API 包括 createSignal、createEffect 等响应式原语，以及 JSX 编译器和运行时支持。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript 编写，依赖 JSX 语法和编译器，支持现代浏览器和 Node.js 环境。
zh.hot: Solid 因其高性能和细粒度响应式而受到关注，尽管本周新增 star 不多，但总星数近 3.6 万，在 TypeScript 周榜中位列第 10，显示出持续的热度。
uses: 前端开发者寻求高性能、细粒度响应式的 UI 库
需要无虚拟 DOM 的轻量级框架的团队
对 React 替代方案感兴趣，希望学习新范式的人

en.tag: Fine-grained reactive UI library without Virtual DOM
en.what: Solid is a declarative JavaScript library for building user interfaces. Instead of using a Virtual DOM, it compiles templates to real DOM nodes and updates them with fine-grained reactions, ensuring efficient state management.
en.content: The repository contains the source code, documentation, examples, and tests for the Solid core library. Key APIs include reactive primitives like createSignal and createEffect, along with JSX compiler and runtime support.
en.stack: Written primarily in TypeScript, relies on JSX syntax and a compiler, supports modern browsers and Node.js environments.
en.hot: Solid gains attention for its high performance and fine-grained reactivity. Although weekly new stars are modest, its total stars approach 36k, ranking 10th on the TypeScript weekly list, indicating sustained popularity.
uses: Frontend developers seeking a high-performance, fine-grained reactive UI library
Teams needing a lightweight framework without Virtual DOM
Those interested in React alternatives and learning new paradigms

zh.tag: 浏览器内高性能 LLM 推理引擎，WebGPU 加速
zh.what: WebLLM 是一个高性能的浏览器内 LLM 推理引擎，利用 WebGPU 实现硬件加速，使语言模型推理直接在浏览器中运行，无需服务器支持。它完全兼容 OpenAI API，支持流式输出、JSON 模式等功能，并可在本地使用任何开源模型。
zh.content: 仓库包含 WebLLM 的 npm 包源码、示例代码、文档和测试，以及用于构建和部署的配置。核心是 TypeScript 编写的推理引擎，通过 WebGPU 和 WebAssembly 实现模型加载与计算。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript，依赖 WebGPU 和 WebAssembly，通过 npm 包分发。与 MLC LLM 项目紧密相关，支持多种模型格式。
zh.hot: 本周新增 345 星，总星数近 1.9 万，位列 TypeScript 周榜第 14。它让 LLM 推理无需服务器，直接在浏览器中运行，兼顾隐私和 GPU 加速，且兼容 OpenAI API，降低了 AI 应用开发门槛。
uses: 前端开发者：在浏览器中构建无需后端的 AI 聊天应用，利用 WebGPU 加速推理。
隐私敏感场景：用户数据保留在本地浏览器，适合处理敏感信息的应用。
AI 应用原型设计：快速在网页中集成开源模型，无需配置服务器环境。

en.tag: High-performance in-browser LLM inference engine with WebGPU acceleration
en.what: WebLLM is a high-performance in-browser LLM inference engine that leverages WebGPU for hardware acceleration, enabling LLM inference directly in the browser without server support. It is fully compatible with the OpenAI API, supporting streaming, JSON mode, and other features, and can run any open-source model locally.
en.content: The repository contains the source code of the WebLLM npm package, examples, documentation, and tests, along with build and deployment configurations. The core is a TypeScript inference engine that uses WebGPU and WebAssembly for model loading and computation.
en.stack: Primarily TypeScript, relying on WebGPU and WebAssembly, distributed as an npm package. Closely related to the MLC LLM project, supporting multiple model formats.
en.hot: With 345 stars added this week and nearly 19k total, it ranks #14 on the TypeScript weekly trending. It enables LLM inference in the browser without servers, balancing privacy and GPU acceleration, and its OpenAI API compatibility lowers the barrier for AI app development.
uses: Frontend developers: build AI chat apps in the browser without a backend, leveraging WebGPU acceleration.
Privacy-sensitive scenarios: user data stays in the local browser, suitable for apps handling sensitive information.
AI prototyping: quickly integrate open-source models into web pages without server setup.

zh.tag: 为 AI 编码代理提供持久记忆层，告别重复解释
zh.what: agentmemory 是一个为 AI 编码代理（如 Claude Code、Copilot CLI、Cursor 等）提供持久记忆的库。它基于真实世界基准测试，让代理记住项目上下文、用户偏好和历史决策，避免每次对话从头开始。它扩展了 Karpathy 的 LLM Wiki 模式，加入置信度评分、生命周期管理、知识图谱和混合搜索。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心 TypeScript 库（npm 包 @agentmemory/agentmemory）、CLI 工具、与多个代理的集成示例、多语言 README（12 种语言）、基准测试脚本和文档。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript 构建，依赖 iii 引擎（用于记忆检索），支持 MCP（模型上下文协议），可与任何 MCP 客户端集成。
zh.hot: 本周新增 519 星，总星数达 27.9k，在 GitHub Trending 周榜（TypeScript）排名第 14。它解决了 AI 编码代理的痛点——持久记忆，且宣称检索召回率 95.2%、节省 92% token，引发开发者关注。
uses: 使用 Claude Code、Cursor 等 AI 编码代理的开发者，希望代理记住项目上下文，减少重复解释。
团队协作场景，需要共享代理记忆，保持代码库知识一致性。
构建自定义 MCP 客户端或代理工具链的开发者，需要集成持久记忆功能。

en.tag: Persistent memory layer for AI coding agents, no more re-explaining
en.what: agentmemory is a library that provides persistent memory for AI coding agents like Claude Code, Copilot CLI, Cursor, and more. Built on real-world benchmarks, it lets agents remember project context, user preferences, and past decisions, avoiding re-explaining every session. It extends Karpathy's LLM Wiki pattern with confidence scoring, lifecycle management, knowledge graphs, and hybrid search.
en.content: The repo contains the core TypeScript library (npm package @agentmemory/agentmemory), CLI tools, integration examples for multiple agents, READMEs in 12 languages, benchmark scripts, and documentation.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript, powered by the iii engine for memory retrieval, supports MCP (Model Context Protocol) for integration with any MCP client.
en.hot: Gained 519 stars this week, totaling 27.9k, ranking #14 on GitHub Trending (TypeScript) weekly. It addresses a key pain point for AI coding agents—persistent memory—with claims of 95.2% retrieval recall and 92% token savings, drawing developer attention.
uses: Developers using AI coding agents like Claude Code or Cursor who want agents to remember project context and avoid re-explaining.
Team collaboration scenarios where shared agent memory is needed to keep codebase knowledge consistent.
Developers building custom MCP clients or agent toolchains that require persistent memory integration.

zh.tag: AI 驱动的 Web 应用与 API 渗透测试代理
zh.what: Shannon 是一款自主 AI 渗透测试代理，专为 Web 应用和 API 设计。它分析源代码，识别攻击路径，并执行真实漏洞利用，以在生产环境前证明漏洞的存在。其理念是“无利用，不报告”，确保每个发现都经过验证。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的开源代理，可通过命令行本地运行，提供交互式启动器、CLI、CI/CD 集成（如 GitHub Actions）、PDF 报告和 SARIF 输出。文档包括 llms.txt 和 llms-full.txt，方便 AI 代理快速了解仓库结构。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript 构建，通过 npx 分发，依赖 Node.js 环境。集成了 GitHub Actions 等 CI/CD 工具，并支持 SARIF 格式输出。
zh.hot: Shannon 在 GitHub 上获得 47,696 颗星，本周新增 483 颗，位列 TypeScript 周榜第 16 名。其“真实利用”验证漏洞的方法和开源可本地运行的特性，吸引了大量安全爱好者和开发者关注。
uses: 安全研究人员和渗透测试人员，希望自动化漏洞验证流程，提高效率。
开发团队在 CI/CD 流水线中集成安全测试，尽早发现并修复漏洞。
对 AI 安全代理感兴趣的技术爱好者，学习如何构建自主安全工具。

en.tag: Autonomous AI pentester for web apps and APIs
en.what: Shannon is an autonomous AI pentester for web applications and APIs. It analyzes source code, identifies attack vectors, and executes real exploits to prove vulnerabilities before production. Its philosophy is 'no exploit, no report', ensuring every finding is validated.
en.content: The repository contains the full open-source agent, runnable locally from the CLI, with an interactive launcher, rebuilt CLI, native CI/CD integrations (e.g., GitHub Actions), professional PDF reports, and SARIF output. Docs include llms.txt and llms-full.txt for AI agents.

uses: Security researchers and pentesters seeking to automate vulnerability validation and improve efficiency.
Development teams integrating security testing into CI/CD pipelines to catch vulnerabilities early.
Tech enthusiasts interested in AI security agents, learning how to build autonomous security tools.

zh.tag: React 渲染器，让 Three.js 场景声明式、组件化
zh.what: react-three-fiber 是一个用于 Three.js 的 React 渲染器，允许开发者以声明式、可复用的组件方式构建 3D 场景。它让组件能够响应状态、交互，并融入 React 生态。

en.tag: A React renderer for Three.js, enabling declarative 3D scenes
en.what: react-three-fiber is a React renderer for Three.js, allowing developers to build 3D scenes declaratively with reusable, self-contained components that react to state, are interactive, and participate in React's ecosystem.

Teams creating interactive 3D visualizations, product showcases, or data visualization interfaces
Projects aiming to integrate 3D content seamlessly into existing React applications

zh.tag: 插件化无广告的免费音乐播放器
zh.what: MusicFree 是一款插件化、定制化、无广告的免费音乐播放器，目前支持 Android 和 Harmony OS。它本身不集成任何音源，所有搜索、播放、歌单导入等功能都通过插件实现，用户可自由安装第三方插件来扩展功能。

zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript 开发，基于 AGPL 3.0 协议开源。插件本质是满足插件协议的 commonjs 模块，支持本地和网络安装。

希望扩展音源、通过插件实现搜索/播放/歌词等功能的开发者
关注开源软件、愿意尝试业余但持续维护的项目的用户

en.what: MusicFree is a plugin-based, customizable, ad-free free music player, currently supporting Android and Harmony OS. Users interested in open-source software and willing to try hobby projects with ongoing maintenance

zh.tag: 面向 AI 编码者的终端代码审查工具
zh.what: Hunk 是一个专为 AI 生成的代码变更设计的终端 diff 查看器，强调审查优先。它支持多文件审查流、侧边栏导航、内联 AI 注释，以及分屏、堆叠等响应式布局，帮助开发者高效审查 AI 代理产生的代码。

zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript，依赖 OpenTUI 构建终端界面，使用 Pierre diffs 处理差异，支持 npm、Homebrew、mise 和 Nix 等多种安装方式。

追求高效代码审查流程的开发者，希望快速浏览多文件差异并添加注释

en.what: Hunk is a terminal-based diff viewer designed for reviewing AI-generated code changes, with a review-first approach. en.content: The repository contains the full source code of Hunk, built on OpenTUI and Pierre diffs, including installation scripts, documentation, Nix support, and it ships as a default tool in Omarchy.

Developers seeking an efficient code review workflow, wanting to quickly browse multi-file diffs and add comments
Terminal enthusiasts who prefer CLI environments and need a powerful diff viewer

en.what: claude-mem is a persistent memory system for AI agents like Claude Code and Codex. It captures everything an agent does during sessions, compresses it with AI, and injects relevant context back into future sessions, enabling continuity and personalization across sessions.

Agent builders: integrate this skill into custom agents to enhance text post-processing.
