zh.tag: AI 代理的自进化上下文数据库，统一记忆、知识与技能
zh.what: OpenViking 是一个为 AI 代理设计的开源上下文数据库，将记忆、资源和技能统一为一个虚拟文件系统（viking:// 协议），代理可以通过 ls、tree、find 等命令浏览自己的上下文，而不是查询黑盒向量存储。内容被处理为三层（L0 摘要、L1 概览、L2 细节），并按需加载，每次检索都会留下可观察和调试的轨迹。
zh.content: 仓库包含 OpenViking 的核心实现，包括虚拟文件系统、三层内容处理管道、检索轨迹记录，以及 OpenViking Studio 在线演示环境。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python 开发，可能依赖向量数据库、文件系统抽象和 AI 代理框架，具体技术栈未在摘要中详述。
zh.hot: OpenViking 在 GitHub 上迅速走红，已获得 28,893 颗星，今日新增 239 颗，位列 Python 趋势榜第 9 名。其创新的上下文管理方式（将记忆、知识和技能统一为文件系统）吸引了大量关注，解决了 AI 代理上下文管理的痛点。
uses: AI 代理开发者：需要高效管理代理上下文、记忆和技能的场景。
RAG 应用构建者：希望用文件系统方式替代传统向量检索的团队。
研究与教育：用于探索代理上下文管理的新范式。

en.tag: Self-evolving context database for AI agents, unifying memory, knowledge RAG, and skills
en.what: OpenViking is an open-source context database for AI agents, unifying memories, resources, and skills into one virtual filesystem under the viking:// protocol, so agents can browse their context with ls, tree, and find instead of querying a black-box vector store. Content is processed into three tiers (L0 abstract, L1 overview, L2 details) and loaded on demand, with every retrieval leaving a traceable trajectory for debugging.
en.content: The repository contains the core implementation of OpenViking, including the virtual filesystem, three-tier content processing pipeline, retrieval trajectory logging, and the OpenViking Studio live demo environment.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Python, likely leveraging vector databases, filesystem abstractions, and AI agent frameworks, though the exact stack is not detailed in the summary.
en.hot: OpenViking has quickly gained traction on GitHub with 28,893 stars and 239 new stars today, ranking #9 on the Python trending list. Its innovative approach to context management—unifying memory, knowledge, and skills into a filesystem—has attracted significant attention, addressing a key pain point in AI agent context handling.
uses: AI agent developers: scenarios requiring efficient management of agent context, memory, and skills.
RAG application builders: teams looking to replace traditional vector retrieval with a filesystem approach.
Research and education: for exploring new paradigms in agent context management.

zh.tag: 用知识图谱增强的代码库 RAG 引擎
zh.what: Code-Graph-RAG 是一个面向多语言代码库的 RAG 系统，利用 Tree-sitter 解析代码并构建知识图谱，支持用自然语言查询、理解和编辑代码。它统一了混合语言 monorepo 的图模式，让 AI 能深入理解代码结构。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心解析器、图构建模块、查询接口、Agentic QA 基准测试工具，以及重复代码检测功能。提供 CLI 和 Python API，支持与主流 LLM 集成。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python，依赖 Tree-sitter 进行代码解析，Memgraph 作为图数据库，支持多种 LLM 后端。
zh.hot: 随着 AI 编程助手普及，开发者需要更精准的代码理解工具。该项目将知识图谱与 RAG 结合，解决多语言仓库的复杂查询问题，上线不久即获近 5000 star，日增 20，登上 Python 趋势榜。
uses: 大型 monorepo 的开发者，需要快速定位和理解跨语言代码依赖。
AI 编程工具团队，希望增强代码检索和编辑的准确性。
代码质量工程师，利用重复代码检测和知识图谱分析架构。

en.tag: Knowledge-graph-powered RAG engine for codebases
en.what: Code-Graph-RAG is a RAG system for multi-language codebases. It parses code with Tree-sitter, builds a knowledge graph in Memgraph, and lets you query, edit, and optimize code in plain English. It unifies mixed-language monorepos under a single graph schema.
en.content: The repo includes core parser, graph builder, query interface, agentic QA benchmark harness, and duplicate code detection. It offers CLI and Python API, with integrations for major LLMs.
en.stack: Primarily Python, using Tree-sitter for parsing, Memgraph as the graph database, and supports multiple LLM backends.
en.hot: As AI coding assistants proliferate, developers need more precise code understanding. This project combines knowledge graphs with RAG to solve complex queries in multi-language repos, gaining nearly 5k stars quickly and trending on Python daily.
uses: Developers in large monorepos needing to quickly locate and understand cross-language dependencies.
AI coding tool teams aiming to enhance code retrieval and editing accuracy.
Code quality engineers using duplicate detection and graph-based architecture analysis.

zh.tag: 14MB 端侧模型，手机/穿戴/家居/机器人皆可跑
zh.what: Needle 2 是一个 45M 参数的开放模型，专为工具调用、设备使用和结构化提取设计。整个模型打包成单个 14MB 的二进制文件，运行完整会话仅需约 28MB 内存。它基于 Simple Attention Network 架构，并采用 Cactus Quants 压缩至 CQ2 位，内置推理引擎。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Python 包，提供推理、LoRA 微调和导出功能。模型权重已嵌入引擎，无需额外文件，推理时无网络请求。还包含工具检索、置信度门控和 256-token 滑动窗口等特性。
zh.stack: 基于 Python，依赖 PyTorch 等，使用 Simple Attention Network 架构，Hadamard MLP、GQA 注意力、engram 键值记忆。推理引擎从 Hugging Face 获取并缓存。
zh.hot: 在 GitHub 日榜上新增 248 星，总星数 3730，因其极小的体积（14MB）和高效的端侧性能而备受关注，在基准测试中与更大的模型（如 FunctionGemma 270M）互有胜负，但体积小 5 到 70 倍。
uses: 端侧 AI 开发者：在手机、可穿戴设备等资源受限环境中部署工具调用模型。
智能家居与机器人：为设备提供本地智能，无需云端依赖。
LoRA 微调研究者：在小型模型上进行高效微调实验。

en.tag: 14MB on-device model for phones, wearables, smart home, and robots
en.what: Needle 2 is an open 45M-parameter model for tool calling, device use, and structured extraction. The entire model is a single 14MB binary that runs a full session in about 28MB of RAM. It is built on the Simple Attention Network architecture, compressed to CQ2-bit with Cactus Quants, and baked into its own engine.
en.content: The repository contains the Python package for inference, LoRA fine-tuning, and export. Weights are baked into the engine, no separate model files needed, and inference does no network calls. Features include tool retrieval, confidence gating, and a 256-token sliding window.
en.stack: Python-based, with dependencies like PyTorch. Uses Simple Attention Network architecture with Hadamard MLP, GQA attention, and engram key-value memory. The inference engine is fetched from Hugging Face and cached.
en.hot: Gained 248 stars today, total 3730, trending on GitHub. It's hot due to its tiny size (14MB) and efficient on-device performance, trading wins with larger models like FunctionGemma 270M while being 5-70x smaller.
uses: On-device AI developers: deploying tool-calling models in resource-constrained environments like phones and wearables.
Smart home and robotics: providing local intelligence for devices without cloud dependency.
LoRA fine-tuning researchers: experimenting with efficient fine-tuning on small models.

zh.tag: 本地优先的 AI 代理工作台，日志即运行时
zh.what: Apache Maka 是一个本地优先的 AI 代理工作台，用于实际工作而非仅仅回答问题。它通过受控权限检查项目、执行工具、生成工件，并将模型消息和工具调用记录为可恢复的执行事实。
zh.content: 仓库包含桌面应用（Electron + React）、终端 TUI 和 CLI（maka, maka run）、评估工具（maka eval run），以及核心的 Runtime Host 和 Runtime Event Log 实现。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript，桌面端基于 Electron 和 React，支持多种模型连接（云 API、本地模型或兼容网关），并包含本地工具如 Read、Write、Edit、Bash、Glob 和 Grep。
zh.hot: 今日新增 460 星，登上 TypeScript 趋势榜第 7，因其本地优先、日志即运行时的创新架构，以及 Apache 孵化项目的背书，吸引了关注 AI 代理可靠性和可恢复性的开发者。
uses: 日常 AI 辅助开发：在本地项目中安全地让代理读写文件、执行命令。
需要可审计、可恢复的 AI 代理工作流的团队，用于记录和回溯每次工具调用。
AI 代理评估：使用 maka eval 进行可复现的基准测试。
偏好本地优先、数据不出机器的隐私敏感用户。

en.tag: Local-first AI agent workspace with log-as-runtime architecture
en.what: Apache Maka is a local-first AI agent workspace built for real work. It inspects projects, executes tools, produces artifacts with controlled permissions, and preserves model messages and tool calls as recoverable execution facts.
en.content: The repo includes a desktop app (Electron + React), a terminal TUI and CLI (maka, maka run), an evaluation tool (maka eval run), and the core Runtime Host and Runtime Event Log implementation.
en.stack: Primarily TypeScript, with Electron and React for the desktop app, supporting multiple model connections (cloud API, local model, or compatible gateway), and local tools including Read, Write, Edit, Bash, Glob, and Grep.
en.hot: With 460 stars added today and ranking #7 on the TypeScript trending list, its local-first, log-as-runtime architecture and Apache incubation status attract developers focused on AI agent reliability and recoverability.
uses: Daily AI-assisted development: let agents safely read/write files and run commands in local projects.
Teams needing auditable and recoverable AI agent workflows, with logs of every tool call.
AI agent evaluation: use maka eval for reproducible benchmark experiments.
Privacy-conscious users preferring local-first, data-stays-on-machine solutions.

zh.tag: AI 代理团队级记忆中枢，沉淀对话、文档与代码为可复用资产
zh.what: TencentDB Agent Memory 是一个为 AI 代理设计的团队级记忆中枢，将对话、文档和代码转化为四种可复用的记忆资产（聊天记忆、技能、LLM 维基、代码图谱），并支持跨代理和框架的治理、共享与装备。它旨在减少重复工作，让代理在团队中持续积累知识。
zh.content: 仓库包含部署脚本（一键启动 memory-core、memory-hub 和 proxy）、核心服务代码、迁移工具，以及详细的安装文档（中英文）。提供面板用于管理记忆资产。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript，依赖 Node.js >=22.16，支持 OpenClaw 和 Hermes 等代理框架，使用 TencentDB 作为存储后端。
zh.hot: 今日新增 1057 星，总星数达 16543，登顶 GitHub Trending 日榜。其“团队记忆”理念切中 AI 代理协作痛点，且提供一键部署，迅速吸引开发者关注。
uses: AI 代理开发者：为代理添加持久记忆，减少重复上下文输入。
团队协作场景：共享代理记忆，提升团队知识复用效率。
个人开发者：构建“一人公司”式的代理团队，自动化工作流。
研究爱好者：探索代理记忆管理与跨框架集成。

en.tag: Team-level memory hub for AI agents, turning conversations, docs, and code into reusable assets
en.what: TencentDB Agent Memory is a team-level memory hub for AI agents, transforming conversations, docs, and code into four reusable memory assets (Chat Memory, Skill, LLM-Wiki, Code-Graph) that are governed, shared, and equipped across agents and frameworks. It aims to reduce repetitive work by enabling agents to accumulate knowledge persistently.
en.content: The repo includes deployment scripts (one-click start for memory-core, memory-hub, and proxy), core service code, migration tools, and detailed installation docs (EN/CN). A panel is provided for managing memory assets.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript, requires Node.js >=22.16, supports agent frameworks like OpenClaw and Hermes, and uses TencentDB as the storage backend.
en.hot: Gained 1,057 stars today, reaching 16,543 total, and topped the GitHub Trending daily chart. Its 'team memory' concept addresses the pain point of AI agent collaboration, and one-click deployment quickly attracts developers.
uses: AI agent developers: add persistent memory to agents, reducing repetitive context input.
Team collaboration: share agent memory to improve knowledge reuse efficiency.
Solo developers: build a 'one-person company' agent team for automated workflows.
Researchers/enthusiasts: explore agent memory management and cross-framework integration.

zh.tag: 苹果芯片上原生多 token 预测加速的本地 LLM 运行器
zh.what: MTPLX 是一个原生 Mac 应用和命令行工具，用于在 Apple Silicon 上运行本地大语言模型。它利用模型内置的多 token 预测（MTP）头，通过自推测解码和精确拒绝采样，在保持输出分布不变的情况下显著加速生成。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 Mac 应用（DMG 下载）和命令行工具（brew/pip 安装），提供模型推荐、自动下载、引擎配置、风扇控制等功能。内置针对 Qwen 3.8 27B 等模型的优化版本，并附有详细的 README 和文档。
zh.stack: 基于 Python 3.11+，使用 MLX 框架，依赖 Apple Silicon 的 Metal 性能。应用层采用原生 Mac 技术，CLI 支持 Homebrew 和 pip 安装。
zh.hot: 本月新增 714 星，总星数 1824，登上 GitHub Trending 月榜（Python）第 18 名。其宣称的 2 倍加速和无需外部草稿模型的特性，吸引了大量 Apple Silicon 用户的关注。
uses: 在 Mac 上本地运行 LLM 的开发者，希望获得更快的推理速度而不牺牲输出质量。
需要离线或隐私保护的 AI 编码助手，特别是使用 Qwen 3.8 27B 等模型的场景。
对推测解码技术感兴趣的研究者，希望参考其实现或进行二次开发。

en.tag: Native multi-token prediction LLM runner for Apple Silicon, ~2x faster
en.what: MTPLX is a native Mac app and CLI for running local LLMs on Apple Silicon. It leverages built-in multi-token prediction (MTP) heads to speculatively draft and verify multiple tokens per step, achieving up to 2.24x speedup while preserving the exact output distribution.
en.content: The repo provides a full Mac app (DMG) and CLI (brew/pip), featuring hardware checking, model recommendation, auto-download, engine setup, and fan control. It includes optimized builds for models like Qwen 3.8 27B, along with comprehensive docs.
en.stack: Built on Python 3.11+ with the MLX framework, leveraging Apple Silicon's Metal performance. The app uses native Mac technologies, and the CLI is installable via Homebrew or pip.
en.hot: Gained 714 stars this month (total 1824), ranking #18 on GitHub Trending (Python) monthly. Its claimed ~2x speedup and no-external-drafter design have attracted significant attention from Apple Silicon users.
uses: Developers running LLMs locally on Macs who want faster inference without compromising output quality.
AI coding assistants needing offline/private operation, especially with models like Qwen 3.8 27B.
Researchers interested in speculative decoding techniques for reference or further development.

zh.tag: 在 Cloudflare 上给 AI 代理一个虚拟文件系统与执行环境
zh.what: Cloudflare Computer 是一个位于 Durable Object 内的虚拟文件系统，通过 SQLite 保存权威状态，并暴露统一的执行接口。它提供多种后端（容器、隔离 shell、隔离 JavaScript），让代理可以像操作真实文件系统一样运行命令或代码。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心包 @cloudflare/computer、可运行示例（容器、worker-shell、worker-javascript、egress）以及说明设计意图的 docs/ 目录。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript，使用 Cloudflare Durable Objects、SQLite、Workers RPC、capnweb 协议，并集成 just-bash 和容器技术（FUSE 挂载）。
zh.hot: 本月新增近 9000 star，因为它是 Cloudflare 官方推出的‘给代理一台电脑’方案，将文件系统与执行环境无缝融入边缘平台，引发开发者对 AI 代理基础设施的想象。
uses: 开发者希望在 Cloudflare 上构建可执行代码的 AI 代理，快速原型验证。
需要为代理提供持久化、类文件系统存储，并支持多种执行后端的场景。
对边缘计算与 AI 结合感兴趣，想探索未来代理运行环境的技术爱好者。

en.tag: Give your agent a virtual filesystem & execution surface on Cloudflare
en.what: Cloudflare Computer is a virtual filesystem inside a Durable Object, with authoritative state in SQLite and a pluggable execution surface via workspace.runtime. It ships multiple backends (container, isolate shell, isolate JavaScript) so agents can run commands or code against a filesystem-like workspace.
en.content: The repo contains the core package @cloudflare/computer, runnable examples (container, worker-shell, worker-javascript, egress), and a docs/ directory describing forward-looking design intent.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript, leveraging Cloudflare Durable Objects, SQLite, Workers RPC, capnweb protocol, and integrating just-bash and container tech (FUSE mounts).
en.hot: Gained ~9k stars this month as Cloudflare's official 'give your agent a computer' approach, seamlessly blending filesystem and execution into the edge platform, sparking excitement about AI agent infrastructure.
uses: Developers building AI agents on Cloudflare that need to execute code and prototype quickly.
Scenarios requiring persistent, filesystem-like storage for agents with multiple execution backends.
Tech enthusiasts exploring edge computing + AI and future agent runtime environments.

zh.tag: Google 产品与技术的 Agent Skills 集合
zh.what: 这是一个包含 Google 产品和技术的 Agent Skills 仓库，提供可复用的技能模块，帮助 AI 代理执行云平台操作、解决方案架构等任务。通过 npx 命令即可安装和选择所需技能。
zh.content: 仓库内包含多个技能目录，涵盖 Google Cloud 入门、多产品解决方案、AI/ML 平台管理等，每个技能以 Markdown 文件形式提供详细指南。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python，依赖 npx 进行安装，技能内容基于 Markdown 编写。
zh.hot: 随着 AI 代理的兴起，开发者需要标准化的技能库来增强代理能力，Google 官方出品使其备受关注，star 数迅速增长。
uses: 开发者：为 AI 代理添加 Google Cloud 操作技能，快速集成云服务。
解决方案架构师：利用预置的技能模板设计云架构和数据分析流程。
AI 平台管理员：管理模型部署、调优和监控，提升运维效率。

en.tag: Agent Skills for Google products and technologies
en.what: This repository contains Agent Skills for Google products and technologies, offering reusable skill modules that enable AI agents to perform cloud platform operations, solution architecture, and more. Skills can be installed via npx command with selective installation.
en.content: The repo contains multiple skill directories covering Google Cloud onboarding, multi-product solutions, AI/ML platform management, etc., with each skill provided as detailed Markdown files.
en.stack: Primarily Python-based, installed via npx, with skills written in Markdown.
en.hot: With the rise of AI agents, developers need standardized skill libraries to enhance agent capabilities, and Google's official offering has gained significant attention, leading to rapid star growth.
uses: Developers: Add Google Cloud operational skills to AI agents for quick cloud integration.
Solution architects: Use pre-built skill templates to design cloud architectures and data analytics workflows.
AI platform admins: Manage model deployment, tuning, and monitoring to improve operational efficiency.

zh.tag: 统一 AI 开发与部署平台，含 MAX 框架与 Mojo 语言
zh.what: Modular Platform 是一个开源平台，旨在统一 AI 开发与部署流程，包含 MAX 框架（用于模型推理和部署）和 Mojo 语言（一种面向 AI 的高性能编程语言）。它提供从模型编译、优化到服务部署的完整工具链，并支持 OpenAI 兼容的端点。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Mojo 编译器、Mojo 标准库、MAX 加速器库、MAX 推理服务器、MAX 模型流水线以及大量代码示例。目录结构清晰，分为 /KGEN、/mojo、/max 等模块，方便开发者浏览和贡献。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Mojo 语言编写，同时涉及 Python（用于 MAX 的 Python API）和 C++（底层内核）。依赖 LLVM 等编译器基础设施，并遵循 Apache 2.0 许可证（含 LLVM 例外）。
zh.hot: 今日新增 268 星，总星数 27933，登顶 GitHub Trending 日榜。Mojo 语言和 MAX 框架的独特定位吸引了大量 AI 开发者，其高性能和统一平台理念备受关注。
uses: AI 开发者：使用 Mojo 语言编写高性能 AI 模型，或利用 MAX 框架进行模型部署和推理。
MLOps 工程师：通过 MAX 推理服务器快速搭建 OpenAI 兼容的模型服务。
研究人员：在 MAX 流水线中集成自定义模型架构，并利用加速器库优化性能。
开源贡献者：参与 Mojo 标准库、MAX 加速器库等模块的开发和改进。

en.tag: Unified AI development & deployment platform, including MAX framework and Mojo language
en.what: The Modular Platform is an open-source platform that unifies AI development and deployment, including the MAX framework for model inference and deployment, and the Mojo language, a high-performance programming language for AI. It provides a complete toolchain from model compilation and optimization to service deployment, with OpenAI-compatible endpoints.
en.content: The repo contains the Mojo compiler, Mojo standard library, MAX accelerator library, MAX inference server, MAX model pipelines, and numerous code examples. The directory structure is clear, with modules like /KGEN, /mojo, /max, making it easy to navigate and contribute.
en.stack: Primarily written in Mojo, with Python for MAX's Python API and C++ for low-level kernels. It relies on LLVM and other compiler infrastructure, and is licensed under Apache 2.0 with LLVM exceptions.
en.hot: With 268 stars added today and 27,933 total, it tops the GitHub Trending daily chart. The unique positioning of Mojo and MAX attracts AI developers, drawing attention to its high performance and unified platform concept.
uses: AI developers: Use Mojo to write high-performance AI models or leverage MAX for deployment and inference.
MLOps engineers: Quickly set up OpenAI-compatible model serving with the MAX inference server.
Researchers: Integrate custom model architectures in MAX pipelines and optimize performance with the accelerator library.
Open-source contributors: Contribute to the Mojo standard library, MAX accelerator library, and more.

zh.tag: 长周期AI代理的开放、中立、有状态控制平面
zh.what: LoopX 是一个轻量级状态内核和本地优先的控制平面，用于管理长期运行的 AI 代理。它运行在任何代理框架（如 Codex、Claude Code）之上，提供持久状态、语义决策、治理、恢复和人机协作，使长周期工作可审查、可重启、易交接。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的文档站点、开发者手册（中英双语）、快速入门指南、以及核心的 Python 控制平面实现。还提供了社交预览图、徽章和社区链接（Discord、飞书手册）。
zh.stack: 基于 Python 3.11+ 构建，采用本地优先架构，与多种代理框架集成（如 Codex、Claude Code、Cursor 等）。使用 Apache-2.0 许可证，并依赖 pyproject.toml 管理依赖。
zh.hot: 本月新增 5248 星，总星数达 5394，登上 GitHub Trending 月榜第 8。其“代理中立”和“状态控制平面”理念切中长周期 AI 代理管理的痛点，受到开发者热捧。
uses: 需要管理复杂、多步骤 AI 代理任务的开发者，确保工作可追踪和可恢复。
使用 Codex、Claude Code 等工具进行自动化编码的团队，希望增加治理和人类监督。
对 AI 代理编排和状态管理感兴趣的研究者或工程师，用于构建自定义控制平面。

en.tag: Open, provider-neutral, stateful control plane for long-horizon agents
en.what: LoopX is a lightweight state kernel and local-first control plane for managing long-running AI agents. It runs on top of any agent harness (e.g., Codex, Claude Code), providing durable state, semantic decisions, governance, recovery, and human-agent collaboration, making long-horizon work reviewable, restartable, and easy to hand off.
en.content: The repository includes a full documentation site, a bilingual developer book, getting-started guides, and the core Python control-plane implementation. It also provides social preview images, badges, and community links (Discord, Feishu manual).
en.stack: Built with Python 3.11+, local-first architecture, integrating with multiple agent harnesses (e.g., Codex, Claude Code, Cursor). Licensed under Apache-2.0, with dependencies managed via pyproject.toml.
en.hot: Gained 5,248 stars this month, reaching 5,394 total, ranking #8 on GitHub Trending monthly. Its 'provider-neutral' and 'stateful control plane' concept hits the pain point of long-horizon AI agent management, gaining rapid traction.
uses: Developers managing complex, multi-step AI agent tasks, ensuring work is traceable and recoverable.
Teams using Codex, Claude Code, etc., for automated coding, seeking governance and human oversight.
Researchers or engineers interested in AI agent orchestration and state management, for building custom control planes.

zh.tag: 让 AI 助手直接给答案，告别啰嗦铺垫
zh.what: 这是一个用于编码助手的技能包，强制 AI 输出简洁、可操作的答案，避免冗长铺垫和无关内容。它基于 ADHD 友好原则，让回复直接给出行动步骤，适合所有希望提高效率的用户。
zh.content: 仓库包含一个 SKILL.md 文件，定义了 10 条规则，如“先行动”“步骤编号”“结尾给出下一步”等。还提供安装说明、多语言 README 和示例对比，展示启用前后的输出差异。
zh.stack: 主要基于 Claude Code 的插件系统，使用 Markdown 定义技能规则。无复杂依赖，仅需 Python 环境（用于仓库元数据）。
zh.hot: 本月新增 20926 星，总星数 21466，登顶 GitHub Trending 月榜。它精准击中开发者对 AI 助手冗长回复的痛点，以极简方式提升效率，引发广泛共鸣。
uses: 开发者：希望 AI 编程助手直接给出可执行步骤，减少阅读负担。
团队：统一 AI 输出风格，提升代码审查和协作效率。
任何 AI 用户：厌倦了“Great question!”式开场，想要更直接的答案。

en.tag: Make coding agents answer directly, no fluff.
en.what: A skill for coding assistants that enforces concise, actionable answers, cutting out verbose preambles and tangents. Based on ADHD-friendly principles, it makes responses direct and step-by-step, benefiting anyone who wants faster, clearer outputs.
en.content: The repo contains a SKILL.md file with 10 rules like 'Lead with the next action' and 'Number multi-step tasks'. It also includes installation instructions, multilingual READMEs, and before/after examples showing the output difference.
en.stack: Built on Claude Code's plugin system, using Markdown to define skill rules. No heavy dependencies; Python is only for repo metadata.
en.hot: With 20,926 stars added this month (total 21,466), it topped the GitHub Trending monthly chart. It hits the pain point of verbose AI responses, offering a minimalist fix that resonates widely.
uses: Developers who want coding assistants to give actionable steps without extra reading.
Teams standardizing AI output style for faster code reviews and collaboration.
Any AI user tired of 'Great question!' preambles and seeking direct answers.

zh.tag: 邮箱账号关联查询 OSINT 工具
zh.what: holehe 是一个 OSINT 工具，用于检查邮箱是否在 Twitter、Instagram 等 120 多个网站上注册过账号。它利用“忘记密码”功能来获取相关信息，且不会向目标邮箱发送任何通知。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Python 包和命令行工具，支持通过 PyPI、GitHub 或 Docker 安装。提供 CLI 和 Python API，模块化设计，每个模块返回标准化的 JSON 格式数据。
zh.stack: 基于 Python 3，使用 trio 和 httpx 进行异步 HTTP 请求，依赖少量第三方库。
zh.hot: star 数达 12k+，今日新增 195，因其在 OSINT 和隐私研究领域的高效性和隐蔽性而广受欢迎。
uses: 安全研究人员进行账号枚举和足迹分析
隐私保护者检查自己的邮箱暴露范围
调查记者或社工场景下的信息收集
开发者集成到自定义 OSINT 工具链

en.tag: OSINT tool to check email registrations across sites
en.what: holehe is an OSINT tool that checks if an email is registered on over 120 websites like Twitter and Instagram. It retrieves information via the forgotten password function without alerting the target email.
en.content: The repo contains a Python package and CLI tool, installable via PyPI, GitHub, or Docker. It offers both CLI and Python API, with modular design returning standardized JSON data.
en.stack: Built on Python 3, uses trio and httpx for async HTTP requests, with minimal third-party dependencies.
en.hot: With 12k+ stars and 195 new today, it's popular for its efficiency and stealth in OSINT and privacy research.
uses: Security researchers for account enumeration and footprinting
Privacy-conscious individuals checking their email exposure
Investigative journalists or social engineering info gathering
Developers integrating into custom OSINT pipelines

zh.tag: 免费公共 API 大全，开发者资源宝库
zh.what: 这是一个由社区维护的免费公共 API 集合，涵盖动物、动漫、反恶意软件、艺术与设计、认证与授权、区块链、书籍、商业、日历、云存储与文件等众多领域。它为开发者提供了丰富的 API 资源，方便他们快速查找和集成到自己的项目中。
zh.content: 仓库以 README 为主，按类别列出所有 API，每个 API 包含名称、描述、认证方式、是否支持 HTTPS 和 CORS 等信息。此外，还包含贡献指南和 API 提交要求。
zh.stack: 仓库本身是纯文档，主要使用 Markdown 编写。主语言标记为 Python，但实际内容不涉及代码。
zh.hot: 该仓库拥有超过 46 万 star，是 GitHub 上最受欢迎的资源列表之一。今日新增 2260 star，持续受到开发者关注，因为它提供了免费 API 的集中索引，节省了开发者搜索和筛选的时间。
uses: 开发者寻找免费 API 用于个人项目或原型开发
技术爱好者探索不同领域的 API，学习集成方法
产品经理或创业者调研可用的 API 服务，评估可行性
教育场景中作为教学资源，帮助学生了解 API 生态

en.tag: A curated list of free public APIs for developers
en.what: This is a community-maintained collection of free public APIs, covering a wide range of categories such as Animals, Anime, Anti-Malware, Art & Design, Authentication & Authorization, Blockchain, Books, Business, Calendar, Cloud Storage & File, and more. zh.what: delegate-skills 是一个用于编排多个编码代理CLI的工具，允许你发现已安装的代理CLI，将它们组织成车道（如feature、tests、ui），然后按车道或直接委派编码任务。你保留审阅和提交的最终控制权。

zh.stack: 基于JavaScript/Node.js，通过npx安装，依赖skills.sh生态。支持多种编码代理CLI，如Aider、Codex、OpenCode、Cursor等。
zh.hot: 随着AI编码代理的普及，开发者需要统一编排多个代理。该项目提供了灵活的车道委派模式，让开发者保持控制权，因此迅速获得关注，今日新增32星，登上JavaScript日榜第三。
uses: 使用多个AI编码代理（如Codex、Aider）的开发者，希望统一管理并委派任务。
团队希望为不同任务类型（如功能、测试、UI）配置专用代理，并保持代码审阅流程。
喜欢手动控制提交的开发者，希望代理只负责实现，自己负责审阅和合并。

en.tag: Orchestrate multiple coding agent CLIs, delegate by lanes, review and commit yourself
en.what: delegate-skills is a tool for orchestrating multiple coding agent CLIs. It lets you discover installed agent CLIs, organize them into lanes (e.g., feature, tests, ui), and delegate coding tasks by lane or directly. You retain final control over review and commit.
en.content: The repo contains multiple skill directories, such as delegate-setup for discovering and configuring fleets, and delegation skills for different CLIs (e.g., codex-delegate, aider-delegate). Each skill has detailed SKILL.md docs and a configuration schema.
en.stack: Built on JavaScript/Node.js, installed via npx, leverages the skills.sh ecosystem. Supports multiple coding agent CLIs like Aider, Codex, OpenCode, Cursor.
en.hot: With the rise of AI coding agents, developers need unified orchestration. This project offers a flexible lane-based delegation model while keeping control, gaining 32 stars today and ranking #3 on the JavaScript daily trending list.
uses: Developers using multiple AI coding agents (e.g., Codex, Aider) who want unified management and delegation.
Teams that want to configure dedicated agents for different task types (e.g., feature, tests, UI) while keeping review workflow.
Developers who prefer manual commit control, letting agents implement while they review and merge.

zh.tag: 一条命令为你的硬件找到最合适的 LLM 模型
zh.what: llmfit 是一个终端工具，能根据你的系统 RAM、CPU 和 GPU 自动检测硬件，并为数百个模型和提供商评分，告诉你哪些模型能在你的机器上流畅运行。它提供交互式 TUI 和经典 CLI 两种模式，支持多 GPU、MoE 架构、动态量化选择、速度估算以及本地运行时提供商（如 Ollama、llama.cpp 等）。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 源码、TUI 和 CLI 实现、基准测试指南（docs/benchmarking.md）、TUI 指南（docs/tui.md），以及用于演示的 demo.gif 和图标资源。
zh.stack: 基于 Rust 构建，依赖终端 UI 库（如 ratatui）和模型推理后端（Ollama、llama.cpp、MLX 等），通过 crates.io 分发。
zh.hot: 星标数达 32k，今日新增近 200，因其解决了本地 LLM 选型的痛点，且新版本支持基准测试并贡献结果，让用户获得真实硬件上的实测数据，迅速走红。
uses: 本地 LLM 爱好者：快速找到适合自己电脑配置的模型，避免下载后跑不动的尴尬。
开发者：在开发环境中评估不同模型的性能，优化推理速度和资源占用。
硬件评测者：通过基准测试功能，分享自己机器上的实测数据，帮助社区完善模型适配信息。

en.tag: One command to find the right LLM for your hardware
en.what: llmfit is a terminal tool that detects your hardware and scores hundreds of models across quality, speed, fit, and context dimensions, telling you which ones will run well on your machine. It features an interactive TUI and classic CLI mode, supporting multi-GPU setups, MoE architectures, dynamic quantization, speed estimation, and local runtime providers like Ollama and llama.cpp.
en.content: The repo contains Rust source code, TUI and CLI implementations, benchmarking guide (docs/benchmarking.md), TUI guide (docs/tui.md), plus demo.gif and icon assets.
en.stack: Built with Rust, leveraging terminal UI libraries (e.g., ratatui) and model inference backends (Ollama, llama.cpp, MLX, etc.), distributed via crates.io.
en.hot: With 32k stars and ~200 new today, it solves the pain point of choosing the right local LLM, and the new benchmarking feature lets users contribute real measured data, driving its popularity.
uses: Local LLM enthusiasts: quickly find models that fit your hardware, avoiding downloads that won't run.
Developers: evaluate model performance in dev environments to optimize inference speed and resource usage.
Hardware reviewers: use benchmarking to share real measured data and improve community model-fit information.

zh.tag: 终端里的轻量 AI 编程代理
zh.what: Codex CLI 是 OpenAI 推出的本地运行编码代理，能在终端中直接执行代码任务。它支持与 ChatGPT 计划集成，也可通过 API 密钥使用，提供命令行交互体验。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 编写的 CLI 工具，提供安装脚本、二进制发布包及文档，支持 npm、Homebrew 等安装方式。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 语言开发，依赖 OpenAI API 或 ChatGPT 认证，支持跨平台（macOS、Linux、Windows）。
zh.hot: 作为 OpenAI 官方开源项目，今日新增 2729 星，总星数突破 11 万，登顶 GitHub 日榜，开发者期待在终端中直接使用 AI 编程。
uses: 开发者希望在终端中快速执行 AI 辅助编码任务，无需离开命令行环境。
使用 ChatGPT Plus/Pro 等计划的用户，可无缝集成现有订阅进行编程。
需要轻量级、可脚本化的代码生成与修改工具的技术团队。

en.tag: Lightweight AI coding agent that runs in your terminal
en.what: Codex CLI is a coding agent from OpenAI that runs locally on your computer. It executes coding tasks directly in the terminal, integrates with ChatGPT plans, and can also be used with an API key.
en.content: The repository contains a Rust-based CLI tool, installation scripts, binary release assets, and documentation, with support for npm and Homebrew installation.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Rust, it relies on OpenAI API or ChatGPT authentication, and supports cross-platform (macOS, Linux, Windows).
en.hot: As an official OpenAI open-source project, it gained 2,729 stars today, surpassing 110k total stars and topping the daily GitHub trending list. Developers are eager to use AI coding directly in the terminal.
uses: Developers who want to perform AI-assisted coding tasks quickly in the terminal without leaving the command line.
Users with ChatGPT Plus/Pro plans who can seamlessly integrate their existing subscription for coding.
Tech teams needing a lightweight, scriptable tool for code generation and modification.

zh.tag: 本地优先的极速微虚拟机运行时，秒级启动隔离环境
zh.what: Microsandbox 是一个用 Rust 编写的轻量级微虚拟机运行时，能在本地快速启动隔离环境，用于运行不可信代码，如 AI 代理、用户脚本、CI 任务等。它提供硬件级隔离，同时保持 Docker 类似的工作流，启动时间平均低于 100 毫秒。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 源码、文档、示例、Agent Skills 和 MCP 服务器集成，以及用于构建和发布的配置。核心是一个可嵌入的库，允许在代码中直接生成虚拟机，无需守护进程。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编程语言，依赖微虚拟机技术（如 Firecracker 或类似），支持 OCI 容器镜像，跨平台（Linux、macOS、Windows）。
zh.hot: 随着 AI 代理和不可信代码执行需求的增长，开发者需要快速、安全的隔离方案。Microsandbox 提供了低于 100 毫秒的启动时间和硬件级隔离，在 GitHub 上迅速获得关注，本月新增 959 星，总星数达 8021。
uses: AI 代理开发者：为代理提供安全的沙箱环境，执行用户代码或插件。
CI/CD 工程师：在隔离环境中运行测试或构建任务，防止恶意代码影响主机。
安全研究人员：分析不可信二进制或脚本，利用硬件隔离降低风险。
平台工程师：将微虚拟机嵌入应用，实现多租户隔离或动态代码执行。

en.tag: Fast, local-first microVM runtime for untrusted workloads
en.what: Microsandbox is a lightweight microVM runtime written in Rust that quickly launches isolated environments locally for untrusted workloads like AI agents, user code, CI jobs, and automation. It offers hardware-level isolation with Docker-like workflows and average boot times under 100 milliseconds.
en.content: The repository contains Rust source code, documentation, examples, integrations for Agent Skills and MCP server, and build/release configurations. The core is an embeddable library that spawns VMs directly in code without a daemon.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, leveraging microVM technology (like Firecracker), supports OCI container images, and is cross-platform (Linux, macOS, Windows).
en.hot: With the rise of AI agents and untrusted code execution, developers need fast, secure isolation. Microsandbox offers sub-100ms boot times and hardware-level isolation, quickly gaining traction with 959 stars this month, reaching 8,021 total.
uses: AI agent developers: provide secure sandboxes for agents to execute user code or plugins.
CI/CD engineers: run tests or build tasks in isolated environments to prevent malicious code from affecting the host.
Security researchers: analyze untrusted binaries or scripts with hardware isolation to reduce risk.
Platform engineers: embed microVMs into applications for multi-tenant isolation or dynamic code execution.

zh.tag: 一站式开发环境管理工具
zh.what: mise 是一个开发工具、环境变量和任务运行器的统一 CLI。它通过一个 mise.toml 文件管理项目工具、环境变量和任务，确保新 shell、检出和 CI 作业从相同的设置开始。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 源码、文档、演示 GIF 和配置文件。核心功能包括安装和切换数百种开发工具、按项目目录加载环境变量（包括 .env 文件），以及定义和运行构建、测试、lint 和部署任务。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编写，依赖 crates.io 生态。支持多种后端，如 npm、pip、go 等，用于安装工具。
zh.hot: mise 在 Rust 社区中热度高，今日新增 258 星，总星数达 31926。它解决了开发环境配置的痛点，将多个工具整合为一个 CLI，受到开发者的欢迎。
uses: 开发者：需要管理多个项目工具版本和环境的个人开发者
团队：希望统一开发环境配置，减少新成员上手成本的团队
CI/CD：需要确保 CI 作业与本地环境一致的持续集成场景
多语言开发者：频繁切换 Node、Python、Go 等语言的开发者

en.tag: All-in-one dev environment manager
en.what: mise is a unified CLI for dev tools, environment variables, and task runner. It manages project tools, env vars, and tasks in one mise.toml file, ensuring new shells, checkouts, and CI jobs start from the same setup.
en.content: The repository contains Rust source code, documentation, demo GIFs, and configuration files. Core features include installing and switching between hundreds of dev tools, loading environment variables per project directory (including .env files), and defining and running tasks for building, testing, linting, and deploying.
en.stack: Written in Rust, leveraging the crates.io ecosystem. Supports various backends like npm, pip, go, etc., for installing tools.
en.hot: mise is trending in the Rust community with 258 stars today and 31,926 total. It solves the pain point of dev environment setup by consolidating multiple tools into one CLI, gaining popularity among developers.
uses: Developers: individuals managing multiple project tool versions and environments
Teams: teams wanting to unify dev environment config and reduce onboarding cost
CI/CD: continuous integration scenarios needing consistency with local environments
Polyglot developers: those frequently switching between Node, Python, Go, etc.

zh.tag: 开源 AI 原生矢量设计工具，支持多智能体协作
zh.what: OpenPencil 是全球首个开源 AI 原生矢量设计工具，支持并发智能体团队。用户可以用自然语言描述界面，实时生成到无限画布上，并通过对话修改设计。它采用 Design-as-Code 理念，是 Pencil 的现代替代品。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 编写的核心引擎、桌面应用（op-host-desktop）、内置 MCP 服务器、多模型支持，以及多语言 README 和演示视频。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 构建，可能涉及 Tauri 或类似框架用于桌面应用，集成 MCP 服务器和多模型 AI 能力。
zh.hot: 作为首个开源 AI 原生矢量设计工具，概念新颖，结合 AI 代理团队和实时生成，吸引了大量关注。今日新增 32 星，总星数达 4772，位列 Rust 趋势榜第三。
uses: 设计师和开发者：快速将想法转化为 UI 原型，提升设计效率。
产品经理：用自然语言描述需求，即时生成界面方案。
AI 爱好者：探索多智能体协作在创意工具中的应用。
开源社区：参与开发，扩展 MCP 服务器和模型集成。

en.tag: Open-source AI-native vector design tool with concurrent agent teams
en.what: OpenPencil is the world's first open-source AI-native vector design tool featuring concurrent agent teams. Users can describe UI in natural language and watch it appear on an infinite canvas in real-time, then modify designs through chat. It embraces Design-as-Code and serves as a modern alternative to Pencil.
en.content: The repository includes a Rust-based core engine, desktop app (op-host-desktop), built-in MCP server, multi-model intelligence, along with multilingual READMEs and demo videos.
en.stack: Primarily built with Rust, likely using Tauri or similar for the desktop app, integrating MCP server and multi-model AI capabilities.
en.hot: As the first open-source AI-native vector design tool, its novel concept combining AI agent teams and real-time generation attracts attention. With 32 stars today and 4772 total, it ranks #3 on the Rust trending list.
uses: Designers and developers: quickly turn ideas into UI prototypes, boosting design efficiency.
Product managers: describe requirements in natural language and get instant interface proposals.
AI enthusiasts: explore multi-agent collaboration in creative tools.
Open-source community: contribute to development, extend MCP server and model integrations.

zh.tag: Rust 原生高性能量化交易平台
zh.what: NautilusTrader 是一个基于 Rust 的高性能量化交易平台，采用确定性事件驱动架构，专为生产环境设计。它提供低延迟、高吞吐量的交易执行和回测能力，同时支持 Python 接口，便于策略开发和集成。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心交易引擎、回测模块、市场数据适配器、策略框架以及多种交易所连接器。代码主要用 Rust 编写，同时提供 Python 绑定，包含完整的文档和示例。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编写，支持 Python 3.12-3.14，兼容 Linux、macOS 和 Windows。依赖包括 PyO3 用于 Python 绑定，以及 Arrow 等用于数据处理。
zh.hot: 凭借 25.9k 星标和今日新增 120 星，NautilusTrader 因其生产级 Rust 性能、确定性架构和活跃社区而备受关注，成为量化交易领域的热门选择。
uses: 量化交易员和算法工程师：用于构建低延迟交易策略和执行系统。
金融科技公司：作为交易基础设施的核心组件，支持回测和实盘交易。
研究人员：利用其高性能回测引擎进行策略研究和数据分析。
开发者：通过 Python API 快速原型设计，或使用 Rust 进行深度定制。

en.tag: Production-grade Rust-native algorithmic trading platform
en.what: NautilusTrader is a high-performance algorithmic trading platform built in Rust with a deterministic event-driven architecture, designed for production use. It offers low-latency, high-throughput execution and backtesting capabilities, with a Python API for strategy development and integration.
en.content: The repository contains the core trading engine, backtesting module, market data adapters, strategy framework, and various exchange connectors. The code is primarily in Rust with Python bindings, including comprehensive documentation and examples.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, with Python bindings for 3.12-3.14, supporting Linux, macOS, and Windows. Dependencies include PyO3 for Python bindings and Arrow for data handling.
en.hot: With 25.9k stars and 120 new stars today, NautilusTrader gains attention for its production-grade Rust performance, deterministic architecture, and active community, making it a popular choice in algorithmic trading.
uses: Quant traders and algo engineers: for building low-latency trading strategies and execution systems.
Fintech companies: as a core component of trading infrastructure for backtesting and live trading.
Researchers: leveraging its high-performance backtesting engine for strategy research and data analysis.
Developers: rapid prototyping via Python API or deep customization with Rust.

zh.tag: 零配置的终端 IDE，融合 VS Code 与 Sublime 的体验
zh.what: Fresh 是一款现代、功能全面的终端文本编辑器，主打零配置，提供熟悉的快捷键、鼠标支持和 IDE 级功能，无需学习曲线。它专为处理超大文件而优化，性能卓越。
zh.content: 仓库包含编辑器核心代码、安装脚本、文档和演示 GIF，涵盖命令面板、多光标编辑、主题定制、LSP 支持、Orchestrator 多任务等功能。
zh.stack: 使用 Rust 编写，依赖终端 UI 库（如 ratatui）和 LSP 协议实现，支持跨平台。
zh.hot: 本月新增 607 星，登上 GitHub Trending Rust 榜第 14 名。其零配置、易用性和高性能吸引了大量开发者，尤其是对终端编辑器感兴趣的用户。
uses: 适合喜欢在终端中工作但不想学习复杂快捷键的开发者，如 Vim/Emacs 新手。
需要处理超大文件（如日志文件）的开发者，Fresh 能高效加载。
希望获得 IDE 级功能（如 LSP、多光标）但偏好轻量级工具的用户。
对 Rust 和终端 UI 开发感兴趣的贡献者。

en.tag: Zero-config terminal IDE blending VS Code & Sublime UX
en.what: Fresh is a modern, full-featured terminal text editor with zero configuration, offering familiar keybindings, mouse support, and IDE-level features without a learning curve. It is optimized for handling huge files with high performance.
en.content: The repository includes the editor's core code, installation scripts, documentation, and demo GIFs, featuring command palette, multi-cursor editing, themes, LSP support, and the Orchestrator for multitasking.
en.stack: Written in Rust, leveraging terminal UI libraries (e.g., ratatui) and LSP protocol, cross-platform.
en.hot: Gained 607 stars this month, ranking #14 on GitHub Trending Rust. Its zero-config, ease of use, and high performance attract developers, especially terminal editor enthusiasts.
uses: Developers who prefer terminal work but dislike steep learning curves, e.g., Vim/Emacs beginners.
Those handling huge files (e.g., logs) that need efficient loading.
Users wanting IDE-level features (LSP, multi-cursor) in a lightweight tool.
Contributors interested in Rust and terminal UI development.

zh.tag: 开源多协议下载管理器，Rust 引擎，免费无广告
zh.what: FluxDown 是一款由 Rust 驱动的多协议下载管理器，支持 HTTP/FTP/BitTorrent 磁力链接以及 HLS/DASH 流媒体，提供智能多线程加速和浏览器无缝集成。它拥有精美界面和极致性能，永久免费且零广告。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 编写的原生引擎（native/engine）、Flutter 编写的跨平台 UI（lib）、以及 MCP 服务器等组件，提供 Windows/macOS/Linux/NAS/Android 多平台安装包。
zh.stack: 核心引擎使用 Rust 和 Tokio 异步运行时，UI 采用 Flutter，支持多平台桌面与移动端，并集成 MCP 服务器。
zh.hot: 本月新增约 1475 颗星，登上 GitHub Trending Rust 月榜第 15 名，作为免费开源的 IDM 替代品，凭借 10 倍提速和多协议支持迅速吸引用户。
uses: 需要高速下载 HTTP/FTP/BitTorrent 资源的普通用户，替代付费的 IDM
希望集成浏览器下载管理、提升流媒体下载体验的开发者或重度用户
在 NAS 或服务器上部署自托管下载服务的用户，支持 Docker 等部署方式

en.tag: Open-source multi-protocol download manager with Rust engine, free & ad-free
en.what: FluxDown is a Rust-powered multi-protocol download manager supporting HTTP/FTP/BitTorrent magnet links and HLS/DASH streaming, with intelligent multi-threading acceleration and seamless browser integration. It offers a polished UI and top-tier performance, completely free with no ads.
en.content: The repository contains a native engine written in Rust (native/engine), a cross-platform UI built with Flutter (lib), and an MCP server, offering installers for Windows/macOS/Linux/NAS/Android.
en.stack: Core engine built with Rust and Tokio async runtime, UI in Flutter, supporting multi-platform desktop and mobile, with MCP server integration.
en.hot: Gained ~1,475 stars this month, ranking #15 on GitHub Trending (Rust monthly), as a free open-source IDM alternative with 10x speedup and multi-protocol support.
uses: General users needing high-speed downloads over HTTP/FTP/BitTorrent, as a free IDM replacement
Developers or power users wanting browser-integrated download management and improved streaming downloads
Users deploying self-hosted download services on NAS or servers, with Docker support

zh.tag: 极速 DataFrame 查询引擎，Rust 编写，支持多语言
zh.what: Polars 是一个用 Rust 编写的极速 DataFrame 分析查询引擎，提供惰性/急切执行、查询优化和流式处理，支持超出内存的数据集。它提供 Python、Rust、Node.js、R 和 SQL 绑定，并可选 GPU 加速。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心 Rust 库、多语言绑定（Python、Node.js、R）、用户指南、文档和插件接口，以及用于扩展的 I/O 和表达式插件。
zh.stack: 基于 Rust 实现，利用多线程和 SIMD 向量化执行，采用 Apache Arrow 列式格式进行零拷贝数据共享，支持 GPU 加速（NVIDIA）。
zh.hot: Polars 凭借其卓越的性能和易用性在数据科学社区广受欢迎，star 数接近 4 万，今日新增 13 个，持续活跃。
uses: 数据科学家和分析师：处理大型数据集，进行快速数据清洗和转换。
数据工程师：构建高效的数据管道，处理超出内存的数据。
Python/R/Node.js 开发者：在各自语言环境中利用高性能 DataFrame 操作。
需要 GPU 加速查询的用户：利用 NVIDIA GPU 加速数据处理。

en.tag: Ultra-fast DataFrame query engine in Rust with multi-language bindings
en.what: Polars is an extremely fast DataFrame analytical query engine written in Rust, featuring lazy/eager execution, query optimization, and streaming for larger-than-RAM datasets. It offers bindings for Python, Rust, Node.js, R, and SQL, with optional GPU acceleration.
en.content: The repository contains the core Rust library, multi-language bindings (Python, Node.js, R), user guide, documentation, and plugin interfaces for I/O and expression extensions.
en.stack: Built on Rust with multi-threaded, vectorized (SIMD) execution, uses Apache Arrow columnar format for zero-copy data sharing, and supports optional NVIDIA GPU acceleration.

en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, relying on Cloudflare's APIs and protocols. Supports multiple installation methods including Docker and package managers.
en.hot: Gained 461 stars this month, totaling 15498, popular for its secure, port-free tunneling solution, especially for intranet penetration and remote access.
uses: Developers and DevOps who need to securely expose local web services to the public internet without router or firewall configuration.
Users requiring remote access to private network resources (e.g., SSH, RDP) via Layer 4 tunneling for secure connections.
Website administrators using Cloudflare services who want to establish a stable tunnel to their origin servers.
