zh.tag: 开源统一XDR与SIEM安全平台，保护端点与云负载
zh.what: Wazuh是一个免费开源的安全平台，用于威胁预防、检测和响应。它由部署在监控系统上的端点安全代理和收集分析代理数据的管理服务器组成，并已与Elastic Stack集成，提供搜索和数据可视化能力。
zh.content: 仓库包含Wazuh的核心组件，包括代理（agent）、管理服务器（manager）、规则集、文档和安装脚本。支持入侵检测、日志分析、文件完整性监控和漏洞检测等功能。
zh.stack: 主要使用C++编写，依赖Elastic Stack（Elasticsearch、Kibana）进行数据存储和可视化，支持跨平台部署（Linux、Windows、macOS等）。
zh.hot: 本月新增431星，总星数达16485，位列C++趋势榜第25。作为开源安全平台的代表，其统一XDR和SIEM能力受到广泛关注。
uses: 安全运维团队：用于集中监控和管理企业安全事件，实现威胁检测与响应。
合规审计人员：利用文件完整性监控和日志分析满足PCI DSS等合规要求。
云原生环境：保护容器和云工作负载，集成威胁情报识别风险。
开源爱好者：学习大型C++安全项目架构和实现。

en.tag: Open-source unified XDR and SIEM platform for endpoint and cloud workload protection
en.what: Wazuh is a free and open-source security platform for threat prevention, detection, and response. It consists of an endpoint security agent deployed on monitored systems and a management server that collects and analyzes agent data, fully integrated with the Elastic Stack for search and visualization.
en.content: The repository contains core components of Wazuh, including agents, manager, rulesets, documentation, and installation scripts. It supports intrusion detection, log analysis, file integrity monitoring, and vulnerability detection.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, relies on the Elastic Stack (Elasticsearch, Kibana) for data storage and visualization, and supports cross-platform deployment (Linux, Windows, macOS, etc.).
en.hot: With 431 stars added this month and a total of 16,485, it ranks 25th on the C++ trending list. As a leading open-source security platform, its unified XDR and SIEM capabilities attract significant attention.
uses: Security operations teams: for centralized monitoring and management of security events, enabling threat detection and response.
Compliance auditors: leveraging file integrity monitoring and log analysis to meet regulatory requirements like PCI DSS.
Cloud-native environments: protecting containers and cloud workloads with integrated threat intelligence.
Open-source enthusiasts: learning the architecture and implementation of a large-scale C++ security project.

zh.tag: 纯C/C++的高性能LLM推理引擎
zh.what: llama.cpp 是一个用纯 C/C++ 编写的高性能大语言模型推理引擎，支持在 CPU 和 GPU 上高效运行。它针对本地部署和资源受限环境进行了优化，无需依赖庞大的深度学习框架。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心推理库 libllama、命令行工具、REST API 服务器（llama-server）以及 WebUI。支持多种量化格式（如 GGUF）和模型架构（如 LLaMA、GPT-OSS）。
zh.stack: 纯 C/C++ 实现，依赖 ggml 张量库，可选支持 CUDA、Vulkan、Metal 等 GPU 加速后端。
zh.hot: 作为最流行的本地 LLM 推理方案之一，llama.cpp 持续获得社区关注，今日新增 159 星，总星数突破 12 万。其高性能、跨平台和易用性使其成为 AI 开发者和爱好者的首选。
uses: AI 开发者：在本地或边缘设备上运行和测试大语言模型
隐私敏感用户：无需联网即可使用 LLM，数据完全本地化
研究人员：探索模型量化、推理优化和自定义模型架构

en.tag: High-performance LLM inference engine in pure C/C++
en.what: llama.cpp is a high-performance LLM inference engine written in pure C/C++, optimized for CPU and GPU execution. It enables efficient local deployment without heavy deep learning frameworks.
en.content: The repo includes the core inference library libllama, CLI tools, a REST API server (llama-server), and a WebUI. It supports various quantization formats (e.g., GGUF) and model architectures (e.g., LLaMA, GPT-OSS).
en.stack: Pure C/C++ implementation, relies on the ggml tensor library, with optional GPU backends like CUDA, Vulkan, and Metal.
en.hot: As one of the most popular local LLM inference solutions, llama.cpp continues to gain community traction with 159 new stars today, surpassing 120K total. Its performance, cross-platform support, and ease of use make it a top choice for AI developers and enthusiasts.
uses: AI developers: run and test LLMs locally or on edge devices
Privacy-conscious users: use LLMs offline with full data locality
Researchers: explore quantization, inference optimization, and custom model architectures

zh.tag: Windows 开源用户态调试器，主打逆向工程与恶意软件分析
zh.what: x64dbg 是一款面向 Windows 的开源用户态调试器，专为逆向工程和恶意软件分析设计。它支持 32 位和 64 位程序调试，提供丰富的功能，并可通过插件系统扩展。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的调试器源码，包括图形界面、调试核心、反汇编引擎、插件 API 以及文档和构建脚本。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 Qt 框架、Capstone 反汇编引擎、Zydis 等，支持 Windows 平台。
zh.hot: 作为免费开源的逆向工程利器，x64dbg 拥有近 5 万 star，本月新增 399，持续受到安全研究者和恶意软件分析师的青睐。
uses: 逆向工程师用于分析二进制程序、理解代码逻辑和漏洞挖掘。
恶意软件分析师在受控环境中调试和分析恶意样本。
安全爱好者学习汇编和操作系统底层机制。
CTF 参赛者用于解决逆向工程挑战题。

en.tag: Open-source user-mode debugger for Windows, focused on reverse engineering and malware analysis
en.what: x64dbg is an open-source user-mode debugger for Windows, designed for reverse engineering and malware analysis. It supports debugging both 32-bit and 64-bit executables, offers a wide range of features, and is extensible via a comprehensive plugin system.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code of the debugger, including the GUI, debugging core, disassembly engine, plugin API, along with documentation and build scripts.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, it relies on Qt framework, Capstone disassembly engine, Zydis, and others, targeting Windows platforms.
en.hot: As a free and open-source reverse engineering tool, x64dbg has nearly 50k stars, with 399 added this month, continuously favored by security researchers and malware analysts.
uses: Reverse engineers use it to analyze binaries, understand code logic, and discover vulnerabilities.
Malware analysts debug and analyze malicious samples in controlled environments.
Security enthusiasts learn assembly and low-level OS mechanisms.
CTF players solve reverse engineering challenges with it.

zh.tag: 开源游戏串流客户端，支持多平台与 Sunshine
zh.what: Moonlight PC 是一款开源的 PC 客户端，用于连接 NVIDIA GameStream 和 Sunshine 服务，实现游戏串流。它支持硬件加速解码、HDR、7.1 环绕声等特性，让用户可以在不同设备上流畅游玩 PC 游戏。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的客户端源码、构建配置、文档和翻译资源，支持 Windows、macOS、Linux 及 Steam Link 等平台。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 和 Qt 框架，依赖 FFmpeg 进行视频解码，支持多种编解码器（H.264、HEVC、AV1）。
zh.hot: 随着 Sunshine 的流行，Moonlight 作为其官方推荐的客户端，用户需求大增，本月新增 433 星，总星数达 1.8 万，位列 C++ 趋势榜第九。
uses: 游戏玩家：在局域网或互联网上串流玩 PC 游戏，享受低延迟和高画质。
远程办公用户：通过 Moonlight 远程控制桌面，处理工作任务。
开发者与爱好者：研究游戏串流技术，或为 Moonlight 贡献代码和翻译。

en.tag: Open-source game streaming client for PC, supporting Sunshine and more
en.what: Moonlight PC is an open-source client for NVIDIA GameStream and Sunshine, enabling game streaming. It features hardware-accelerated decoding, HDR, and 7.1 surround sound, allowing smooth gameplay across devices.
en.content: The repository contains full client source code, build configurations, documentation, and translation resources, supporting Windows, macOS, Linux, and Steam Link.
en.stack: Primarily C++ with Qt framework, leveraging FFmpeg for video decoding, supporting H.264, HEVC, and AV1 codecs.
en.hot: With the rise of Sunshine, Moonlight as its recommended client has seen increased demand, gaining 433 stars this month and reaching 18.5k total, ranking 9th in C++ trending.
uses: Gamers: stream PC games over LAN or internet with low latency and high quality.
Remote workers: use Moonlight for remote desktop control and productivity.
Developers and enthusiasts: study game streaming tech or contribute code and translations.

zh.tag: AI视频超分辨率与补帧工具
zh.what: Video2X 是一个基于机器学习的视频超分辨率和帧插值框架，能够提升视频分辨率和帧率。它支持多种算法，如 Anime4K、Real-ESRGAN 等，并提供图形界面和命令行工具。
zh.content: 仓库包含 C/C++ 重写的核心库、Windows 安装程序、Linux 支持、GUI 界面以及文档。
zh.stack: 基于 C/C++，利用 ncnn 和 Vulkan 加速，支持 Anime4K、Real-ESRGAN、Real-CUGAN 和 RIFE 模型。
zh.hot: 6.0 版本完全重写，性能大幅提升，跨平台支持，且今日新增 174 星，登上 C++ 趋势榜。
uses: 动漫爱好者提升老番画质，享受高清视觉体验。
视频创作者对素材进行超分和补帧，提升作品质量。
研究人员测试不同超分算法效果，进行对比实验。

en.tag: AI-powered video upscaling and frame interpolation tool
en.what: Video2X is a machine learning-based framework for video super-resolution and frame interpolation, enhancing video resolution and frame rate. It supports algorithms like Anime4K and Real-ESRGAN, with both GUI and CLI.
en.content: The repository includes a C/C++ rewritten core library, Windows installer, Linux support, GUI, and documentation.
en.stack: Built with C/C++, accelerated via ncnn and Vulkan, supporting Anime4K, Real-ESRGAN, Real-CUGAN, and RIFE models.
en.hot: Version 6.0 is a complete rewrite with significant performance gains and cross-platform support, gaining 174 stars today and trending in C++.
uses: Anime fans upscale old shows for a high-definition viewing experience.
Video creators enhance footage with super-resolution and frame interpolation to improve quality.
Researchers test and compare different super-resolution algorithms for experiments.

zh.tag: Minecraft 多实例管理启动器，MultiMC 分支
zh.what: Prism Launcher 是一款开源的 Minecraft 启动器，允许用户同时管理多个游戏安装，支持模组、整合包和版本切换。它是 MultiMC 的分支，但提供了更多社区功能和改进。
zh.content: 仓库包含启动器的完整源代码，包括核心逻辑、界面、构建脚本和文档。支持 Windows、Linux 和 macOS，并提供稳定版和开发版构建。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 和 Qt 框架，依赖 CMake 构建系统，支持多种平台。
zh.hot: 拥有超过 1 万 star，本月新增 310，因其强大的多实例管理功能和活跃的社区支持而受欢迎。
uses: Minecraft 玩家需要同时管理多个游戏版本或模组配置时使用。
模组开发者或整合包作者需要快速测试不同环境时使用。
希望替代官方启动器获得更多自定义选项的高级用户。

en.tag: Custom Minecraft launcher for managing multiple instances, fork of MultiMC
en.what: Prism Launcher is an open-source Minecraft launcher that lets users manage multiple game installations simultaneously, supporting mods, modpacks, and version switching. It is a fork of MultiMC with additional community-driven features and improvements.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code of the launcher, including core logic, UI, build scripts, and documentation. It supports Windows, Linux, and macOS, with stable and development builds available.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++ with the Qt framework, using CMake for building, and supporting multiple platforms.
en.hot: With over 10k stars and 310 added this month, it's popular for its robust multi-instance management and active community support.
uses: For Minecraft players who need to manage multiple game versions or mod configurations simultaneously.
For mod developers or modpack authors who need to quickly test different environments.
For advanced users who want more customization options than the official launcher.

zh.tag: 真正独立的现代网页浏览器，基于全新引擎
zh.what: Ladybird 是一个真正独立的网页浏览器，采用基于 Web 标准的新颖引擎，旨在构建完整、可用的现代浏览器。它目前处于预 alpha 阶段，仅适合开发者使用。
zh.content: 仓库包含浏览器的主要源代码，采用多进程架构，包括 UI 主进程、多个 WebContent 渲染进程、ImageDecoder 进程和 RequestServer 进程。核心库组件继承自 SerenityOS，如 LibWeb、LibJS、LibWasm 等。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 SerenityOS 的多个库（LibWeb、LibJS、LibWasm 等），支持 Linux、macOS、Windows（WSL2）等平台。
zh.hot: 作为真正独立的浏览器项目，Ladybird 在开发者中引起广泛关注，star 数已达 64,842，今日新增 42，位列 C++ 日榜第一。
uses: 对浏览器引擎感兴趣的开发者，可以学习其架构和实现。
希望参与开源浏览器项目贡献的开发者。
关注 Web 标准和技术前沿的技术爱好者。

en.tag: A truly independent web browser with a novel standards-based engine
en.what: Ladybird is a truly independent web browser with a novel standards-based engine, aiming to build a complete, usable browser for the modern web. It is currently in pre-alpha state and only suitable for developers.
en.content: The repository contains the main source code of the browser, using a multi-process architecture with a main UI process, several WebContent renderer processes, an ImageDecoder process, and a RequestServer process. Core library components are inherited from SerenityOS, such as LibWeb, LibJS, LibWasm, etc.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, relying on several SerenityOS libraries (LibWeb, LibJS, LibWasm, etc.), supporting Linux, macOS, Windows (with WSL2), and other *NIXes.
en.hot: As a truly independent browser project, Ladybird has gained significant attention among developers, with 64,842 stars and 42 new stars today, ranking first on the C++ daily trending list.
uses: Developers interested in browser engines, to learn its architecture and implementation.
Developers who want to contribute to an open-source browser project.
Tech enthusiasts following web standards and cutting-edge technology.

zh.tag: 可扩展分布式梯度提升库，支持多语言多平台
zh.what: XGBoost 是一个优化的分布式梯度提升库，旨在高效、灵活且可移植。它实现了梯度提升框架下的机器学习算法，提供并行树提升（GBDT、GBM），能够快速准确地解决许多数据科学问题。同一套代码可在 Kubernetes、Hadoop、Spark 等分布式环境运行，处理数十亿样本。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心 C++ 实现、多语言接口（Python、R、Java、Scala、C++ 等）、分布式集成（Spark、Dask、Flink 等）、文档、示例和测试。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，提供 Python、R、Java、Scala 等语言绑定，支持分布式框架如 Spark、Dask、Flink 和 DataFlow。
zh.hot: XGBoost 是机器学习竞赛和工业界的经典工具，拥有 28.7k 星标，本月新增 126 星，持续活跃。其高效性和多平台支持使其成为数据科学家的首选。
uses: 数据科学家和机器学习工程师用于构建高性能的梯度提升模型，解决分类、回归和排序问题。
需要在大规模数据集上训练模型的企业，利用其分布式能力处理海量数据。
Kaggle 竞赛参与者，利用其准确性和速度提升模型表现。
研究人员和开发者，通过其多语言接口集成到现有系统中。

en.tag: Scalable, portable, distributed gradient boosting library for multiple languages and platforms
en.what: XGBoost is an optimized distributed gradient boosting library designed to be highly efficient, flexible, and portable. It implements machine learning algorithms under the Gradient Boosting framework, providing parallel tree boosting (GBDT, GBM) that solves many data science problems fast and accurately. The same code runs on major distributed environments (Kubernetes, Hadoop, Spark, etc.) and can handle billions of examples.
en.content: The repository contains the core C++ implementation, multi-language interfaces (Python, R, Java, Scala, C++), distributed integrations (Spark, Dask, Flink), documentation, examples, and tests.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, with bindings for Python, R, Java, Scala, and more; supports distributed frameworks like Spark, Dask, Flink, and DataFlow.
en.hot: XGBoost is a classic tool in ML competitions and industry, with 28.7k stars and 126 new stars this month, remaining active. Its efficiency and multi-platform support make it a top choice for data scientists.
uses: Data scientists and ML engineers use it to build high-performance gradient boosting models for classification, regression, and ranking.
Enterprises needing to train models on large-scale datasets leverage its distributed capabilities to handle massive data.
Kaggle competitors utilize its accuracy and speed to improve model performance.
Researchers and developers integrate it into existing systems via its multi-language interfaces.

zh.tag: Google 开源的端到端机器学习框架与生态平台
zh.what: TensorFlow 是 Google 开发的端到端开源机器学习平台，提供从研究到生产部署的完整工具链与库生态。它让研究者能够推进机器学习前沿，也让开发者轻松构建和部署 AI 驱动的应用。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心 C++ 运行时、Python 与 C++ API、Keras 高级接口，以及 TensorFlow Lite、TensorFlow.js 等跨平台推理部署工具和丰富的官方示例。
zh.stack: 以 C++ 构建高性能计算后端，通过 Python 提供主要前端接口；支持 CUDA GPU 加速、Bazel 构建系统及 Docker 部署，并提供多语言绑定。
zh.hot: 作为深度学习领域最具影响力的基础框架之一，TensorFlow 凭借 196,329 星（本周新增 365 颗）和工业级稳定性，持续获得学术界与工业界的广泛采用。
uses: 机器学习研究者 —— 需要灵活底层接口进行模型创新与算法实验
AI 应用开发者 —— 希望借助 Keras 和 TF Lite 快速训练并部署到端侧或服务器
工程团队 —— 寻求从训练到推理的规模化、可移植生产流水线
高校学生 —— 学习深度学习原理与工程实践的首选框架之一

en.tag: Google's end-to-end open-source ML framework and ecosystem
en.what: TensorFlow is an end-to-end open-source machine learning platform developed by Google, offering a comprehensive toolchain and library ecosystem from research to production. It enables researchers to push the state-of-the-art in ML while allowing developers to easily build and deploy AI-powered applications.
en.content: The repository contains the core C++ runtime, Python and C++ APIs, the Keras high-level interface, plus cross-platform deployment tools like TensorFlow Lite and TensorFlow.js along with extensive official examples.
en.stack: Built on C++ for a high-performance compute backend with Python as the primary frontend; it supports CUDA GPU acceleration, Bazel builds, Docker deployment, and multi-language bindings.
en.hot: As one of the most influential foundational deep-learning frameworks, TensorFlow maintains strong momentum with 196,329 stars and 365 new stars this week, reflecting broad academic and industrial adoption for its production-grade stability.
uses: ML researchers —— who need flexible low-level APIs for model innovation and algorithmic experiments
AI application developers —— looking to quickly train and deploy models to mobile, edge, or server via Keras and TF Lite
Engineering teams —— seeking scalable, portable production pipelines from training to inference
Students and educators —— using it as a primary framework to learn deep-learning concepts and engineering practices

zh.tag: 开源跨平台 2D/3D 游戏引擎，社区驱动
zh.what: Godot 是一个功能全面的跨平台游戏引擎，提供统一的界面来创建 2D 和 3D 游戏。它内置了丰富的常用工具，用户无需重复造轮子，可以专注于游戏开发。游戏可一键导出到多个平台，包括桌面、移动、网页和主机。
zh.content: 仓库包含引擎的完整源代码、编辑器、文档和示例项目。主要目录包括核心引擎代码（C++）、场景系统、渲染器、脚本语言（GDScript）、编辑器界面以及导出模板。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，支持多种脚本语言（如 GDScript、C#、VisualScript）。依赖包括 OpenGL/Vulkan 渲染、音频库等，并支持跨平台构建。
zh.hot: Godot 因其完全免费、开源且无版税的特点而广受欢迎，社区活跃，持续更新。本月新增 1876 星，总星数达 116k，在 C++ 趋势榜中排名第 17，显示出其强大的吸引力和用户基础。
uses: 独立游戏开发者：利用 Godot 的免费开源特性，低成本开发并发布跨平台游戏。
教育场景：作为教学工具，学习游戏开发、编程和引擎架构。
游戏工作室：用于原型设计和快速迭代，支持从 2D 到 3D 的多样化项目。
开源贡献者：参与引擎开发，通过社区协作改进功能和修复问题。

en.tag: Free & open-source cross-platform 2D/3D game engine, community-driven
en.what: Godot is a feature-packed, cross-platform game engine for creating 2D and 3D games from a unified interface. It provides a comprehensive set of common tools, allowing users to focus on making games without reinventing the wheel. Games can be exported with one click to multiple platforms, including desktop, mobile, web, and consoles.
en.content: The repository contains the full engine source code, editor, documentation, and demos. Key directories include core engine code (C++), scene system, renderers, scripting language (GDScript), editor UI, and export templates.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, with support for multiple scripting languages (e.g., GDScript, C#, VisualScript). Dependencies include OpenGL/Vulkan rendering, audio libraries, and cross-platform build support.
en.hot: Godot is popular for being completely free, open-source, and royalty-free, with an active community and continuous updates. With 1,876 new stars this month and 116k total, ranking #17 on the C++ trending list, it demonstrates strong appeal and a solid user base.
uses: Indie game developers: Leverage Godot's free and open-source nature to develop and publish cross-platform games at low cost.
Educational settings: Use as a teaching tool to learn game development, programming, and engine architecture.
Game studios: For prototyping and rapid iteration, supporting diverse projects from 2D to 3D.
Open-source contributors: Participate in engine development, improving features and fixing issues through community collaboration.

zh.tag: 面向移动端与边缘设备的混合云边 AI 推理引擎
zh.what: Cactus 是一个专为移动设备、可穿戴设备、智能家居和机器人设计的混合边缘-云 AI 引擎。它提供 OpenAI 兼容的 API，支持文本、语音和视觉任务，并具备本地推理与云端卸载能力。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Cactus Engine（引擎）、Cactus Graph（零拷贝计算图）、Cactus Kernels（CPU/GPU 内核）和 Cactus Quants（基于旋转的量化技术）。提供 C++ API 和命令行工具，支持快速部署。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖硬件加速（Apple、Samsung、Pixel 等），支持多种精度（FP16、INT8），并集成自动 RAG 和流式生成。
zh.hot: 随着边缘 AI 需求增长，Cactus 提供了高效的移动端推理方案，月增 425 星，登上 GitHub Trending C++ 月榜第 17 名，受到开发者关注。
uses: 移动应用开发者：在手机或平板上部署本地 AI 模型，实现离线文本生成、语音识别等功能。
嵌入式/机器人工程师：为资源受限的设备（如智能家居、机器人）集成 AI 推理能力。
边缘计算研究者：探索混合云边架构和量化技术，优化模型在边缘设备上的性能。

en.tag: Hybrid edge-cloud AI inference engine for mobile, wearables, smart home and robots
en.what: Cactus is a hybrid edge-cloud AI engine designed for mobile devices, wearables, smart home and robots. It offers OpenAI-compatible APIs for text, speech, and vision, with local inference and cloud handoff capabilities.
en.content: The repository contains Cactus Engine, Cactus Graph (zero-copy computation graph), Cactus Kernels (CPU/GPU kernels), and Cactus Quants (rotation-based quantization). It provides C++ APIs and CLI tools for quick deployment.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, leverages hardware acceleration (Apple, Samsung, Pixel, etc.), supports multiple precisions (FP16, INT8), and integrates auto-RAG and streaming generation.
en.hot: With rising edge AI demand, Cactus offers an efficient on-device inference solution, gaining 425 stars this month and ranking #17 on GitHub Trending C++ monthly, attracting developer attention.
uses: Mobile app developers: deploy on-device AI models for offline text generation, speech recognition, etc.
Embedded/robotics engineers: integrate AI inference into resource-constrained devices like smart home and robots.
Edge computing researchers: explore hybrid cloud-edge architectures and quantization techniques to optimize performance on edge devices.

zh.tag: 明日方舟全自动日常助手，一键长草
zh.what: MAA 是一款基于图像识别的《明日方舟》游戏辅助工具，能自动完成游戏内的日常任务，如刷图、基建换班、公招等。它通过模拟操作和图像识别，让玩家实现“一键长草”，省时省力。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 C++ 源代码、文档（支持多语言）、以及用于构建和发布的配置。主要模块涵盖战斗、基建、公招、肉鸽等自动化功能，并提供多种编程语言的接口。
zh.stack: 基于 C++20 开发，使用图像识别技术，支持 Windows、Linux 和 macOS 平台。项目还集成了多种语言的接口，如 C、Python、Java、Rust 和 Golang。
zh.hot: 作为热门游戏《明日方舟》的辅助工具，MAA 凭借其高度自动化和活跃的社区更新，在 GitHub 上获得了 2.3 万星标，本月新增 762 星，位列 C++ 趋势榜第 21 名。
uses: 《明日方舟》玩家：希望自动完成日常任务，节省时间，实现一键长草。
游戏自动化爱好者：对图像识别和模拟操作技术感兴趣，可学习其实现。
开发者：需要集成游戏辅助功能，可通过提供的多种语言接口进行二次开发。

en.tag: One-click Arknights daily task assistant, auto-grind all clients
en.what: MAA is an image-recognition-based assistant for Arknights that automates daily tasks like auto-battles, base management, and recruitment. It simulates user operations to enable one-click idle farming, saving time and effort.
en.content: The repo contains full C++ source code, multi-language docs, and build/release configs. Main modules cover battle, base, recruitment, and roguelike automation, with APIs in multiple languages.
en.stack: Built with C++20, leveraging image recognition, and supporting Windows, Linux, and macOS. It also provides APIs for C, Python, Java, Rust, and Golang.
en.hot: As a popular Arknights assistant, MAA's high automation and active community updates have earned 22,988 stars, with 762 added this month, ranking #21 on the C++ trending list.
uses: Arknights players who want to automate daily tasks and save time with one-click farming.
Game automation enthusiasts interested in image recognition and simulated input techniques.
Developers seeking to integrate game assist features via provided multi-language APIs.

zh.tag: 原生高性能桌面命令面板，可扩展的启动器
zh.what: Vicinae 是一个高性能的原生桌面命令面板，集应用搜索、剪贴板历史、文本扩展、文件搜索、浏览器标签切换、表情选择器、计算器、窗口切换等功能于一体。它支持通过 React/TypeScript 扩展（兼容 Raycast 生态）和脚本命令进行扩展，还提供 dmenu 风格菜单创建。
zh.content: 仓库包含 C++ 核心源码、文档、扩展 API、脚本命令支持，以及 Vicinae 和 Raycast 商店的集成。还提供网站和 Discord 社区链接，以及赞助商列表。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 开发，支持 React/TypeScript 扩展（兼容 Raycast），并集成脚本命令和 dmenu 风格菜单。
zh.hot: 凭借原生高性能和 Raycast 生态兼容性，Vicinae 在开发者中迅速走红，月增 585 星，总星数达 9305，位列 GitHub Trending C++ 月榜第 23 名。
uses: 追求高效桌面操作的用户，可通过命令面板快速完成应用启动、文件搜索等任务。
开发者可利用 React/TypeScript 扩展或脚本命令定制工作流，兼容 Raycast 生态。
Linux 用户可使用 dmenu 风格菜单创建，实现极简交互。

en.tag: Native high-performance desktop command palette, extensible launcher
en.what: Vicinae is a high-performance native command palette for the desktop, integrating app search, clipboard history, text expansion, file search, browser tab switching, emoji picker, calculator, and window switching. It supports extension via React/TypeScript (Raycast-compatible) and script commands, plus dmenu-style menu creation.
en.content: The repository contains C++ core source code, documentation, extension APIs, script command support, and integration with Vicinae and Raycast stores. It also provides links to the website and Discord community, plus a sponsor list.
en.stack: Primarily developed in C++, supports React/TypeScript extensions (Raycast-compatible), and integrates script commands and dmenu-style menus.
en.hot: With native high performance and Raycast ecosystem compatibility, Vicinae quickly gained popularity among developers, adding 585 stars this month to reach 9305 total, ranking 23rd on GitHub Trending C++ monthly.
uses: Users seeking efficient desktop operations can quickly launch apps, search files, etc., via the command palette.
Developers can customize workflows using React/TypeScript extensions or script commands, compatible with the Raycast ecosystem.
Linux users can leverage dmenu-style menu creation for minimalist interaction.

zh.tag: 港大出品的 AI 私人家教：个性化终身学习工作区
zh.what: 香港大学 HKUDS 实验室的「agent 原生」学习平台：聊天辅导、刷题测验、深度研究、可视化、解题、Mastery Path 掌握度练习跑在同一套 agent 循环上。支持多引擎 RAG 知识库（LlamaIndex、PageIndex、GraphRAG、LightRAG，可挂 Obsidian 库），可从任意对话呼叫 Claude Code / Codex 等子 agent；带三层可检查记忆（L1 trace / L2 摘要 / L3 综合）和 Memory Graph 溯源。
zh.content: 完整 Web 应用（Python 后端 + Next.js 16 前端），附 11 种语言 README、Docker 部署、CLI/agent-native 接口、EduHub 社区 skills 生态；发版极勤。
zh.stack: Python 3.11+ + Next.js 16，RAG 多引擎 + MCP 工具 + FAISS 向量库，Apache-2.0；2025 年 12 月底创建，有 arXiv 论文背书。
zh.hot: 它把 AI 教育与 Agent 原生工作流结合，并由高校实验室持续维护，概念清晰、可体验性强。
uses: 学生 / 自学者 —— 把教材和论文喂进去，得到 24 小时私人家教
考研 / 考证党 —— 用刷题测验 + 掌握度路径系统备考
知识管理玩家 —— 直接挂 Obsidian 库做 RAG 问答

en.tag: An AI personal tutor from HKU: a lifelong, personalized learning workspace
en.what: An 'agent-native' learning platform from HKU's HKUDS lab: chat tutoring, quizzes, deep research, visualization, problem solving and Mastery-Path practice all run on one agent loop. It supports multi-engine RAG knowledge bases (LlamaIndex, PageIndex, GraphRAG, LightRAG — even your Obsidian vault), lets you call Claude Code / Codex sub-agents from any conversation, and ships three-layer inspectable memory (L1 trace / L2 summary / L3 synthesis) with a Memory Graph for provenance.
en.content: A full web app (Python backend + Next.js 16 frontend) with READMEs in 11 languages, Docker deployment, CLI/agent-native interfaces and the EduHub community skills ecosystem; releases ship very frequently.
en.stack: Python 3.11+ + Next.js 16, multi-engine RAG + MCP tools + FAISS; Apache-2.0; created late December 2025 with an arXiv paper behind it.
en.hot: It combines AI education with an agent-native workflow and carries the credibility of a university research lab, making the concept easy to evaluate and share.
uses: Students & self-learners — feed in textbooks and papers, get a 24/7 personal tutor
Exam candidates — prepare systematically with quizzes and the mastery path
PKM enthusiasts — plug your Obsidian vault straight in for RAG Q&A

zh.tag: 专治「AI 味」网页的设计 skill，让 AI 生成的 UI 不像模板货
zh.what: Together AI 出品的设计 skill 包：装进 Claude Code、Cursor 或 Codex 后，AI 生成网页 UI 时会从 20 套主题里选宏观结构，并跑 57 项「anti-slop」检查加自我批判，拒绝 LLM 默认那套千篇一律的渐变卡片风。提供生成、hallmark audit（给现有代码打分）、hallmark redesign（换结构重写）、hallmark study（从截图/URL 提取设计 DNA）四个动词。
zh.content: 核心是 skills/hallmark/ 下的 SKILL.md + references/ 规则文件；docs/ 有 recipes 和示例，site/ 是官网及大量自包含 HTML+CSS 示例页（语言占比因此显示为 CSS）。
zh.stack: Markdown 规则 + 参考文档的 skill 包（符合 Agent Skills 规范），示例为纯 HTML/CSS，MIT，无运行时依赖，一行 npx skills add nutlope/hallmark 安装。
zh.hot: 它直指 AI 生成网站同质化这一普遍痛点，并用在线 Demo 降低验证门槛，定位清晰且易于传播。
uses: 独立开发者 / 小团队 —— 没有设计师，也能让 AI 生成不撞脸的官网和落地页
设计师 —— 用 hallmark study 从优秀网站提取设计 DNA 做参考
前端工程师 —— 用 audit 给存量项目打分，找出「AI 味」重灾区

en.tag: The anti-'AI-slop' design skill — AI-built UIs that don't look like templates
en.what: A design skill pack from Together AI: once installed in Claude Code, Cursor or Codex, your agent picks a macro-structure from 20 themes when generating web UIs, then runs 57 'anti-slop' checks plus self-critique — rejecting the default LLM look of identical gradient cards. Four verbs: generate, hallmark audit (score existing code), hallmark redesign (rewrite with a new structure), hallmark study (extract design DNA from a screenshot or URL).
en.content: The core is SKILL.md plus rule files under skills/hallmark/ and references/; docs/ holds recipes and examples; site/ contains the homepage and many self-contained HTML+CSS example pages (which is why the language stat reads CSS).
en.stack: A Markdown-rules skill pack (Agent Skills compliant) with pure HTML/CSS examples; MIT, zero runtime dependencies; install via npx skills add nutlope/hallmark.
en.hot: Its anti-slop positioning addresses a common complaint about AI-generated websites, while the live demo makes the claim easy to evaluate.
uses: Indie devs & small teams — generate distinctive sites and landing pages without a designer
Designers — extract design DNA from great sites with hallmark study
Frontend engineers — audit existing projects to find the worst 'AI-slop' offenders

zh.tag: 开源版 CapCut（剪映），免费跨平台视频编辑器
zh.what: 免费开源视频编辑器，对标 CapCut，目标覆盖 Web、桌面和移动端。项目正在从零重写：Editor API、插件优先架构、Rust 核心（一套代码跑桌面/移动/浏览器）、供 AI agent 调用的 MCP server、无头批量渲染模式和编辑器内置脚本页。旧版代码已迁至 opencut-classic 继续维护。
zh.content: monorepo：apps/web、apps/desktop、apps/api 三个应用，根目录 Cargo.toml（Rust 核心）；用 moonrepo + proto 管理工具链，moon run web:dev 即可起本地开发。
zh.stack: TypeScript（Web 前端）+ Rust 核心，Bun 包管理，MIT；重写期间暂不接受外部代码贡献。
zh.hot: 「开源视频剪辑工具」满足了广泛需求，Rust 重写与基于 MCP 的 AI 剪辑能力又形成了清晰的技术差异。
uses: 自媒体创作者 —— 免费替代剪映专业版，无水印跨平台剪片
开发者 / 自动化团队 —— 通过 MCP server 让 AI agent 批量剪视频
企业 —— 基于 Editor API 和插件架构搭建内部视频流水线

en.tag: The open-source CapCut alternative — free, cross-platform video editing
en.what: A free, open-source video editor rivaling CapCut, targeting web, desktop and mobile. The project is being rewritten from scratch: an Editor API, plugin-first architecture, a Rust core (one codebase for desktop/mobile/browser), an MCP server so AI agents can edit video, a headless mode for automated batch rendering, and built-in editor scripting. Legacy code lives on in opencut-classic.
en.content: A monorepo: apps/web, apps/desktop and apps/api, with a root Cargo.toml for the Rust core; toolchain managed by moonrepo + proto — `moon run web:dev` starts local dev.
en.stack: TypeScript (web frontend) + Rust core, Bun for packages, MIT; external code contributions are paused during the rewrite.
en.hot: The open-source alternative to CapCut addresses broad latent demand, while the Rust rewrite and MCP-based AI editing story give the project a distinct technical direction.
uses: Content creators — a free, watermark-free CapCut Pro alternative across platforms
Dev & automation teams — batch-edit video via AI agents over the MCP server
Companies — build internal video pipelines on the Editor API and plugin architecture

zh.tag: 开源一体化产品数据平台：分析、回放、实验、LLM 观测全包
zh.what: 知名开源产品数据平台：产品分析、Web 分析、session 回放、feature flag、A/B 实验、错误追踪、日志、问卷、数据仓库、CDP、LLM 可观测性全部集成在一个系统。最新定位「构建自驱动产品（self-driving products）」：把错误、rage click 等产品信号自动转成分析报告和 PR 供你 review 合并，可从 Slack、Web、桌面端或 MCP 操作，支持 Docker 自托管。
zh.content: 超大型 monorepo：posthog/（Django 后端）、frontend/、products/（各产品线）、rust/、services/、ee/（企业版，单独授权），大量 docker-compose 部署文件与全平台 SDK。
zh.stack: Python/Django + TypeScript/React + Rust 服务，底层 ClickHouse；MIT（ee/ 目录除外）。
zh.hot: 它把完整的产品分析套件与面向 Agent 的自动化能力结合，既有成熟开发者用户，也有清晰的新使用场景。
uses: 产品团队 —— 一个平台替代 GA + 回放 + 实验工具的组合订阅
注重数据合规的公司 —— 自托管部署，用户数据不出机房
AI 产品团队 —— 用 LLM 可观测性追踪自家 agent 的成本与质量

en.tag: The open-source all-in-one product data platform
en.what: The well-known open-source product data platform: product analytics, web analytics, session replay, feature flags, A/B experiments, error tracking, logs, surveys, a data warehouse, CDP pipelines and LLM observability in one system. Its latest positioning is 'self-driving products': product signals like errors and rage clicks are automatically turned into analysis reports and PRs for you to review and merge — operable from Slack, web, desktop or MCP, and self-hostable via Docker.
en.content: A huge monorepo: posthog/ (Django backend), frontend/, products/ (each product line), rust/, services/, ee/ (enterprise code, separately licensed), lots of docker-compose files and SDKs for every platform.
en.stack: Python/Django + TypeScript/React + Rust services over ClickHouse; MIT (except ee/).
en.hot: The project combines a broad product-analytics suite with an agent-facing automation narrative, giving an established developer audience a clear reason to revisit it.
uses: Product teams — replace the GA + replay + experimentation stack with one platform
Compliance-sensitive companies — self-host so user data never leaves your infra
AI product teams — track your agents' cost and quality with LLM observability

zh.tag: 1-bit/三值超压缩大模型 Bonsai 的本地运行 demo
zh.what: PrismML 的 Bonsai 系列语言模型官方演示仓库，主打极致量化：1-bit 版每权重约 1.125 bit，27B 模型能塞进现代 iPhone；三值（Ternary）版约 1.7 bit，是质量更高的默认选项。最新 27B 是视觉语言模型，支持看图、tool calling、MCP、256k+ 长上下文和推理努力度调节。
zh.content: 纯 Shell 脚本工程：setup.sh / setup.ps1 一键装依赖下模型，scripts/ 放运行和下载脚本，另有三份白皮书 PDF、AGENTS.md（写给 AI agent 看的配置指南）、VISION/TOOLS 等专题文档与社区 benchmark。
zh.stack: Shell + llama.cpp 服务端，模型托管在 HuggingFace；支持 Mac Metal、CUDA/Vulkan/ROCm 和纯 CPU，Apache-2.0。
zh.hot: 视觉语言模型与 iPhone 端侧演示把技术卖点变得直观，配套脚本也降低了上手与复现实验的门槛。
uses: 手机 / 边缘设备开发者 —— 在 iPhone 上离线跑 27B 视觉语言模型
隐私敏感场景 —— 医疗、法律等数据不出本地的本地 AI 助手
硬件玩家 —— 在树莓派等低功耗设备上体验大模型

en.tag: Local-run demo of Bonsai, the 1-bit / ternary ultra-compressed LLMs
en.what: The official demo repo for PrismML's Bonsai model family, built around extreme quantization: the 1-bit version uses ~1.125 bits per weight so a 27B model fits a modern iPhone; the ternary version (~1.7 bits) is the higher-quality default. The newest 27B is a vision-language model with image input, tool calling, MCP, 256k+ context and adjustable reasoning effort.
en.content: A pure Shell project: setup.sh / setup.ps1 one-liners install dependencies and pull models, scripts/ holds run/download scripts, plus three whitepaper PDFs, an AGENTS.md (a config guide written for AI agents), topical docs (VISION/TOOLS/…) and community benchmarks.
en.stack: Shell + a llama.cpp server, models hosted on HuggingFace; runs on Mac Metal, CUDA/Vulkan/ROCm or plain CPU; Apache-2.0.
en.hot: The vision-language model and on-device iPhone demo make a technically ambitious claim concrete, while the included scripts reduce trial friction.
uses: Mobile / edge developers — run a 27B vision-language model offline on an iPhone
Privacy-sensitive settings — local AI assistants for medical or legal data that can't leave the device
Hardware tinkerers — run LLMs on low-power boards like a Raspberry Pi

zh.tag: 100+ 个能直接跑起来的 AI Agent 和 RAG 应用合集
zh.what: 超大号 LLM 应用模板库：收录 100 多个亲手构建并端到端测试过的 AI agent、agent skill 和 RAG 应用，全部 Apache-2.0 可商用。兼容 Claude、Gemini、GPT、DeepSeek、Llama、Qwen 等主流模型，克隆下来装依赖就能跑，口号「clone, customize, ship」。
zh.content: 按难度和形态分目录：agent_skills/（npx 一键装技能）、starter_ai_agents/（单文件入门）、advanced_ai_agents/（多智能体团队）、voice_ai_agents/、always_on_agents/、RAG 教程等；每个模板配 README 和依赖清单，场景覆盖旅行规划、金融分析、播客生成、房屋装修等。
zh.stack: Python 为主，常见 Streamlit 前端 + 各家模型 SDK，部分用 CrewAI/AG2 等多智能体框架。
zh.hot: 它用大量可运行示例降低 LLM 应用试验成本，并通过 Agent Skill 模板与教程保持对实践者的持续价值。
uses: AI 入门开发者 —— 克隆单文件模板，一天跑通第一个 LLM 应用
创业团队 —— 基于成熟模板二开（旅行规划 / 金融分析 / 播客生成）快速验证 idea
企业技术选型 —— 横向对比 CrewAI / AG2 等框架的真实代码

en.tag: 100+ AI Agent & RAG apps you can actually run
en.what: A giant library of LLM app templates: 100+ hand-built, end-to-end-tested AI agents, agent skills and RAG apps, all Apache-2.0 (commercial use OK). Works with Claude, Gemini, GPT, DeepSeek, Llama, Qwen and more — clone, install deps, run. The motto: 'clone, customize, ship'.
en.content: Organized by difficulty and form: agent_skills/ (one-line npx installs), starter_ai_agents/ (single-file starters), advanced_ai_agents/ (multi-agent teams), voice_ai_agents/, always_on_agents/, RAG tutorials and more; each template ships a README and requirements, covering travel planning, financial analysis, podcast generation, home renovation…
en.stack: Mostly Python, usually a Streamlit frontend over OpenAI/Gemini/Anthropic SDKs, some CrewAI/AG2 multi-agent frameworks.
en.hot: Its broad, example-led catalog lowers the cost of trying LLM applications, while agent-skill templates and tutorials keep the collection useful to practitioners.
uses: AI beginners — clone a single-file template and ship your first LLM app in a day
Startup teams — fork mature templates (travel planning, finance analysis, podcast generation) to validate ideas fast
Enterprise evaluators — compare CrewAI / AG2 and other frameworks on real code

zh.tag: GTA 5 增强版的开源作弊菜单 DLL
zh.what: 《GTA 5: Enhanced》的实验性修改菜单（mod menu）：编译成 DLL 后用 Xenos 等注入器在游戏主菜单注入，按 INSERT 或 Ctrl+\ 呼出菜单。建议配合 FSL 把存档数据重定向到本地磁盘以保号，且需要关闭 BattlEye 反作弊（目前没有 BE 绕过，公共战局会被心跳检测踢出）。
zh.content: C++ 源码 + 一份简短 README，讲清使用步骤（FSL → 下载 nightly release → 注入器 → 关 BattlEye → 注入）和常见问题修复（掉线、存档消失、游戏起不来）。
zh.stack: C++，DLL 注入式单机/联机修改器，依赖外部注入器和 FSL，GPL-2.0；默认分支 enhanced。
zh.hot: 它面向 GTA5 增强版 Mod 社区的具体需求，并延续 YimMenu 项目路线，为需要开源菜单的用户提供选择。
uses: GTA5 单机玩家 —— 刷车刷钱体验全部游戏内容
mod 开发者 —— 基于源码学习或二次开发游戏菜单
离线娱乐 —— 关 BattlEye 后在私人战局整活

en.tag: The open-source mod menu DLL for GTA 5: Enhanced
en.what: An experimental mod menu for GTA 5: Enhanced: compile to a DLL, inject at the main menu with an injector like Xenos, then press INSERT or Ctrl+\ to open. Pairing with FSL (redirecting save data to local disk) is recommended to protect your account, and BattlEye anti-cheat must be disabled (there's no BE bypass — public sessions will kick you via heartbeat checks).
en.content: C++ source plus a short README covering the workflow (FSL → nightly release → injector → disable BattlEye → inject) and fixes for common issues (disconnects, missing saves, game won't launch).
en.stack: C++, a DLL-injection single/multiplayer mod menu relying on external injectors and FSL; GPL-2.0; default branch enhanced.
en.hot: It targets a concrete need in the GTA5 Enhanced modding community and continues the familiar YimMenu project line for users seeking an open menu.
uses: GTA5 single-player fans — unlock vehicles and cash to experience all content
mod developers — learn from or fork the source for custom game menus
Offline fun — mess around in private sessions with BattlEye off

zh.tag: 教你从零重写各种技术的教程大合集
zh.what: CodeCrafters 维护的著名教程索引仓库，理念是费曼那句「我不能创造的东西，我就不理解」。收录大量「从零重写某技术」的 step-by-step 教程链接，覆盖数据库、操作系统、Git、Docker、编程语言、神经网络、Web 浏览器等约 30 个类别。
zh.content: 主体是一个巨大的 README 列表，按「Build your own X」分类组织，每条标注所用编程语言和链接（如用 Python 写 LLM、用 C++ 写光线追踪）；无代码本体。
zh.stack: 纯 Markdown 文档；收录的教程本身横跨 C/C++/Python/Go/Rust 等各种语言。
zh.hot: 它用「亲手实现一遍」把抽象的计算机科学原理变成具体项目，学习路径清晰，因此长期具有传播力。
uses: 在校生 / 转行者 —— 按「造一遍」路线真正理解数据库、操作系统原理
资深工程师 —— 面试前用手写 Git / Docker 项目补底层功底
技术布道者 —— 按分类找写作和分享素材

en.tag: The giant collection of 'rebuild your favorite tech from scratch' tutorials
en.what: CodeCrafters' famous tutorial index, founded on Feynman's 'What I cannot create, I do not understand'. It collects step-by-step 'build your own X' tutorial links across ~30 categories: databases, operating systems, Git, Docker, programming languages, neural networks, web browsers and more.
en.content: Essentially one huge README list organized by 'Build your own X' categories, each entry tagged with its language and link (e.g. write an LLM in Python, a raytracer in C++); no code of its own.
en.stack: Pure Markdown; the tutorials themselves span C/C++/Python/Go/Rust and more.
en.hot: Its learn-by-building catalog remains useful because it turns abstract computer-science concepts into concrete implementation projects.
uses: Students & career switchers — truly understand databases and OS internals by building them
Senior engineers — shore up fundamentals before interviews by hand-rolling Git / Docker
Tech writers — find writing and talk material by category

zh.tag: 把 GitHub Copilot 智能体嵌进你自己应用的官方 SDK
zh.what: GitHub 官方出的多语言 SDK：在自己的应用或服务里直接调用 Copilot Agent 的能力。它暴露的是 Copilot CLI 背后同一套经过生产验证的 agent 运行时 —— 你不用自己搭编排层，定义好 agent 行为，规划、工具调用、文件编辑都交给 Copilot 处理。
zh.content: 单仓库 6 套 SDK，按目录分：nodejs/、python/、go/、dotnet/、java/、rust/，另有 docs/、test/ 和 cookbook 示例；各语言经 npm / PyPI / NuGet / Maven Central / crates.io 分发。
zh.stack: 多语言 monorepo（TS/Python/Go/.NET/Java/Rust 六个 SDK），MIT；2026 年 1 月创建，推送非常活跃。
zh.hot: 「Copilot agent 能力开放给第三方应用」的定位自带关注度，GitHub 官方背书。
uses: SaaS 厂商 —— 在产品里内嵌 Copilot 级 AI 助手（IDE、低代码平台等）
企业内部工具 —— 快速给内部系统加 agent 能力，不用自研编排
多语言团队 —— JS / Python / Go / .NET / Java / Rust 任选

en.tag: GitHub's official SDK for embedding the Copilot agent in your own apps
en.what: GitHub's official multi-language SDK: call the Copilot Agent's capabilities directly from your own apps and services. It exposes the same production-proven agent runtime behind the Copilot CLI — no need to build your own orchestration layer: define the agent's behavior and let Copilot handle planning, tool calls and file edits.
en.content: Six SDKs in one repo, by directory: nodejs/, python/, go/, dotnet/, java/, rust/, plus docs/, test/ and cookbook examples; distributed via npm / PyPI / NuGet / Maven Central / crates.io.
en.stack: A multi-language monorepo (TS/Python/Go/.NET/Java/Rust), MIT; created January 2026, committing very actively.
en.hot: 'Copilot agent capabilities opened to third-party apps' draws attention by itself — with GitHub's official stamp on it.
uses: SaaS vendors — embed Copilot-grade AI assistance into products (IDEs, low-code platforms)
Internal tooling — add agent capabilities to internal systems without building orchestration
Polyglot teams — pick from JS / Python / Go / .NET / Java / Rust

zh.tag: 你的「AI 团队总管」：把一堆 agent 组织起来 7×24 干活
zh.what: 定位「Chief Agent Operator」：把多个 AI agent 当工作单元统一招聘、调度和汇报。核心功能包括 Agent Builder（描述需求即可自动配置出可用 agent）、Agent Groups（多 agent 并行协作）、Pages/Schedule/Project/Workspace 协作面板，以及白盒可编辑的 Personal Memory；支持接入任意模型和模态，号称 10000+ skills 和 MCP 插件生态。
zh.content: 可自部署的 Web 应用（Vercel/Docker/Zeabur/Sealos 一键部署），仓库含完整中英文档、Changelog、插件体系和本地开发指南；默认分支 canary，今天仍在高频 push。
zh.stack: TypeScript + Next.js 系 Web 应用，Docker 自托管，插件走 MCP 协议；许可证为自定义（非标准）。
zh.hot: 多 Agent 调度与即时通信网关的组合，让这一成熟 AI 应用平台形成了明确的协作化方向。
uses: 一人公司 / 自由职业者 —— 组建 7×24 自动干活的 agent 团队处理重复工作
运营团队 —— 定时调度 agent 做日报、巡检、内容分发
进阶玩家 —— 用 Personal Memory 和 10000+ skills 定制专属助手

en.tag: Your 'Chief Agent Operator' — an AI team working 7×24
en.what: Positioned as a 'Chief Agent Operator': hire, schedule and hear reports from multiple AI agents as work units. Key features: Agent Builder (describe the need, get a configured agent), Agent Groups (parallel multi-agent collaboration), Pages/Schedule/Project/Workspace panels, and a white-box editable Personal Memory; any model and modality, with a claimed 10,000+ skills and MCP plugin ecosystem.
en.content: A self-deployable web app (one-click Vercel/Docker/Zeabur/Sealos), with full bilingual docs, a changelog, the plugin system and local dev guides; default branch canary, still pushing frequently today.
en.stack: TypeScript + Next.js, self-hosted via Docker, plugins over MCP; custom (non-standard) license.
en.hot: Its combination of multi-agent orchestration and messaging gateways gives an established AI application platform a clear collaboration-focused direction.
uses: Solo founders & freelancers — run a 7×24 agent team for repetitive work
Ops teams — schedule agents for daily reports, patrols and content distribution
Power users — craft custom assistants with Personal Memory and 10,000+ skills

zh.tag: 终端里的编程 agent，专为便宜小模型优化
zh.what: 跑在终端里的 AI 编程助手（OpenAI Codex 的 fork），核心思路「换 harness 不换模型」：内置 claude-code、kimi-cli、qwen-code、deepseek-tui 等多种 agent 运行框架，让低成本开源模型也打出好表现。自带 QA 技能，可驱动真实浏览器或原生 App 做界面测试，支持 macOS/Linux/Windows 原生沙箱执行。
zh.content: 完整 Rust 工程：终端 TUI、文档站（openinterpreter.com/docs）、安装脚本；配置与会话存本地 ~/.openinterpreter，支持 /model 切模型、/harness 切框架、MCP、hooks、AGENTS.md。
zh.stack: Rust（2023 年创建的老牌项目，刚从 Python 重写），Apache-2.0；支持 ACP 协议接入编辑器，可接多家模型 provider。
zh.hot: Rust 重写与「低成本模型运行框架」定位，正好契合开发者对更高效编程 Agent 基础设施的需求。
uses: 预算有限的开发者 —— 用 DeepSeek / Qwen 等便宜模型跑编程 agent，成本降一个量级
多工具用户 —— 一套终端切换 claude-code、kimi-cli 等不同框架
QA 团队 —— 让 agent 驱动真实浏览器做界面自动化测试

en.tag: A coding agent in your terminal, tuned for low-cost models
en.what: An AI coding assistant in your terminal (a fork of OpenAI Codex) built on the idea of 'swap the harness, not the model': it bundles multiple agent runtimes — claude-code, kimi-cli, qwen-code, deepseek-tui — so cheap open models still perform well. It ships a QA skill that drives real browsers or native apps for UI testing, with native sandboxing on macOS/Linux/Windows.
en.content: A full Rust project: the terminal TUI, a docs site (openinterpreter.com/docs) and install scripts; config and sessions live in ~/.openinterpreter, with /model to switch models, /harness to switch runtimes, plus MCP, hooks and AGENTS.md support.
en.stack: Rust (a 2023 veteran, freshly rewritten from Python), Apache-2.0; supports ACP (Agent Client Protocol) for editors and multiple model providers.
en.hot: The Rust rewrite and focus on serving as a harness for lower-cost models align with demand for efficient coding-agent infrastructure.
uses: Budget-conscious devs — run coding agents on cheap models like DeepSeek / Qwen, an order of magnitude cheaper
Multi-tool users — swap between claude-code, kimi-cli and other harnesses in one terminal
QA teams — let agents drive real browsers for UI automation testing
